内容: Blades gleam, swords cast shadows; the ground darkens as heaven dims. At the Taiyue Grand Ceremony, heroes clash, and for a moment, it's unclear who will emerge victorious.
Just as the decisive moment to determine victory or defeat, life or death approached, suddenly, the earth shook and the seas roiled!
What's going on?! Is it an earthquake?! ...Okay, so it's just Senior Brother Yang... Don't shake the bed apart...

#PlayerName#!#PlayerName#! It's already well past sunrise, why are you still sleeping so late!\nWhile still muttering things like 'Take this!' and 'You're too kind' under his breath.\nYou must be doing heroic deeds again in your dreams.
Quiet, I was in the middle of showcasing my skills at the Taiyue Grand Ceremony, dominating all around me, about to crush the major factions... and then you came and ruined it!
Fine, fine, then I won't bother you \nBut your master is currently waiting for you in the main hall. If he gets too anxious,\n#PlayerName#, don't blame me for not warning you.
Master?!! Why didn't you say so earlier! I'll get dressed right away. You go ahead and stall for time; I'll be there shortly!
Alright, alright, hurry up before you fall asleep again.
Huh…Huh…Disciple #$PlayerName# pays respect to Master!……Huh…
It's already past three in the afternoon; why are you still lounging in your dorm room?\nI went to today's morning training session, #PlayerName#, you didn't go either.
Hehe, Master, I've been studying a new set of techniques recently. This art is rather peculiar; it can only be cultivated in dreams…
Oh? Could it be the long-lost secret art "Dream Slay True Dragon"? Very well, you've been in our sect, Xianxia Clan, for several months now. Today, I'll test you to see if your skills have improved.
This, this... Master, I am inexperienced and my martial arts are not refined... Please go easy on me.
Rest assured, I have my limits. First, let me handle this series of Sword!
Master... please spare me! I can't fight anymore.
Hmph! Talk about refining your martial arts in dreams. You haven't even mastered our sect's most basic Linked Sword. What face do you have to beg for mercy!
They knelt down loudly \nMaster spare me!, #PlayerName# though he sleeps all day long,\nBut he is always punctual for meals, never late once!
You, you, you...

(smiling and kneeling)\n#PlayerName# started latest and has the shortest training period.\nIt is understandable that your understanding of this martial arts technique is not yet deep. Please, Master, forgive me.
All of you get up, get up!\n#PlayerName#, Master showed you mercy during our sparring to prevent you from getting seriously injured.
What if you encounter bandits or your enemies on your travels? Would they show mercy like I do?
Of course not... Master, I know my mistake!
If we had encountered thieves just now, disciple would likely be dead by now and unable to serve you in your old age!
Heh, if you put as much effort into your training as you do into being witty, your skills wouldn't be so pitiful.
#$PlayerName#, you have natural talent, so I naturally have higher expectations for you.\nFrom today onward, you must study diligently and train hard; never be careless or lax again.
To avoid being laughed at by others in the martial world when they hear you're my disciple, I must ensure I don't end up with an unworthy student like you!
Master Xie, thank you for your guidance! From today on, I will earnestly mend my ways and diligently practice. I will not disappoint your teachings!
Huh…Scared me to death \nAlmost thought Master was going to expel #PlayerName# from the sect.……
That's not quite true. Although Master flew into a rage, deep down, he has a heart of tofu behind his sharp words.
Moreover, #PlayerName#'s Martial Arts are quite lacking as well.\nI saw it all and I was holding my breath for you too.
Hehe, Senior Apprentice Brother Gu, your martial arts are formidable. Only the eldest senior apprentice can outshine you. Today, my mediocre skills are truly a source of embarrassment.
We are fellow junior brothers in the same sect. What's there to find humor in?\n#PlayerName#, if you can muster courage after feeling ashamed, you are still worthy of being called a hero.
Alright then, since I have some free time today, I'll go ahead and give you some guidance.

Now that your foundation is unstable, you can't even perform the simplest Tai Zu Chang Quan smoothly. I think you need to firstRead the Grand Ancestor Long Fist Manual to accumulate theoretical experience.That's enough.
I'll go first.Our sect's Scripture PavilionMedium, bring out the Grand Ancestor Long Fist Manual. Get ready and come over; don't go wandering around again.
Our sect's Scripture PavilionWhat? Yes! I'm coming right away, Senior Brother.
Wow, our sect's library hall is adorned with exquisite carvings and paintings, filled with countless books. It truly is impressive.
Judging by your surprised tone, you probably haven't been here since you first entered, right?
Ah, this... hehe. Senior Brother, please tell me how to read this manual.

Ah... to master martial arts, you first need to study manuals. Martial arts are divided into four major categories: Internal Art, Movement Art, Special Techniques, and External Arts. Are you clear on this?
Senior Brother underestimates me. Isn't this something even a three-year-old would know?
Among theseInternal Art, Movement Art, Ultimate SkillOnce activated, it continuously provides a bonus effect. The higher the cultivation technique level, the stronger the bonus effect.
AndExternal ArtFor example, the Taizu Long Fist is a truly effective offensive move in combat. The higher the External Art level, the stronger the attack power naturally becomes.
So that's why my Taizu Long Fist feels weak and limp, like I'm just massaging someone's back...
#PlayerName#, you still have some self-awareness \nIt takes one martial art from grasping the basics to reaching the pinnacle, totaling Tenth-stage Power Proficiency Realm。

Now that your Great Ancestor Long Fist technique is only at the third level of cultivation, its power is naturally weak. Therefore, the top priority right now is to focus on perfecting this Great Ancestor Long Fist technique.
Oh, I've been thinking the same thing. But how can I improve my Taizu Long Fist? Please enlighten me, Senior Brother!
To advance your martial arts cultivation level, you need to accumulate sufficientTheoretical ExperienceAndCombat ExperienceBoth of these are indispensable.
Theoretical ExperienceIt is the book knowledge of a martial art. It can only be improved through reading manuals or receiving guidance from fellow practitioners.

I have found this manual for the Grandmaster Long Fist in our sect's library. Study it well first, and once you have a thorough grasp of the theory, I will teach you how to improve your practical skills.
Thanks for your efforts, Senior Brother. I'll go study it thoroughly right away.
Senior Brother, I have finished reading the Manual of Grand Ancestor's Long Fist.
Heh heh, no big deal not reading it, but boy, did I get a surprise when I did. My previous moves were indeed riddled with mistakes. No wonder Master flew into a rage.
#PlayerName# can easily spot their own mistakes with just a brief review.\nProgress is so rapid, it's making me take a second look.
#TargetInteractName#, you're flattering me too much \nIt's just the Great Ancestor Long Fist; it's as if I've mastered some world-shaking martial art.
For others, it might not be worth mentioning.\nBut it's already quite commendable for you, #PlayerName#, who are usually so lazy.
For a moment, I wasn't sure if #TargetInteractName# was praising me or insulting me.
Hehe, remember I said that a martial art requiresBoth theoretical experience and practical experience are maxed out., to level up.
Now that you have mastered this Manual, obtainTheoretical ExperienceThe next step should be learning how to obtain it.Combat ExperienceAlright.
Combat experience refers to the practical application of martial arts. It can only be gained by practicing on the Training Grounds or engaging in real battles with others.
#PlayerName#, why don't you come with me to the training ground? I can guide you on how to obtain it.Combat experience！
Training GroundsSure, Senior Brother, I'll be right there.
So this square is actually our school's Training Grounds. Whenever I passed by, I often heard shouting and thought they were slaughtering pigs!
Ah, if I don't visit the Scripture Pavilion, I won't come to the Training Ground either.\n#PlayerName# after you started playing, didn't you just hang out in the dining hall and dormitory?
And the latrine... cough. Senior Brother, could you tell me how to improve Combat Experience Okay.
Ah... let's get down to business. To improve practical combat experience, you naturally need to practice on the Training Grounds.
When your External Art level is below three, your power is extremely weak. You need to practice on your own first to quickly gain practical experience.
It won't be truly effective until your martial arts reach the fourth level and you use them in real combat against enemies.
Your Great Ancestor Long Fist technique has just reached the third level. How about you practice it here first?
This self-practice method involves using your target technique to strike incoming arrows, thereby honing the force and accuracy of your moves and enhancing practical combat experience.
Don't worry about it for now. Just start practicing, and I'll guide you along the way when you run into any issues.
#TargetInteractName#, I'll go ahead and give it a shot.
You're hitting with real conviction. #PlayerName#, if you can maintain this momentum,\nIt won't be long before there's hope of surpassing me, Senior Brother.
Really? Hahaha! By then, Master will have to look at me in a whole new light!
I was just paying you a compliment, but you took it seriously. Senior brother, I train diligently every day; how could I let a mere child like you surpass me so easily?
Hehe, that's true...
Whoosh!......Haa!......Whoosh!......Haa!
Speaking of diligence, #TargetInteractName# is the one who trains hardest in our sect.\nHe probably spends more than half of the twelve time periods practicing diligently here.
Hehe, #PlayerName#, don't tease me \nI am not very gifted, so I work hard to keep up with my senior and fellow brothers.\nSo he could only put in some dull effort and train day and night.
Well, even so, my martial arts progression is still excruciatingly slow.\nI hope that #PlayerName# and Senior Brother Gu will offer me much guidance in the future.
Yang Junior Disciple is being too modest. Though you've progressed slowly, at least you're a slow bird that takes off early.\nMaybe I even have a slight edge over #PlayerName#.
#TargetInteractName# I have to say, I'm not convinced.\nYang Sichi and I started at about the same time, so we're probably on par with each other.
Hehe, since you're not convinced, and we happen to have some time today, why don't you spar a few rounds with Brother Yang to settle things?

Besides practicing on your own, causing damage to the opponent during sparring,\nCombat experience can accumulate rapidly with martial arts beyond the fourth level.\nYou can practice your half-baked Great Ancestor Long Fist.
Ah, better not……\n#PlayerName# has exceptional talents; I am far from matching him.\nSenior Brother Gu, please don't force me to embarrass myself.……
Fellow disciples refining martial arts through sparring and debating the way-what's there to be ashamed of?\n#TargetInteractName#, just come at me full tilt! I'll show you a few moves!
Alright... okay, #PlayerName#, please be gentle...
Well, #PlayerName#'s martial arts are incredibly strong... I'm truly far behind....
Hahaha, you flatter me. Little Brother Yang's skills are also impressive and he has great potential as a master.
Ah, Younger Brother Yang's skills are remarkably formidable. It seems hard work can make up for natural shortcomings-this saying holds true.
Thank you for yielding \nHad #PlayerName# not shown mercy, I probably would have ended up with a black eye and a tail between my legs.
Alright, alright, your two amateur skills,\nWe fought for half a day with your punch and my kick, and I was almost dozing off.
Big... Elder Brother? Hehe, we've only just started our training, so our martial arts skills are naturally not up to par.
Hmph! You two better hurry up and train. The Xianxia Sect doesn't keep idle hands around!
Ah, Big Senior Brother may be cold-faced but warm-hearted. What he says about you, #PlayerName#, you don't need to take too seriously.
#PlayerName#, your Great Ancestor Long Fist should have progressed through this sparring.\nThis is precisely how one gains practical experience through combat.

I understand, byGaining theoretical experience by reading in the Scripture Pavilion, throughGain practical experience through training and sparring in the martial arts arena.When these two types of experience accumulate enough, you can advance your martial arts realm level.
The pupil is teachable, but the higher the martial arts realm, the more experience is required. Only through relentless practice day and night can one make progress.
#PlayerName#, your Great Ancestor Long Fist is still at the third or fourth level of power.\nIn my opinion, it will take another month to boost the power to the next level.
A whole month?! This Grand Ancestor Fist is one of the most basic fist techniques in the martial world. If it takes a month to master this, when will I ever become a great martial hero?
Heh, what did you expect? Who lets you slack off all day and shirk your responsibilities?

I haven't heard of Senior Apprentice Brother Gu before. Does that mean one should look at someone with new eyes after three days? Today, after listening to Master and Senior Apprentice Brother Gu's teachings, I've resolved to reform and diligently practice my skills!

(#$PlayerName# is young and full of energy; you might try flattering him into anger.)\nOh wow? I don't believe that. If #PlayerName# works hard on their cultivation, wouldn't the sun rise in the west?

Why don't we make a bet then!\nIf #PlayerName# can In a month, elevate the Great Ancestor Long Fist by one level of power.，\nI will willingly offer you the secret technique I happened to obtain a few days ago. What do you think?
Heh, let's make a deal! It's just the Great Ancestor Long Fist. I'll definitely advance to the next level within a month and have Senior Brother Gu take notice!
Oh oh, #PlayerName# really seems full of energy today.\nI can't fall behind either; I'll have to step up my efforts!\nHo!.....Ha!.....Ho!.....Ha!
Ah, this Taizu Long Fist may seem simple, but it's the foundation of a hundred fists. Once you start practicing, you lose track of time without even realizing it.
A single punch sends gusts of wind, it seems my skill has advanced to the next level. Heh heh, time to find Brother Gu and fulfill our bet.
Haha, #TargetInteractName#, good morning!\nI observed the stars last night and calculated that #TargetInteractName# you will have to spend some money today!
Oh? What do you mean by that?

#TargetInteractName# won't forget our bet, right?\nMy Great Ancestor Long Fist technique is already at the next level after a month of practice.\n#TargetInteractName#, if you don't believe me, why not try it out!

No need to do so, #PlayerName# has been making incredible progress in his recent diligent training. I've seen it with my own eyes.\nHowever, you should know that while the Great Ancestor Long Fist is one of the simplest fist techniques, it contains numerous profound principles.

Legend has it that Emperor Taizu, Guo Wei of this dynasty, created this martial art set to guide the people in training with simple techniques, strengthening their bodies and building a strong military.
Thus, in the martial world, whether it's the masters or apprentices, everyone starts their martial arts journey with the Grand Ancestral Long Fist, step by step.

No matter how extraordinary or unique a martial art is, the methods of cultivation ultimately resemble those of Grand Ancestor Long Boxing. They all involve constantly enhancing theoretical knowledge and practical experience until reaching the pinnacle.
I hope that #PlayerName# can begin with the Great Ancestor Long Fist.\nContinuously train martial arts to advance in cultivation.
I hope one day you'll truly surpass me, becoming a hero who can stand on your own and strike fear into the hearts of the martial world. That would make all my efforts worthwhile.
I wonder why #TargetInteractName# suddenly made a bet.\nIt turns out it was a taunt to motivate me to work hard on my cultivation!
Well, however it turns out, I Gu Younian accept my loss.\nToo bad this secret technique will end up being wasted on #PlayerName#.\nNext!
This is... the "Essence of Sword Control" manual?

Not bad. Our sect is renowned for its sword techniques in Bashu, and the Sect Leader is even feared for his Faint Shadow Chaotic Sword.\nIf #PlayerName# were to fully master the Great Ancestor Long Fist, outsiders might laugh their heads off when they see it.
This "Essential Sword" is the foundation of Sword. Study it well. Once mastered, you may advance to our higher-level martial arts, such as "Linked Ring Sword" and "Meteor Strike Sword Art."
Thanks, Senior Brother! I will study it carefully and not waste your efforts.
Actions speak louder than words, exactly.February 15thApproaching, our school will hold its annualClan Tournament。
When the big competition comes around, if you've made no progress at all, don't blame me for showing no mercy on the arena and beating you until you cry for your parents!
Uh... hahaha, no need to flatter me. I'll start practicing right away, right away...
(It seems I need to diligently cultivate this Grand Ancestral Long Fist to the tenth level before I can February 15th Sect Grand Competition Go ahead and really make a name for yourself!）
#PlayerName# you've been part of the sect for months already. Are you getting used to living on this mountain?
Report to #TargetInteractName#, though this mountain is somewhat isolated from the world,\nBut the beauty lies in its scenic charm and fragrant flowers and birdsong.
To practice martial arts and heed the earnest teachings of Master in such a serene place,\nIt is precisely what the apprentice has long desired.
Haha, while the Xianxia Sect may be located in a remote area, it's not entirely cut off from the world.
Free time permitting, let Senior Brother take you to Jiangling City nearby for a stroll. It will broaden your horizons.
You've probably met your few senior brothers and sisters already, have you gotten along with them?
Met met, Yang Sichi Senior Brother entered the door around the same time as me, so we often spar together.
Senior Brother Gu Younian and Sister Jiang Wan are the most kind to me, and they take particularly good care of me in everyday life.
Scen Tui, Senior Brother, and Sister Yu Caiwei have exceptionally high martial talent and often guide me in practicing martial arts.\nJust Big Senior Brother Wei Xuhua……
Haha, what's wrong with Xu Hua? He was the one who mocked you mercilessly and did his best to undermine you!
#TargetInteractName#, I may be unskilled, and Big Senior Brother also hates to see iron that doesn't become steel.……
Ah, Master naturally understands Xu Hua's temperament \nHe grew up orphaned and became a disciple of the Xianxia Sect from a young age, showing unwavering loyalty to his own sect.

Though as the Big Senior Brother, Xu Hua's personality is not particularly steady, he instead comes across as rebellious and unruly.\nBut he isn't without virtue, and certainly not a villain.——Otherwise, my master would have cleaned house long ago.
Just this tendency to be cynical and hurt people with one's words-my mentor has criticized me for it many times.\nWhile empires can be transformed, one's nature resists change.
So you don't need to worry about what Xu Hua said; just focus on practicing your skills.\nGiven time, once he achieves martial prowess, he will look at you with new eyes.
Yes, disciple will not fail #TargetInteractName#'s expectations!
Hmhm, you have potential \nMaster, I've noticed since you came up the mountain that you've lacked a suitable weapon, so you've had to practice with a wooden sword.
My senior brother Gu Younian used this iron sword when he first joined our sect.\nThough not particularly sharp, it suits beginners well. You can take it and use it first.
Just remember, a gentleman harbors talent and waits for the right moment to act.\nDo not use this sword for unlawful acts or reckless fighting.
Haha, my disciple finally has his own sword too!\nThank you, master. I'll go try my skills right away!
Hey, today you managed to wake up without sleeping in, #PlayerName#.
Recently, after listening to Master's teachings, I have resolved to work hard on my cultivation!
#PlayerName# wants to train hard? That's like the sun rising in the west.\nYou don't have the temperament to hold out for long; before you know it, you'll start dabbling again.
I've made up my mind, #TargetInteractName#, why are you still mocking me here?
Hmph. In the Jianghu, the road is long and hearts are treacherous.\nIf you can't handle a few barbs and taunts, it's best to go home early!

Harsh criticism doesn't bother me, but as Big Senior Brother #TargetInteractName#,\nWhy don't you recall the brotherhood among fellow disciples and constantly make life difficult for this outer gate disciple?
Not bad. As fellow members of the Xianxia Sect, our seniority bonds are indeed genuine.\nBut in the Jianghu, conflicts are perilous and ever-changing, with no room for emotions or loyalties.

Senior Brother, I fear that you will one day experience the true bloodshed and slaughter, life-and-death combat.\nIf you want to back out at the last minute and drag the Xianxia Sect down, that wouldn't be very wise, would it?

So I advise you to give up sooner rather than later. Senior Brother, I'd be happy to help plead your case with Master.\nLet Master give you more travel money to send you on your way down the mountain.

Go to the foot of the mountain and buy a few acres of land to be a leisurely farmer. Spend your days weeding and feeding the cows.\nAt least it's better than ending up nowhere in the Jianghu and dying a mysterious death, right?
As I have joined the Xianxia Sect, I naturally stand alongside my Senior Brothers and Fellow Brothers, never shirking in battle!\nBetter to die at someone's hands than to survive by compromising!

Haha, I didn't expect #PlayerName# to have a bit of backbone.\nUnfortunately, in this Jianghu, only strength matters, not honor!\nAnd if disaster truly does strike one day, don't count on my helping you even if you stay.
Hmph, don't bother with that!
Drank hundreds of chimes of golden waves……Drunk, I wield my sword at the void.……\nFoot root play dodging and intersecting combat……A loud roar dyed heaven and earth red……
#TargetInteractName#, good mood indeed, composing poems here!
Oh, it's #PlayerName#!\nThis is the mantra for a sword technique. I just ran through it in my mind and mused for a long while before losing concentration.
Could this really be the chant for a sword technique? I can't make it out at all.

You see this first line: Thirsty, drink hundreds of chimes of golden waves.
This first move raises the sword to face front like lifting a glass.
This opening move is indeed a timing opportunity, combining attack and defense.
The Eight Immortals' sword technique has a move called Waist Probe for Wine Offer, which is similarly ingenious.

The second line reads: Drunkenly, he wields his sword at the void.
Then there is a sword technique where the sword is raised and stabbed upward.
After the sword was thrust out, the central gate was left wide open,
Therefore, the sword technique should carry three parts of intoxication, reserving it for a counterattack. Hence, this is a feint.

In the third sentence, foot root playfully dances in combat, this phrase is quite difficult to comprehend.\nIt seems to require a fickle, unrestrained footwork to complement the sword techniques, thus controlling the distance from the enemy.

The fourth phrase: a long howl turns heaven and earth red.
This move extends the sword's reach for a long-distance strike, sharp as a piercing scream.
When the sky turns red, this sword will always draw blood.
Thus, this final move is a killing blow within kills!

Got it!\nI never expected that a seven-character jueju could contain such complex sword techniques!\n#TargetInteractName# has such profound martial arts cultivation; in the future, I will rely on you for more guidance.
#PlayerName#, you're giving me too much credit. My insights are hardly worth mentioning in front of true martial arts masters!
But martial arts exchange knows no size\n#PlayerName#, if you encounter any difficulties while training, feel free to come ask me.
Thank you for your help, #TargetInteractName#

It's okay, it's okay……\nI need to carefully study this third step in the Root Play Step Method for Dry and Moisture Combat.\nYou must overlap your feet, with the heel of one foot against the ball of the other, making your steps scattered yet orderly. This will confuse your opponent and give you an advantage.……
I won't bother you then, #TargetInteractName#. I'll take my leave.

If one cannot control the distance well, it will be hard to generate power, and one will not be able to catch the opponent off guard.\nUsing this fourth secret technique would significantly weaken its power.……\nIf the first strike misses, how should the follow-up move connect?……
Ah, #PlayerName#, you're still here. Is there anything you need?
Oh, nothing to do. Goodbye, goodbye.

(swaying and humming)\nOh!……Face aligned. Heart sharp and clever. Eyebrows long, eyes extending to the hairline.\nNosy and small-mouthed, with a neck as pure as jade and hair like clouds. Eyebrows carved like blades.……
Oh wow~Good morning, #PlayerName#\nThe weather today is quite pleasant. Why don't we descend the mountain together and head to Jiangling City to listen to a few small tunes for some merriment!
#TargetInteractName# is joking around again \nWhile Master specifically instructed them to diligently practice within the temple these days and not venture down the mountain casually.
Aiyah, just sneak down the mountain!\nMaster is too busy to notice
No no, Senior Brother, you should go by yourself.\nIf Master discovers that I have been slacking off again, he will likely punish me severely once more.
#PlayerName# how can you be like your Junior Disciple Si Chi, day after day just practicing cultivation. Don't you fear that you might get bored to death?
Drunk today, drunk today; life is short, so enjoy it to the fullest.\nYou see, Senior Brother, I may seem laid-back, but my martial arts cultivation hasn't fallen behind much.

#TargetInteractName# has progressed rapidly; naturally, he has time for such trivialities as cockfighting and dog-racing.\nMy foundation with Senior Brother Yang is still shallow; we must study and practice more diligently.
Sigh, forget it, fussing over details, no use trying to carve rotten wood.\nSenior Brother, I'll take my leave first. Off to have a good time!~
By the way, #PlayerName#, don't go telling Master on me!
Not at all, have a nice day.#TargetInteractName#……
#TargetInteractName#, it's been a few days, but you're still captivating as ever.
Just because you're so talkative, does that mean you've caused trouble again and are asking me to plead with Master on your behalf?
No, no, I was just expressing my feelings. #TargetInteractName#, you must not think too little of me.

Haha, since you and Si Chi began your training, Master has had plenty on his hands taking care of both of you.\nYou should also train hard and learn martial arts to help your sect alleviate its burdens sooner.
Yes~Yes~#TargetInteractName#, relax,\nThe heavy responsibility of reviving our sect falls on {#$PlayerName#}'s shoulder!
Yet so talkative!\n……As the cold air on Tianshan mountain has been biting these days, how can you still be wearing just this single-layered robe?\nIf we fall ill, how can we revive the Xianxia Sect?
I fetched this thick coat from the granary yesterday. You should put it on first.\nIn Si Chi's place, I'll go find one for him too.
Thanks, #TargetInteractName#. You're still the best to me.~\nMother's loving hands sew clothes for her wandering son.
What merciful mother's thread could age me so!\nAre you saying then that your master and senior brother haven't been good to you?
Oh, they are good too \nBut still, #TargetInteractName# falls short in warmth and attentiveness compared to a gentle spring breeze.
So practice your skills well in consideration of Senior Sister's face.\nDon't make Master angry again, okay?~
Yes, don't worry, senior.
Let the breath sink to the lower abdomen… Hah!… Swing the fist with a bow stance… Ah!\nLet the breath sink to the lower abdomen… Hah!… Swing the fist with a bow stance… Ah!
Let the breath sink to the lower abdomen… Hah!… Swing the fist with a bow stance… Ah!\nLet the breath sink to the lower abdomen… Hah!… Swing the fist with a bow stance… Ah!
#TargetInteractName# is practicing again!\nJust this fist technique seems a bit simple-just the bow stance and straight punch?

Oh no, #PlayerName#, you see, once this technique gets too complicated, I can't remember it at all.\nWhile correcting, they had to devise a strategy, perfecting each move over several days repeatedly. This way, it would be harder to forget them.
This bow step rushing fist from the Great Ancestor Long Fist, I have been practicing it for several days.\nFeel like I've got it pretty much down, believe me and watch my hand!
Sink the qi and thrust the punch…Wow!…Lunge to gather qi…Ha!\nSink the qi and thrust the punch…Wow!…Lunge to gather qi…Ha!
Hehe, not bad at all, right!……Huh, something doesn't feel right……
Ah, it seems to be about sinking the breath into the dan tian, with a bow stance and a charging punch.……
Done and done, with this mushbrain of mine, these few days of practice were basically in vain.\nWell, when it comes to quick thinking and meticulous consideration, #PlayerName# far outpaces me.
If you have the time in the future, #PlayerName#, please guide me.\nIf I'm doing anything wrong, just point it out! Don't hold back on the criticism!
Oh well, alright then \nJust that I'm not very skilled either, #TargetInteractName#, don't have too high expectations.
#PlayerName#'s advice truly cleared up my confusion. Thank you very much.
Hi~It's only proper for fellow disciples to help each other; there's no need to be polite.
But as I repeatedly practiced this fist technique, I began to develop a strange sense of how to generate power.
Oh? What's the feeling like? You might as well say it.
Sigh……A few words cannot possibly explain it clearly.\nWhen striking, you need to apply the strength from your waist and abdomen along with the qi energy from your dantian.
Focusing all his thoughts on the power in his punches, he could ignore everything around him and release the force from a single point.\nSo delivering a punch would be five times stronger than usual.

Isn't this exactly what Master often says about aligning one's mind and intent, intent and energy, and energy with strength? Makes sense!\nIt seems that #TargetInteractName# may have a poor memory, but his comprehension is quite good.
Hehe, I don't know my own strength yet?\n#PlayerName# doesn't mind if I'm a bit slow as my senior brother, that's all right.
If you have time in the future, I still need to trouble you, #PlayerName#, for more guidance. Thank you in advance!

No problem no problem. We both started at about the same time, so we can consider each other tough competitors.\nLearning from each other and advancing together \nOne day, we'll have to earn Master and senior brothers' respect!

Hahaha, really? That's great! Then I need to practice hard right away!\nLet the breath sink to the lower abdomen… Hah!… Swing the fist with a bow stance… Ah!\nLet the breath sink to the lower abdomen… Hah!… Swing the fist with a bow stance… Ah!
Ah, I never expected there to be such a dilapidated sect hidden in the depths of these mountains!
Haha, such a tiny little sect \nStill dare to call yourselves the Xianxia Sect, Xian, Xian. Truly, truly, a source of endless amusement.
I see not even a single brave soul to challenge in this sect; calling it the Putrid Shrimp Sect would be more fitting!
Haha, #TargetInteractName#, your words are splendid!\nFrom today on, this Fresh Shrimp Faction will be renamed the Rotten Shrimp Faction!
Where did you, daredevils, get off talking trash at the entrance of our Xianxia Sect?

(With a few quick, clean Sword strikes, you finish off the follower.)\nPiece of cake.
(With one swift Sword stroke, he cuts down the leader as well.)\nHeh. Not bad, #PlayerName#.
Hehe. I'm still a long way from Senior Brother.
(Several consecutive Sword strikes are deflected by the follower.)\nDamn! He's about to call for help!
(He cuts down the leader, turns, and pierces the follower with a single Sword strike.)\nTch. How can you be this useless? I still have to clean up after you.
Uh... hehehe. I'm not in great form today. Please forgive me, Senior Brother...
Enough chatter. The main tent is right ahead.\nLet's listen from the side and gather intelligence. That's what matters.
Wait a moment, Senior Brother. Let me hide the bodies first.
Right. Nearly forgot. I'll help you move them...
Sect Leader Xia, forgive me! I attacked Baling Village and captured Gu Younian.\nI did everything I could, and I lost many brothers in the process.
Your disciple Gongsun Fang was killed only because Xianxia Sect had superior numbers,\ncaught us off guard, and even had government troops supporting them...
Oh? Chief Xiong, are you implying that my side failed to provide enough support?

I wouldn't dare! Sect Leader Xia sent two outstanding disciples to support us, and I am deeply grateful.\nIt was simply... man proposes, Heaven disposes. Please accept my condolences, Sect Leader Xia.
Di Kun!
D-d-d-disciple is here!
Chief Xiong tells me that when the battle turned against you and Senior Brother Gongsun was killed,\nyou were the first to turn and run... Is that true?
M-M-Master... Master, spare me!\nD-d-disciple saw the government troops arrive and p-panicked...
What damned government troops?! I've already investigated it.\nWhere would Jiang Yingquan suddenly find that many soldiers? They were Baling villagers in disguise!\nYou useless trash!
Huh? B-b-but... disciple c-c-couldn't tell at the time!\nMaster, m-mercy! Mercy!
By Gang rules, I should have you torn limb from limb.\nBut we're short of men right now, so I'll spare your worthless life for the moment!
T-thank you, Master! Thank you!
You may escape death... but punishment is unavoidable.
M-Master?
Ugh!\n(A palm strike slams into his chest. He screams, spits out a mouthful of blood, and collapses unconscious.)
Drag him away! Anyone in Iron Palm Gang who dares flee from battle will share his fate!\nWhen that happens, don't blame me, Xia Tianxiong, for showing no mercy!
(Several Iron Palm disciples, their legs trembling, hurriedly carry the unconscious Di Kun away.\nXiong Baisheng stands nearby in terrified silence, wiping sweat from his old face.)
Hehehe. Chief Xiong, my disciple has embarrassed himself in front of you!
S-S-Sect Leader Xia is too modest.\nIron Palm Gang is filled with experts and mighty fighters.\nIt was only a momentary mistake that let those Xianxia brats gain an advantage.
Besides, we also gravely wounded Jiang Yingquan's prized disciple, Gu Younian.\nThe man is practically crippled now, barely different from dead. It wasn't a complete loss.

Hmph! I, Xia Tianxiong, have roamed the Jianghu for years. When have I ever suffered such humiliation?\nAnd you, Chief Xiong—your newly built stronghold was destroyed, many brothers were lost,\nand now you're forced to scrape by in this remote place.

Sigh, it's all because of those Xianxia Sect dogs!\nThe blood debts of my Second and Third Chiefs, and the four brothers Jackal, Wolf, Tiger, and Leopard, must be repaid!\nSect Leader Xia, please uphold justice for us!
There is an excellent opportunity before us.\nNext year... when... feign an attack on... Baling Village... while together... Xianxia Sect Headquarters...
Ahem. This matter is too important.\nWe should find somewhere away from prying eyes another day and discuss it in detail, Chief Xiong.
For now, Chief Xiong must continue recruiting men and preparing for war.\nWhen the time comes, we will uproot Xianxia Sect completely and leave no one alive!
Hahahaha! Sect Leader Xia is brilliant and unmatched in strategy.\nIf the two of us work together, how could Xianxia Sect survive, or Jiang Yingquan escape death? Hahahaha!
Hahahaha! Chief Xiong, as a token of sincerity, I brought several Iron Palm Gang Manuals.\nHave your brothers study them carefully. Their Martial Arts will surely improve greatly.
Sect Leader Xia has shown Black Wind Stronghold immeasurable kindness. Please accept my bow!\nI, Xiong Baisheng, and the dozens of brothers under me will give our lives to repay your grace!
Hahahaha! You're too polite, Chief Xiong. Drink!
Drink! Drink!
(As you listen closely, a sudden commotion erupts behind you in the stronghold.\nIt seems they've noticed two patrolmen are missing and are now searching everywhere.)
(Whispering) Senior Brother, they've noticed something. We shouldn't stay here any longer.
(Whispering) Wait here. I still have something to do...\n(Before the words are finished, he activates his Movement Art and vanishes into the night.)
(Whispering) Senior Brother! ...Where did he go...?

(After waiting roughly the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, shouts and screams echo through the stronghold.\nFires begin rising everywhere, smoke fills the sky, and cries to put out the flames continue without end.)
Bad. Several footsteps are approaching. Looks like they've found us.\nNo matter. I'll catch them off guard!
Just a few petty bandits—nothing worth mentioning. I'm more worried they'll keep coming until there are too many to handle.
Why hasn't Senior Brother come back yet...
Damn. These bandits have some skill. I won't be able to hold out much longer.
Why hasn't Senior Brother come back yet...
(Several cold flashes suddenly cut through the darkness, followed by a series of screams.\nThe noisy footsteps of the bandits gradually fade until everything falls silent.)
What are you standing around for, #PlayerName#!
Aah! You scared me to death, Senior Brother Wei!\nWhew~ I thought the bandits had found me.\nWhy did you cause such a huge commotion?
Hmph! Hearing those bandits talk about Junior Brother Gu made my blood boil.\nI went and set a few fires and killed a few of them to vent my anger.
But Xia Tianxiong's Martial Arts are formidable. The two of us probably aren't his match yet.\nLet's get out before he realizes what's happening!
Alright. Let's withdraw!
Also, I found a Blade Manual on one of the bandits just now.\nIt's useless to me. #PlayerName#, take it and have a look.
Then... thank you, Senior Brother.
What is there to thank me for? Stop fussing. Let's go!
Master, #PlayerName# and I have finished scouting Black Wind Stronghold and returned.
Good. Did you uncover anything useful?
Yes. Xiong Baisheng truly is colluding with Xia Tianxiong of Iron Palm Gang.\nThey seem to be plotting something major.

From the fragments we overheard,\nIron Palm Gang plans to feign an attack on Baling Village sometime next year,\nwhile its main force joins Black Wind Stronghold to strike our Sect Headquarters directly!
That Xia Tianxiong is bold indeed.\nHe actually dares bypass Baling Village and attack our heavily defended Sect Headquarters directly!
I believe the plan is dangerous,\nbut if they really feign an attack on Baling Village, considering what happened before,\nwe would certainly send our elites there to defend it.
Our Headquarters would then be poorly defended. If Iron Palm Gang and Black Wind Stronghold combined their forces,\nthey could indeed overwhelm us with numbers and catch us completely unprepared.
Mm. Xuhua is right. If our Sect Headquarters fell,\nat best we'd suffer terrible casualties; at worst, a century of foundations could be destroyed...
Seen that way, the plan is risky but offers a great reward.\nIt does sound like something Xia Tianxiong would devise.

Then for the time being, you must strengthen patrols and defenses around our Sect Headquarters.\nKeep watch on Black Wind Stronghold and Iron Palm Gang as well, and remain prepared for an enemy attack.
Yes, Master!
You two have worked hard and uncovered intelligence of great importance to our Sect.\nTake this Silver as your Master's reward.
As the Senior Brother, it is my duty to ease the Sect's burdens.\n#PlayerName# contributed greatly to this mission. Give him my share as well.
Hehe, thank you, Master and Senior Brother...\nHuh? Senior Brother, how did you get hurt?
A minor flesh wound. Nothing worth mentioning.\nYour disciple will take his leave and return to training.
Alright... Sigh. Xuhua still likes to act tough.
Senior Brother leads from the front and sets an example.\nI need to work hard and catch up too.
#PlayerName#, what are you doing lounging around here? Something terrible has happened!
What?! Iron Palm Gang attacked again?
No, no! It's Senior Brother Shen!\nMaster discovered that he secretly learned Iron Palm Gang Martial Arts and is about to punish him severely!
Come with me quickly. We have to persuade Master to spare Senior Brother Shen this once!
Oh... Senior Brother Shen secretly learned Iron Palm Gang Martial Arts?\nI... may have heard something about that.
Come on. Let's go persuade Master together.
Tui'er, I have never treated you poorly, and I allow you to study most of our Sect's Martial Arts.\nWhy must you insist on learning Iron Palm Gang techniques?
Master, Iron Palm Gang's Martial Arts share the same origins as ours.\nDuring the battle at Baling Village, I saw how fierce and domineering their methods were and became curious...
Hmph! The Jianghu is vast. Of all the Martial Arts you could be curious about, why theirs?

It is normally a good thing for Xianxia Sect disciples to study other Sects' Martial Arts and learn from their strengths.\nBut Iron Palm Gang killed Senior Brother Wei, occupied Baling Village, and bears a blood feud with our Sect.
Instead of properly studying our own Martial Arts, you chose to practice Iron Palm techniques.\nDoesn't that raise our enemy's prestige while diminishing our own?
What if you set a bad example for your Junior Brothers and Sisters and they all start learning Iron Palm Martial Arts too?\nWe might as well rename Xianxia Sect the 'Little Iron Palm Gang'!
Master! I only wanted to understand what makes Iron Palm Gang's Martial Arts special!\nOnly by knowing ourselves and the enemy can we win every battle, right?
If temporary prejudice and hatred make us give up opportunities to improve our Martial Arts,\nwhen will we ever retake Baling Village and avenge Senior Brother Wei?

Insolent! You still dare mention Senior Brother Wei?\nHe was only just killed by the very Iron Palm Martial Arts you're practicing—have you forgotten?\nA gentleman seeks wealth by proper means. The same is true of Martial Arts: improving yourself doesn't mean you should learn everything indiscriminately.

If you later obtained some sinister art of Five Poisons Sect or Yama Palace,\nwould you learn that too just to improve your Martial Arts?\nAre you not afraid I would expel you from the Sect when the time comes?

Even putting that aside, if you truly insisted on learning Iron Palm Martial Arts,\nhad you reported it beforehand and sincerely asked permission, I might have allowed it.\nActing first and asking later shows no respect for me as Sect Leader or for Xianxia Sect's rules!
Master! Tui'er was momentarily led astray. Please calm your anger!
Yes, Master. Senior Brother Shen meant well but handled it badly. He is still utterly loyal to our Sect.\nPlease give him a lighter punishment!
It's rare to see Senior Brother Shen take Martial Arts so seriously, even if what he's practicing belongs to Iron Palm Gang...\nAh, did I say the wrong thing...?
None of you need to plead for me.\nI, Shen Tui, will take responsibility for my own actions. I accept the punishment!
Fine. Since you still understand your mistake and haven't caused a disaster yet,\nI sentence you to one month of secluded reflection on the rear mountain!
For this entire month, you are not to leave the rear mountain without my permission. Do you understand?
Thank you, Master! I'll pack my bedding and go to the rear mountain to reflect at once.
Hmph. Go!
Tui'er, the rear mountain is cold and miserable. It's no place for a person to stay.\nCome with me and ask Master again. If his heart softens, he may let you off.

Senior Sister Jiang, I brought this upon myself. I broke Sect rules and should be punished.\nI simply refuse to accept that Xianxia Sect disciples should be forbidden from learning Iron Palm Gang Martial Arts.
To improve my Martial Arts and take revenge, even techniques from Five Poisons Sect or Yama Palace might be worth learning!\nMaster is simply bound by old ways and refuses to change!
What are you saying? Do you have a death wish?!\nFine, fine! I won't care about you either. Go to the rear mountain and fend for yourself! (She turns and leaves.)
Sigh, Senior Brother Shen... why make things harder for yourself?
Things have already come to this, Shen Tui. Endure one month on the rear mountain.\nBy Sect rules, Master has already shown you considerable leniency.

I don't think he was truly furious. He only wants you to calm down on the rear mountain.\nStop drifting around and dividing your attention. Properly mastering our Sect's Martial Arts is the right path.
...Senior Brothers, Junior Brothers... farewell. I'm going to the rear mountain now.
Wait! I brought you bedding and winter clothes.\nIf you catch a chill, a heartless fool like you might freeze to death up there!
And I made some dry rations and brought wine...\nSenior Brother Shen, take care.
...Senior Sister, Junior Sister... farewell.
Sigh. Junior Brother Shen is all hard words and stubborn pride.\nLetting the rear mountain wear down his temper might actually be good for him.
I just hope Senior Brother Shen doesn't hold a grudge against Master over this...
Hmph! He caused this himself, and he still dares resent Master?\nHe should have been sent to the rear mountain to cool his head long ago!
Alright, alright. We'll keep eating and drinking well while he fends for himself!
Senior Sister Jiang has a sharp tongue but a soft heart.\nI'll bet that within three days she'll be delivering food to the rear mountain.
Stop! You're one of the Five Ghosts of the Underworld?\nYou dare run wild in Flying Dragon Sect territory? I'll see you arrested and brought to justice!
I hear all the great Sects under Heaven have placed bounties on the Five Ghosts of the Underworld.\nCapture this man and we'll enjoy wealth and honor for the rest of our lives!
Heh. I'm afraid you'll have the life to earn that money, but not the life to spend it.
I am Gao Shou—and 'Gao Shou' means expert!\nThough I, Gao Shou, rank last among the Five Ghosts of the Underworld, my Martial Arts rank first!
Two fists cannot defeat four hands. Everyone attack together, and we'll split the bounty afterward!
Wait!\n(He throws out both hands. His clothes swell as if inflated, and a cloud of white mist sprays out.)
Manifesting True Qi? His Internal Art has reached a terrifying level. We can't underestimate him.
I'm in a good mood today and don't feel like killing anyone.\nIf you know what's good for you, leave your valuables and I'll spare your lives!
Hmph. So what if you know some Internal Art?\nWe'll take turns wearing you down. Let's see how long you last! Attack!
Wait!\n(He sneers twice, bends down, and picks up a stone.)
(He rubs it between his fingers a few times,\nand the entire stone is ground into powder that drifts to the ground.)
T-this... that strength, that Hard Skill...\nTerrifying!

Don't panic. This villain may cultivate both Internal and External Arts, but he doesn't seem to know any refined techniques.\nIf we surround him from all sides, we can defeat him through superior technique!
That's true. For a lifetime of wealth and comfort, why not risk a fight with this villain?
Wait!\n(He sneers again, suddenly flicks his sleeve, and a small Sword flies from his robe.)
(With each wave of his arm, the tiny Sword twists and loops through the air,\nthen flies straight back into the villain's hand as if it had eyes of its own!)
Sword Control!!! Great King, spare me! Spare me! I was blind and failed to recognize Mount Tai!\n(He repeatedly kowtows, throws his weapons and valuables to the ground, then turns and runs.)
Ahem... Your Martial Arts are supreme. I admit defeat.\n(He bows, drops his weapons and valuables, and stumbles away.)
H-hey, everyone! ...Why am I the only one left? Great King, mercy!\n(Throwing down his valuables as he flees in panic,\nhe trips over his own Sword and falls flat on his back.)
Ohohohoho! I, Gao Shou, am invincible under Heaven!\n(Once the others are far away, he hurriedly bends down to collect their weapons and valuables.)
You dog! Are you one of those Five Ghosts of the Underworld?\nSecond Brother, Third Brother—today is our Flying Dragon Three Heroes' chance to make our names!
Damn it, more nuisances...\nAhem. I am Gao Shou—and 'Gao Shou' means expert!\nThough I rank last among the Five Ghosts of the Underworld, my Martial Arts rank first!
Last in rank, but first in Martial Arts? Who are you trying to fool?\nBig Brother, Second Brother, let's surround him and capture the villain.
Wait!\n(He throws out both hands again. His clothes swell as if inflated, spraying a cloud of white mist.)
The bounty! My bounty! Give me my bounty!\n(He slashes with his Blade. The villain fails to dodge and his clothes tear open,\nrevealing a hidden leather bellows that drops out.)
Wait, wait, wait! Where did this reckless idiot come from?
Well, look at that. He hid a bellows under his clothes to pretend his True Qi was overflowing!\nBrothers, don't let him bluff you. Let's capture him together!
Playing tricks and deceiving people? Villain, take my Sword!
Ow, ow! You brat—just you wait!
Thief, dare to misbehave! Feel my powerful punch!
Ow, ow, what a naughty boy! Wait for me!
Dare to break my Invincible Golden Body and ruin my plans? You guys are in for it!\n( Finished speaking, he reached into his pocket and threw something with all his strength. )
Cough cough, lime powder!……\nThis little thief may not be particularly skilled in martial arts, but he's full of tricks.……Cough cough cough cough
Cough cough, the three brothers have met again. Why are you all here?
Cough cough, you've had to step in and help again, #PlayerName#.\nWe three brothers just joined the Flying Dragon Sect; aren't we now serving in the bureaucracy?
It's said that this High Chief ranks fifth among the Black Dao Five Ghosts, but he is also a major fugitive hunted by both the court and the Wulin.\nSo we came here to hunt down this thief.

Ah, being a servant for the government might sound appealing, but it's actually quite a tough job.\nWe small patrol officers don't have much in the way of benefits and are constantly running around like mules, always being summoned.
If we can apprehend and bring this individual to justice, it would indeed be a significant achievement.\nThen we three brothers will finally have a chance to prosper and rise in status!
Senior Brother, Third Brother, stop talking. The thief is nearly gone; the cooked duck will fly away.\nLet's hurry and catch up!
Okay! Let's continue to chase them.\nIf you spot the thief's whereabouts, send a message pigeon to #PlayerName#. We'll split the reward then!
No problem, go chase after them quickly
Hehe, though these three boys are silly, they do understand the advantages of being an official.\nShould I also go to the government offices to look for a job?……
I am Gao Shou, the expert is me!\nAlthough I rank last among the Five Evils in the underworld hierarchy, my martial arts skill is number one.
Hmph, so-called High Chief? I think he's more of a master at blowing his own trumpet!\nWatch your palm!
Wait!\n(Sweeping his hands, the clothes around him inflated like balloons and sprayed out a lot of white mist.)
Strong neigong! Now I've attracted some serious competition.……
Brother don't panic; with my Flying Dragon Long Spear on guard, fear not the bandits' measly neigong.
Wait!\n(Sneered for a moment, bent down to pick up a stone from the ground)
(Fingers gently rubbed a couple of times,\nThe entire stone was crushed into powder, drifting down onto the ground.)
A true empty-hand rock-breaking skill-such solid internal power takes at least two to thirty years of practice.……

Do not worry, my desert witch have roamed beyond the passes for over a dozen years; I've seen it all.\nThis battle will be my primary attack. We'll strike from three sides, and no matter how hard his internal strength is, he'll be at a disadvantage!
Wait!\n(Two cold laughs echoed as he suddenly swept his sleeve, and a small sword flew out from his chest.)
(Associated with the swinging of his arm, the small sword traced a sinuous path through the air, looping and weaving,\nIt then flew straight back into the enemies' hands as if it had eyes!)
Using my breath to control the sword, sorry to interrupt, goodbye!\n(He leaps back and swiftly escapes)
Little one knows not how to behave, offending the Great Hero-pardon me, pardon me!\nI'll take my leave then! (turns and staggers off in a hurry)
Ah ah ah\n(turning around, he fell flat on his back and scrambled along the ground)
One running slowest, die!
Help!……(Glancing up to see white eyes, he fainted dead away)
Hahaahaha! I'm Highhead, unconquerable across the land!\n(Hurriedly bent down to search for the dying man's possessions)
Huh……Hey……Finally caught up, you son of a bitch, stand still for me!
Truly, you three guys won't give up, huh?
What else do you want to say?\nIsn't it time to fire up the jet pack, then polish the stone, and then fly with the sword again?
Less talk, bring me the bounty, and get to work!
Three brothers, let me join in to catch the thief.
You must bring you in this time, thief! Feel my sword!
Ouch, ouch, hold on just a moment!
Huh? Who's behind you?\n……Pong!
Ouch, ouch, hold on just a moment!
Well, is there anything else to say?\nYour tricks are nothing new to Mountain Person.
Using blowers to spray air, making fake rocks out of flour dough, and swinging wooden swords on silk threads back and forth.\nAh, what other tricks do you have up your sleeve?
Haha, you've damaged my divine skills, but I still have a trump card!\nFourth Brother, why did you just arrive now?
Little Fifth, little Fifth, Senior Brother told you not to go around bragging and cheating, but you didn't listen.\nYou're in trouble now, I see
Hehe, Fourth Brother, it's these few brats who've pushed me into this state.\nYou'd better give them a good lesson today.
These guys? Hmph! Their martial arts are merely average. I even brought some brothers along.\nYou're going to have to make up for the travel expenses and the hardship fee.
Brother Four, rest assured and accept these silver coins first.\nMy lord, I've recently acquired quite a few good items. I'll present them to you shortly.
Hmph, I'll give you that
You little punks, dare to touch my Brother Wei Wuwei?\nDo you know that our Five Ghosts in the underworld have a bond as strong as gold? We share life and death together!\nSubordinates, kill!
The newcomer is Black-Clan Four Fiends Yue Wowe, this man's martial arts are harsh and ruthless.\nThree brothers, be more careful
#PlayerName#, don't panic \nLi Dali, Wang Cai, let's show our newly formed Chain of Three Tribulations array and eliminate these bandits right here, fellow brothers!
Brother Guo? How did you also end up here!

Several of you need not worry; word has reached us that the Five Ghosts of the underworld are causing chaos here.\nI, the small hero Guo Yongrui from Central China, come to capture the thief together!
Thief, where do you think you're going this time!
Ah, Brother Four save me!
Today with all five of us working together, even the Shaolin Abbot couldn't save you!
Haha, I knew it!\nThis trickster definitely isn't #PlayerName#'s match
Thief, where do you think you're going this time!
Ah, Brother Four save me!
Damnit, there are more soldiers around. It's not fun to keep fighting now.\nBrother, seek your own blessings! You guys, withdraw!
Fourth Brother, Fourth Brother, don't leave me alone!……\nWoo woo woo woo,#$PlayerName# Great Hero, spare this humble one, please.\nThe little one dares not brag or cheat anymore.
Hmph, you're begging for mercy now? Too late!
Just like that, Wu Mou, Wang Cai \nTie this boy up tight and take him to the authorities for questioning!
#PlayerName#, Brother Guo Yongrui, I thank you both for your help this time.\nThough our three brothers using the Linked Three Tribulations Formation could also easily capture the thief.……
Triple Encircling Continuous Tribulation Array? It sounds very formidable.\nWhen Gu brothers have some free time, you must teach me.
Haha, this one is quite profound, Brother Guo. You might not be able to learn it.

调用函数: AddWorldNews;传闻中原小侠郭勇锐，将已修炼至陆地神仙境界的高首一举擒获。\n江湖中人皆惊骇不已，认为其功力已与其父郭淮大侠不相上下。
内容: Well, with my skills, the Dragon Taming Palm technique isn't something I struggle with either, Brother.\nBut for now, the top priority is to chase and capture Old Fourth, Yue Woweiyu, who just ran away.
According to my father, Yue Wuxie has committed numerous evil deeds and killed countless people.\nIt is much more difficult to deal with than those who are showing off and deceiving.
If he is allowed to get away with it, how many more civilians will be harmed?\nSo this scroll will have to be entrusted to the three brothers for safekeeping.
No problem at all. After our three brothers claim the bounty,\nFly the pigeon to invite the two of you so we can split it evenly.
No no, my father specifically told me,\nDealing with evil cannot be done solely for the reward; otherwise, one tarnishes the spirit of chivalry.
Split my bounty among yourselves. Goodbye!
Haha, then I'm afraid I've inconvenienced Xiao Xiaoguo.\nSenior Brother, let's head to claim the reward for the prisoners as soon as possible, hehehe.……
Several brothers, I do need my share of the reward. You can't keep it all for yourselves!
Oh, #PlayerName#, don't worry \nA gentleman loves wealth but acquires it with righteousness. We brothers are not the kind to forsake integrity for profit!
We'll take this guy to the authorities first to verify his identity.\nOn the day of your reward, a homing pigeon will be sent to notify you, #PlayerName#.
No problem at all, fellows, farewell!
#PlayerName# finally made it, hurry up \nHeard we caught one of the Five Evils from the underworld? A big shot is going to meet us in person and reward us!
Oh, is there such a good thing? Who exactly is this important person? Let me hear about it.

He is said to be one of the Four Great Censors of the current court, Lin Nongying, the Commander.\nThey say she hails from Mount Emei, with a sword technique so sharp and unparalleled that evil-doers can't help but pale at the sight.
Alright, alright, the Brother can't wait any longer. Go claim your reward!
Was it you guys who captured one of the Black Society's Five Ghosts, Gao Shou?

Haha, though this person's martial arts are poor, they make up for it with numerous cunning schemes.\nAfter roving about and committing fraud, he also committed many crimes.\nSeveral Young Heroes have eliminated a menace from the Wulin this time!
To rid the people of harm is within my duty, General Lin, so there's no need for such politeness.……
Haha, Commander Lin, when can our brothers' rewards be arranged?

Huh, you're kind of anxious \nSect Leader Zhuge has informed me that the upper-level martial arts treatises of Flying Dragon Sect are available for selection.\nOf course, if you wish to convert it into silver coins, that is also fine.

I desire the secret techniques, and I also desire silver coins.\nHowever, as three brothers and disciples of the Flying Dragon Sect, we are also officials in the government.\nTo right wrongs and help those in need is our duty; we do not seek such mundane rewards!
Younger Brother, what does it mean?\nHard-won reward money, you don't want it?

Don't talk nonsense. As three brothers, we just want a better job.\nThis way, we can better practice chivalry and righteousness, punishing evil and removing wrongdoing.\nServe the Flying Dragon Sect and the court even better!

Haha, I see. Wu Brother really knows how to use a reckoning rod.\nIn that case, from today onward, each of you will be promoted one rank and become a patrol captain from your previous position as an office clerk.
Though this constable is not a high-ranking official, he still needs to maintain peace in his jurisdiction.\nI hope you all take your duties seriously and don't neglect them.
Haha, detective? You must be doing well now!

Brother Two, don't speak recklessly! Thank Captain Lin!\nWe three brothers must work diligently and fulfill our duties faithfully.\nLive up to the Flying Dragon Sect and the imperial court's high expectations.

选项: Choose a potion;ChooseGaoShouBounty;0|Receive reward silver 1000 taels;ChooseGaoShouBounty;1
内容: That's best \nSo, #PlayerName#, what reward would you like to choose?
Very well. I hope you can continue to strive and keep eliminating evil from the Wulin.\nI still need to gather these stolen items and evidence; I'll proceed for now. Goodbye everyone.
Commander Lin, take your time~
Commander Lin, take your time~
Haha, Senior Brother Second Brother, now that the three of us are chief constables, we've really made it!
Hmph, hmph, hmph. Our three brothers rose from the wilderness and are finally in official positions now.\nIt's truly a bright future ahead, things are looking up!
We must also thank #PlayerName# for your invaluable help!\nIn the future, #PlayerName#, if you encounter any difficulties, feel free to come find Brothers; we will definitely do our utmost to help!
Good for you three brothers. Congratulations!\n(Isn't he just a small police officer? Why do these three seem as thrilled as if they've won the top prize in the imperial examination?……）
Senior Brother Third Brother, since we've already become constables,\nDon't go around the countryside showing off and intimidating people, right?
Brother Two said it's true. Shall we go then?
Walk ahead!
Brother Guo, Brother Wang, are you two also coming to the Young Heroes Conference?
Haha, of course \nThis Hero Youth Conference lacks the valor of Guo Yongrui from Central Plain's Little Hero. How can it claim to be truly heroic!

Co-Brother's confidence andswagger are simply irresistible!\nI'm quite different; I spend my days practicing and doing odd jobs in the sect, finding it very boring.\nJust wanted to check out the latest developments and have some fun with everyone.

Oh, I see \nBrother Wang's skills may not match mine, but he is still one of the premier figures among young martial artists in the Jianghu.\nThis youth hero conference will surely astonish all who attend and establish their fame in one battle!

Haha, thanks to Brother Guo!\nThis youth hero assembly, Brother Guo, you're definitely the top contender. I'll settle for second place to make things a bit more challenging.\n#PlayerName#, just play the third option for now. Does that work?
Ohaha ahahaha ha, very well! Brother Wang, please!
Brother Guo, please!
(These two just bickering back and forth is one thing, but why did they start taking it seriously?……）\nCough cough, you two young heroes, let's get inside quickly. The meeting is about to start.

Hehe, Senior Sister Jiang is really great. Pure in heart and refined like orchids, selfless and public-spirited.\nThis is the time you're still thinking of your senior and junior brothers.
Hm, if you want to repay my kindness, go back and practice your martial arts well.\nRise to your own challenges and stop keeping your master worried!
Senior Sister, rest assured. I #$PlayerName# will have my revenge one day.\nWe will retake Baling Village and repay the blood debt for Big Senior Brother!
Pft! With your serious expression, Senior Sister nearly fell for it too.
Alright alright, it's getting late. I still need to head back to the Sect to cook dinner.\nYou shouldn't waste time either. Go back sooner rather than later.~
Uh-huh, Senior Apprentice Sister, take your time
Senior Brother Ku! You sent me a message by pigeon to Baling Village. What great plan do you have for me?
Shh! Keep it down, this is currently Iron Palm Gang territory in Baling Village.\nWe need to be cautious and avoid drawing attention.
These scoundrels, we must reclaim Baling Village one day!
Why can't I want it as much as you do?\nBut Big Senior Brother is currently missing, and we are few in number and weak.\nWe must bide our time for now and plan for the future.
Getting back to the point, my younger sister and I just came up with a plan.\nNot only can we weaken the Iron Palm Gang's strength, but we can also take this opportunity to avenge Big Senior Brother!
Too bad Vi and Wen'er have other plans and are too busy to spare time for this.\nOnly trouble you, #PlayerName#!
Of course I deserve a share of such good fortune!\nSenior Brother Gu, go ahead and tell me your plans.
Good! I've been scouting around Baling Village for dozens of days already.\nDuring the rotation of guards, there is a short period when only one person patrols around Baling Village.
This person is the direct disciple of the Iron Palm Gang, Lu Qi!
Lu Qi?……Oh, that sneaky fellow!\nLast time in the battle at Baling Village, this guy kept leering at Little Junior Sister.\nStill dare to call yourself the Iron Palm Quartet!
#PlayerName#, don't talk about it. Just thinking about it makes me feel sick.……\nAnd this guy is also responsible for Senior Brother Wei's blood debt!
So Senior Brother Ku's intention is to want to take advantage of when he is patrolling alone.\nShall we work together to catch this little thief?
Not quite. Although only he patrolled the outer perimeter of Baling Village,\nBut within the village, there are still Elders of the Iron Palm Gang and many disciples who remain stationed there.

If we engage in combat with him on the perimeter, we are likely to attract attention with our fighting cries.\nIf we accidentally alert the guards in the village, it would be like trying to steal a chicken and ending up losing a rice sack.
Ah, I never expected the Iron Palm Gang's defenses to be so tightly woven and interlocking.\nDon't we have no way to deal with this then?
So we need to come up with a way to lure this guy to a secluded place before we can make our move.\nSo this time, Little Junior Sister has to be sacrificed.……
Ah? What does Senior Brother Gu mean? Not likely, right?……
No way! Absolutely not!
Oh, junior sister, just tease that guy for a moment, and you'll definitely confuse him beyond recognition!\nMoreover, with #PlayerName# and me guarding you from the shadows, you are surely safe.
You just need to lead that guy into our ambush.\nWith the three of us acting together, we're sure to bring that rogue to justice!
Me me me, every time I see that guy, I want to vomit. How do I flirt with him!?\nWhat if, in the end, I can't control myself and stab with my sword-won't that be it!
For our Xianxia Sect, little junior sister, you'll have to bear with it just this once!
