内容: (Eyes reddened, on the verge of crying, could only turn and look at you)\n#PlayerName#……You also want me to go?……
Ah, Little Junior Sister,\nFor the Xianxia Sect and to avenge Big Senior Brother, I have to ask for your forbearance this once.
#PlayerName#……Since you say so too, then I will.……
Sigh……Little Junior Sister,\nIf you're really not willing, let's just drop it.
I reconsidered and forced you for the sake of the sect's interests.\nIt's really forcing someone to do something against their will, which goes against the spirit of chivalry.
Junior Sister, if you don't want to go, just stay here.\nWho dares to force you? I object first!

Senior Brother Gu, if we are doing this for the sake of our sect's greater interests,\nIsn't forcing the little junior sister to do such unwilling things any different from those dog thieves of the Iron Palm Gang?
Erm……Haha, #PlayerName#, this teaches me that I was too careless.
I acted too hastily to avenge Big Senior Brother and neglected Little Junior Sister's feelings.\nLittle Junior Sister, I apologize to you!
Senior Brother Gu……#PlayerName#……Thank you……
I've got it straightened out! #PlayerName#, Senior Brother Gu, I'm going!
These past years, I have always been well cared for by Master and my senior brothers.\nBut I never thought I would have to stand alone and alleviate everyone's worries.
Now comes a rare opportunity for me to pitch in.\nBut he still wants to hide behind everyone like a child.……\nIt's really unacceptable!
So I decided: I'm going!\nI shall certainly charm that little thief and lead him into the senior brother's ambush!
Little Junior Sister……
Little Junior Sister……
You two, what are you still standing there for? Didn't you just be making grand vows not long ago?\nLet's not waste time; let's get our preparations in order quickly.
(In the entrance of Baling Village, Iron Palm Gang disciple Lu Qi is scolding a dirty and disheveled old laborer.\nHe walked with a haughty stance, resembling a noble official. )
Hey, old thing, hurry up and load these supplies onto the cart!\nA lazybones, dare to play tricks on Little Master in front of me?
If Master doesn't return from his patrol and the move hasn't been finished, you're going to get whipped!
(The old street performer hastily bowed and quickly picked up the items.\nLu Qi spat on the ground and slowly walked towards the village exit.)
Haha, at least we've finally taken over Baling Village for the Iron Palm Gang.\nI have to show these obstinate commoners some discipline and proper conduct!
Sang a little country tune, ya know? Wah-la nga lang……What a mess……\nEyebrows like emerald feathers~Skin like snow-white frosting~Waist like bound silk~Teeth like shell-like~

Oh, patrolling alone is truly unbearable \nThis Baling Village is filled with country girls who are shabby and plain, lacking in any charm.\nAfter finishing this watch, I need to hurry to Chengdu City to find some fun.……
Huh, it seems like there's a beautiful lady gracefully walking in the distance.\nLet me take a look!
(Picking flowers by the roadside while humming a tune)\nCyan cyan your collar, afar my heart yearns.……Who is it?
Ah, are you the Young Miss of the Xianxia Sect?\nNot seeing you for a few days feels like it's been three autumns!\nEsteemed friend, I bow to you~
You! You're from the Iron Palm Gang.……Land Strange Hero?
Ah, what a courtesy from such a beauty to still remember my humble name.\nTruly, it was a blessing in three lifetimes to die for such a cause!
(smiling coquettishly, batting eyelashes) Haha, don't be so tongue-in-cheek.\nYour Iron Palm Gang has deep-seated enmity with our Xianxia Sect.\nHurry up and go! Don't let anyone find out.
Ah, if it's because of this sect's hatred, it has prevented me from enjoying true love with you.\nWhy should I be a direct disciple of the Iron Palm Gang? Better not!

Ah, Young Hero Lu, don't say such things recklessly.……\nAs one of the Iron Palm Quartet, your martial arts are formidable, and your future is limitless.\nHow could that be…For such a mere scrap like me to forsake such promising prospects!
Young Miss! With a wife like this, what else does a husband seek!\nFor you, I would not even want the position of an emperor.\nMoreover, what use is the hollow fame of the Iron Palm Quartet!
Erm……Young Miss, why do you look so queasy?\nIs your body feeling uncomfortable?
(Hurriedly put on a smile) Oh, the battle with Baling Village in the past...\nYoung Lord Lu, you exude an imposing presence and possess extraordinary skills, earning my heartfelt admiration.
After returning home, I thought of you day and night, and my worries eventually turned into illness.\nLike catching a chill, he suddenly felt unwell in his stomach and wanted to vomit.……
(hardly slapped himself)\nWhat virtue do I, Lu Qi, have to make such a beauty fall ill for me!\nI deserve death a thousand times! I deserve death a thousand times!
Hehe, beauty, I just happen to be skilled in medicine.\nHow about I come over to rub your stomach and help heal your injuries with some exercises?
(hid in the shadows and observed, whispering)\nSenior Brother Gu, I can't listen anymore. Let's move on to the next step quickly.
This guy is really greasy and repulsive \nEven if the little junior sister didn't vomit, she's still nauseated.~I need to throw up first too
(Qiao sheng) Didn't expect that Little Junior Sister has such astonishing acting skills; this guy is already under her spell.\nI think it's about right; we can move on to the next step.
(Saying this, she pouted and mimicked the cooing call of a robin.)
Hearing this, he glanced at where they were hiding and instantly understood.\nThis this this, how can Young Hero Lu do that!\nI didn't expect you to be such a cad!
(one sight of Lin Yunshang feigning anger, he immediately turned pale with shock)\nBeauty! I have acted rashly! Please accept my apologies, beauty; I hope you are not angry.

Young Lord Lu, as a man and woman, we should not touch or pass things to each other.\nAdd to that, with so many people around Baling Village, it's easy for others to notice.\nIf it were seen by outsiders, it would be hard to explain.
(She said and turned to leave, her robe flowing behind her, leaving only a fragrant breeze in her wake)
Pretty lady! Where are you going?
(I turn around, cover my face with a shy smile) I know there's a secluded place around here.\nIf you truly wish to, come with me to share your heart.……\n(then quickly departed)
Young Miss! Even if it means ascending a mountain of knives and descending into a pot of boiling oil, this scholar would never wrinkle a single brow!\nOh beauty, wait for me, wait for me……
(Lu Qi follows Lin Yunshang's steps and rushes to the location you both agreed upon.\nThis place is beside a cliff, desolate and quiet, with not a soul in sight.)
Beautiful lady! Beautiful lady? Where are you going? Stop playing with poor me!\nI am constantly thinking of you and cannot sleep or eat because of you.……
(Hiding in the woods, barely visible.) Really? I don't believe it.……
Hundred percent genuine!\n(Single finger pointing skyward) May I fall to my death from this cliff if I speak falsely!
Oh no, Young Hero Lu, don't make random oaths!\nIf anything were to happen to you, I would also feel heartache.……\n(The expression gradually distorts)
Wife! Wife, I do not seek to be born on the same day as you, but only to die on the same day as you!\nI hope, Lady, you will come out quickly to meet your humble student!

Just……The young lady is still a bit afraid.……\nYoung Lord Lu, you are after all a disciple of the Iron Palm Gang, and you possess formidable martial arts skills.\nIf you dare to do such inappropriate things to this lady,……
How could this be! I, Lu Qi, am not someone who would ruin the elegance with reckless actions!\nHow must I entice you to come out and see me?
Unless……Unless Young Lord Lu throws his weapons over.\nLeave it to this lady to keep
After all, a mere woman like me has no strength to lift a chicken, unlike Young Lord Lu who is skilled in martial arts.\nEven without weapons, there's nothing to be worried about.
Oh, what should I say? This is nothing difficult.\n(Drew his weapon and threw it in the direction of the sound immediately)\nFair lady, watch out; you might get hit!
(The weapon vanished like a clay ox thrown into the sea, leaving no trace in the forest.\nThe forest fell silent, with only the rustling of leaves in the wind.)
Beauty, fair lady? I have already sheathed my weapons. Why don't you come out to meet me?
(Hearing rustling sounds from the other side of the woods)
Hehe, beauty, were you playing hide and seek with Little Lord?\nInteresting interesting, don't let me catch you though!~
(Creeping quietly to the sound of rustling bushes and making a sudden leap)\nBeauty~I'm here!
Young Hero, I'm coming too!
Ouch! By the grandmother's sake, you little stinker from the Xianxia Sect?\nWhere is my beauty?
Pretty much, my lady is right here!
Beauty, how would you……How could you say such vicious words?\nDidn't you just have deep feelings for me not long ago?
That was just lies to deceive you; it's really disgusting.\nHearing this, we'll all live three years shorter. Are you prepared to pay with your life!
I don't believe it! She must have been coerced by you all!\nFair lady, do not fret; once I rescue you, we can share our hearts again!

(Lu Qi was without weapons and was constantly at a disadvantage to the three of you, falling behind after just a few moves.\nYou waited for the right moment and struck quickly, stabbing him several times in the back.)
Dog thief, can you even dream of having my junior sister? Die!
Hey, hero spare me! Hero spare me! I won't dare again!
Hmph, too scared to?\nIt's too late for regrets now
Fortunately, #PlayerName# is here to hold down the fort.\nThis time, you must pay for your big senior brother's death.
(Though Lu Qi initially held the upper hand, he gradually grew weary under your three-way skirmish.\nFinally, Lin Yunshang caught the right moment and swiftly stabbed several swords into his back.)
Dog thief, come back to Big Senior Brother for your punishment! Look, sword!
Ah, beauty, how could you be so heartless!
Lu Qi, it's now your last moment of despair. Submit and meet your end meekly.
Huh……Huh……Die beneath the flowers, and be a devil who leads a lively life.……
I Lu Qi would die before leaving Lady Meng alone!!!

(That Lu Qi, though injured by a sword at his vital point, was still fighting like a cornered beast, desperate and fierce.\nHe suddenly generated a streak of fierce strength, like an arrow released from a bow, charging towards the Little Junior Sister!)
Oh no!
Junior Sister, be careful!\n(Rushing to stand in front of Lin Yunshang, drawing upon all their inner strength, they pushed out with both palms forcefully!)

(The punch struck his chest suddenly, shattering both his heart and meridians, causing him to cough up a large mouthful of blood instantly,\nThe entire body tumbled down the cliff like a kite string snapped.)
(shouted with all his remaining strength)\nYoung Miss! May we meet again in the next life!
This shameless little thief still dares to think of our little junior sister as he faces his death.……\nRight, Little Junior Sister! Are you okay!
Not…It's fine……\n#PlayerName#, if it weren't for you, I fear I would have met with great misfortune.……
Hi, Little Junior Sister. Why are you being so formal with me?
Just……Lu Qi, still showed devoted affection in his own way.\nHe died because of me, and I can't help but feel somewhat guilty about it.……
This rogue deserves his demise, Little Junior Sister. You need not worry about it.

Exactly, this little thief has committed countless evil deeds and killed our Wei Senior Brother. He deserves to be sliced a thousand times and hacked apart a myriad of times.\nThis death is already merciful to him
Glanced at the cliff, nodded seriously \nHmm, the two senior brothers are correct. With the bandits now slain, we……
(At this moment, suddenly a figure darted out from the trees and blocked your three paths.\nUpon closer inspection, the person turned out to be the Elder of the Iron Palm Gang, Ye Yiming!)
Hmph! I wondered why there was so much noise here. Turns out it's just three little thieves from the Xianxia Sect!
Lu Qi this guy was supposed to be patrolling here, but I have no idea where he ran off to.……\nI'm going to give him a serious beating when I find him!
Speak up! What are the three of you doing here!\nAre you probing the strengths and weaknesses of Baling Village?
(The three of you exchanged glances, at a loss for how to respond.)

Well, I might as well tell you,\nThis Baling Village is guarded by the Iron Palm Gang's top experts on all three inner and outer layers.\nIf your Xianxia Sect hopes to reclaim this place, it's akin to a dreamer talking to themselves!
Elder Ye misunderstood. We came to pay our respects to Senior Brother Wei and are about to leave now.\n(Threw a glance at) #PlayerName#, Little Junior Sister, let's go!

Hold on! Just because you feel like it, doesn't mean you can just leave!\nYou three can just stay and be hostages.\nMmph, with the three of you in hand, I'm not afraid that Old Jang Yiquan won't submit.
I've heard that Ye Yiming of the Iron Palm Gang is merciless and ruthless, and sure enough, he lives up to his reputation.\n#PlayerName#, little junior sister, you go ahead. I'll cover your rear.
Senior Brother Gu, you are badly injured and not yet healed. Let me cover your withdrawal instead!
#PlayerName#, Senior Brother Gu, I'm the least useful. They won't have to do much if they catch me.\nYou go ahead then!
(faux-naively rubbed his eyes)\nBrotherhood runs deep, so touching, so touching \nToo bad-none of them can leave!

(The three of you are struggling to keep up with Ye Yiming with all your might,\nYet the opponent is indeed an Elder of the Iron Palm Gang, with profound powers.\nGu Younian and the Little Junior Sister gradually grew weary and found themselves at a disadvantage.)

I have the strength to deal with this person for now,\nHow could Senior Brother Gu be in such serious condition and still recovering, while Little Junior Sister has yet to attain much strength?\nWe need to come up with a way to get them out of this situation...
Huh……Huh……#PlayerName#, I'm out of strength in my hands now.……
Little Junior Sister, come behind me……
There's a flaw!\n(Speak easy, do quick-palm struck like lightning)
#PlayerName#, be careful!!!\n(He stepped forward and firmly took the blow!)
Junior Sister! Scoundrel! I'll fight you to the death!
(Duck to avoid the several swords stabbed at you)\nHey, what a beautiful lady saving a hero!
Brat, I didn't want to make things difficult either.\nGive in early, and you'll suffer less, right?\n(As soon as the words fell from his mouth, he flashed back towards you.)

(At this critical moment, another figure suddenly appeared in the woods,\nIt's none other than the old servant who was beaten and scolded by Lu Qi earlier!\nHe struck out several sword blows in the blink of an eye, pushing back all of Ye Yiming's offensive moves!)
Ha! Shadowless Random Sword Techniques? Jiang Yingquan?!\n(He turned around and darted towards Baling Village.)
This stinky woman went to get reinforcements, hurry and follow me!
(Lv Renqian navigated the forest with ease, leading all of you to swiftly traverse through it,\nOnly to hear the sounds of battle cries gradually rise from Baling Village behind him. )
(Not stopping until all the cries of battle faded away, you finally came to a halt in a secluded area,\nThe three of them were panting heavily, struggling to catch their breath.)
Look at the three of you. You're so young, yet you're panting after just a short walk.\nNot as good as these old bones!
Lu, Senior Master Lu, your Movement Art is powerful; we certainly can't compare.\nBut how did you, the Elder, end up here, dressed as a menial?
Ah, this is a long story and I can't explain it to you little ones.
Oh, well, okay
Hmm? Why aren't you pressing for more details now? This is the time to get to the bottom of things, isn't it?\nWhy so little curiosity at such a young age!
Ah? Didn't Senior Master say it was unclear to explain?……
Senior Apprentice Brother, Senior Apprentice Brother, what exactly is going on here? You should tell us!
(Sighing and looking off into the distance) Well, Senior Master, it's me...\nOver these many years away from the Xianxia Sect and traveling through the Jianghu, there were always my own reasons.
On the one hand, it's indeed unpleasant to be constantly constrained within the walls.\nOn the other hand, it was also to seek out the lost supreme martial arts of Patriarch Miao Yuan, the Immortal.
Wow, lost world-renowned martial arts from the Ancestral Master?\nIt sounds like quite the formidable skill, but why hasn't our master told us about it before?
(gave a meaningful smile)\nHmph, this is the sect's secret; naturally, you little brats wouldn't know.

Our ancestor Master Miao Yuan, known as the Master of Dual Excellences in Fist and Sword, dominated all of China south of the Yangtze River with few rivals.\nHow did it split into the Xianxia Sect and Iron Palm Gang, making this martial arts ordinary and unsuited for great endeavors?
So your Master guessed as I did that the Ancestral Master passed down her true teachings to her.\nHidden somewhere in the Xianxia Sect, Iron Palm Gang, or Baling Village.
Just these two locations, the Xianxia Sect and the Iron Palm Gang.\nOur two factions have thoroughly searched each other's territories over the years.\nAll came up empty-handed
So during this summer, Xiong naturally set his sights on Baling Village.\nThis is also why the Iron Palm Gang would spare no expense to seize Baling Village.

There are rumors that Summer Hero may have found clues to the lost martial arts technique.\nThat's why they amassed a heavy force here after seizing Baling Village.\nAnd they dug up the ground thoroughly, searching everywhere.

I am not usually within the Xianxia Sect, so that gang of iron palm villains is not very familiar with my appearance.\nThat's why I disguised myself as an old janitor to gather intelligence inside Baling Village.
Senior Master, your solo infiltration of Baling Village is rather dangerous.……
Rest assured, my martial arts are sufficient for self-defense.\nBut the three of you little guys are surprisingly bold.\nDare to intercept and kill Iron Palm Gang disciples near Baling Village!
Let Senior Instructor laugh at me, though this time we did manage to eliminate the minor bandit Lu Qi.\nBut if it weren't for Master's intervention, we might have met with disaster.
Haha, not bad at all \nYou three brats have had Lu Qi spinning around like a top. I saw it all from hiding.\nBrave and strategic, you have quite a bit of my youthful flair!
Alright, enough small talk. Uncle Senior, I need to return and continue gathering intelligence.\nGo back to the Xianxia Sect quickly! Don't let the Iron Palm Gang catch you again!

Hey! Stinking beggar!\nDo you know if this area is part of the Iron Palm Gang's territory?\nHow dare you beg on the street and spoil the scenery here without paying the protection fee!
(Only to see this old beggar with unkempt hair and dirty face, tattered clothes,\nHis hands were severely missing fingers, each having only six digits, tremulously holding a iron bowl.)

Old man, have mercy, I'm an old beggar with hand disabilities. It's hard for me to earn a meal.\nAnd this Yunmeng Township, which is clearly in the Beggars Sect's territory, how did it become the Iron Palm Gang's domain?
A dead flower seller still dare to be stubborn!\nThis Baling Village, for a hundred miles around, will be under the jurisdiction of our Iron Palm Gang from now on.\nRemember this!
Now you have to pay protection money if you beg here in the future. Do you hear me!

Hmph, since you're not completely out of your mind, let's split it fifty-fifty like Sanqi!
Ah? A third, huh?
Thirty percent? Seventy percent!\nSeven to three! Old fool!
You stinky beggar, coming to beg in our territory.\nI didn't ask for it all, so you've already gone as far as courtesy allows!
Old Man, evenbeggar can only get a few copper coins asking for alms for a day.\nGiving away seventy percent really leaves nothing for us to eat!
Damn it, still trying to bargain? Beat him up hard for me!
Old man, spare me! Spare me!
Traitor, stop!
Yohei? Isn't this the stinky brat from the Xianxia Sect?\nHaha, Baling Village is already our territory of the Iron Palm Gang. Move along, before we make you!
Whoever's territory it is,\nYou wreak havoc here, bullying the weak, and I, Yang Sichi, must step in!
Okay! My minions,\nBeat this shortsighted brat harshly first, then scold the old beggar!
Brat, feel my Invincible Iron Palm!
No……Not itching or painful

Brat, take one more hit from me and feel the Dragon Taming Tiger!

Huh……Huh……You little brat, you're pretty tough to beat up; it's making my hand ache.\nWait for Grandpa to catch his breath, and we'll fight again!
Oh Young Hero……
Old man, you shouldn't worry about this matter here. Just go!
Not a young hero, though I'm but a weathered old bone, in my youth I did see my share of the world.\nYour sword technique doesn't seem quite right

Old man, you were right. I've always had a strong temperament, something I can't control.\nSo while the sword moves have plenty of power, they lack dexterity.

Ah, since you naturally have great strength, it's only fitting that you wouldn't understand the Xianxia Sword.\nAs the saying goes, teaching should be tailored to the student. Old Beggar acquired a powerful fist technique a few years ago.\nToday, I will pass it on to you, Young Hero.
Ah? It's too late, it's too late!\nI've been practicing the Great Ancestor Long Fist for ten or more days, and you expect an old man to understand it quickly?
You go first! Don't worry about me; they're going to attack again from the other side!
Brat, come here, let your grandfather give you another lecture!
Old man, why are you still here?\nHurry up and hurry up! I'm tough-skinned, those guys can't do much to me!
Young Hero, don't panic. This fist technique is very simple.\nYou don't need to overthink it; just follow the Senior Beggar's commands and fight with all your might!
Still time for idle chatter?\nWaa ya ya ya ya! Hit with my Black Panther Seize Heart attack!
Young Hero! The bandits are attacking fiercely, and the gate is wide open.\nJust sink your qi to your dantian, focus force in both arms, and attack his center for a direct clash!
Oh? Well, okay then! Ah ah ah ah!
Ouch! What a strength! How did it suddenly get so powerful?
Wow! Old man, it really works!
Well, it's just that a blind cat happened to catch a dead rat.\nAttack again with Monkeys Steal Peaches!
When the attacker strikes your lower body, you should assume a horse stance to dodge.\nThen he swung his fists, one to the left and one to the right, striking the thief's neck!
Okay!\n(Punching with all my strength, both fists like copper hammers, one left and one right,\nHe smashed heavily into Di Kun's temples on both sides!)
Damnit, if that hits me, I won't die but I'll be crippled!\nBut there's no way to avoid it now, so she had to take the hit!\n(Saying this, he gathered all his strength and raised his palm to block!)

(I could hear a loud clang as Di Kun stepped back several paces,\nHe stumbled and staggered, on the verge of fainting.\nLifted his palm to inspect it and found the skin torn and the muscle ruptured, with the muscles and bones nearly snapped!)
Ah! My hand! Oh my hand!
Is this really the punch I threw?\nHow could it have such astonishing power? Elderly man.……
(Turning around, the old beggar was nowhere to be seen.)\nErm…Old person?
How can you disappear and reappear without a trace?\nHard to say, could it be that Lord Land Has Appeared?
Rotten, rotten brat! You dare hurt Grandfather with your bare hands?\nYou won't be going back alive today! Die!!!
Ah, Senior Brother Yang! I finally found you. Why are you fighting with the Iron Palm Gang again?
There's no time to explain, #PlayerName#. Follow me and help repel the enemies first!
Traitor dog, your palms are already disabled. See how you can still be arrogant now!
(Aware of their inability to resist but still clinging to a spark of survival,\nHe pushed several bandits in front of him and then turned to run away!)
Ahh, a gentleman must repay this debt! I'll make you wait!!!\n(disappeared without a trace)
Haha... It still had to be #PlayerName# who pulled it off,...\nSeverely punished this evil bandit!
Dog thief, your palms are disabled now. See if you still dare to collect protection money!
(Aware of their inability to resist but still clinging to a spark of survival,\nHe pushed several bandits in front of him and then turned to run away!)
Ahh, a gentleman must repay this debt! I'll make you wait!!!\n(disappeared without a trace)
Three or four moves dispelled the remaining bandits.\nHmm, finally got rid of those villains
#PlayerName#, once again I owe you my life-thanks so much.……

Don't talk anymore, Senior Brother Yang. A person changes in three days; you should look at me with new eyes!\nWhy has your fist technique suddenly become so powerful? You nearly knocked down even Di Kun!

Oh well, let me tell you, #PlayerName#, I know you won't believe this,\nIt was the land deity of Yunmeng Township who appeared to me and taught me a set of fist techniques.\nIt was only then that justice was served to the thieves.
Haha, Land God has appeared? Even able to descend to the mortal world to meet Queen Mother!\nWell, Yang Sichi, you've learned to keep things for yourself, haven't you?
Thankfully, I saved you so many times before; just wait and see.\nIf I save you again, I'll be a dog!\n(Saying this, he turned and walked away.)
Oh oh oh, #PlayerName#, do you believe me? It's really the Land God showing his presence!
(About to chase after, but then seemed to remember something,\nLook around nervously for a moment before kneeling and pounding his head loudly on the ground.)
Amituofo, Supreme Heaven Sovereign, much thanks to Land God for your protection!\nDisciple will bring some offerings to visit you next time.……
Hey, #PlayerName#! Wait for me!\n(Hastily got up, shook off the dust from my knees, and stumbled after it.……）
Little Junior Sister, what are you rummaging through all the boxes for here?
#PlayerName#! Alas, it's all because our sect has been hit by a series of misfortunes recently.\nI see everyone looking dejected and lackluster one by one.
These days, my cooking skills have also improved a bit.\nSo you want to cook up a few more delicious dishes to boost everyone's spirits, right?
Haha, I see. #TargetInteractName# is just struggling to find good ingredients again, right?
#PlayerName# really knows me \nThis time, I want to try challenging some high-difficulty dishes.\nTherefore, one must find Premium-grade ingredients As a raw material only
Junior Sister, rest assured. I #$PlayerName# have walked the Jianghu for so many years,\nI've come across hundreds of high-quality ingredients; I'll definitely find one for you!
Then……I must ask #PlayerName# one more time \nThis time, let me taste the food first, #PlayerName#.
Deal!
#PlayerName# have you found the high-quality ingredients I need?
Haha, I'll take care of #$PlayerName#. Junior Sister, is there anything else you're worried about?\nWhat is this?
Ah, this is it! Thanks, #PlayerName#!\nI'll go make some delicious dishes and let you taste them first, #PlayerName#.
Look at how anxious you are. Go ahead, go.
(After a moment)
Mission complete!

Wow, it's been a few days. I didn't expect your cooking skills, Little Junior Sister, to have improved so much!\nYou should hurry and serve it hot to Master and the senior brothers and fellow disciples.
Haha, #PlayerName# really went overboard!\nI still have some practice dishes left over. If you don't mind, #PlayerName#, why not accept them?
No complaints, no complaints, junior sister. Just bring as much as you have, and I'll eat it all up!
Ah, so many times already, why are you still not tired of it?\nSlow down, don't overdo it, #PlayerName#
#PlayerName#, you've arrived just in time. Have you received my pigeon post?
Received received, look at you getting so anxious.\nSenior Yu, why have you started thinking about seeking out powerful cultivators again?

Since my last trip to Wudang where I received guidance from a master, my cultivation has made great strides for some time.\nUnfortunately, lately I've hit another bottleneck, which is why I'm resorting to old tricks again.
So, this time Senior Sister Yu wants to find which senior or esteemed elder?

I've heard that there's a newly risen merchant guild in the Jiangnan region, called the Changle Gang.\nHis Gang Master Yue Wuji wielded the Jing Le Liu Li knife with impeccable skill; it was clear, exquisite, and flawless.\nCombined with the peerless Agility technique Dreamy Fish Dragon Dance, he moved like a startled swan, agile as a soaring dragon.

When these two supreme techniques are performed together, the dance moves gracefully, as if a fairy has descended from heaven.\nEnraptured and bewildered, as if lost in a misty dream.\nIf I could just see and learn something, even just a technique or two……

Haha, Senior Sister Yu was just joking again.\nThat Changle Gang dominated the Jiangnan region, controlling the shipping and trade along the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal,\nHe is wealthy beyond compare, at the peak of his success.
As Yue Wuji, the Master of Changle Gang, is busy with affairs and manages a thousand matters each day,\nHow would you deign to give us, these two mysterious minor characters, your guidance?

Who cares? I Yu Caiwei always speak after I act.\nI heard that Yue Wuji often appears in Hangzhou to personally oversee the city's waterway business.\nLet's head to Hangzhou and see if we have any luck.
#PlayerName#, you don't have to be so fussy either.\nIf you won't come with me, I'll go alone!

内容: Oh well……
(In Hangzhou city, misty rain veils everything, with vibrant flowers competing in beauty.\nThe market buzzed with noise, voices echoing everywhere, exuding a bustling vitality.)

(You've walked a few steps and arrived at the main street inside the city. The cobblestone path is lined with...\nSeveral dozen stern-faced disciples of the Changle Gang, dressed in fine silk robes, were patrolling back and forth.)
(Around the roads on both sides, many people gathered in three layers inside and out.\nWhispering to each other and eagerly anticipating, as if waiting for some major event to occur.)
Hey, why are so many commoners standing by the roadside? Is there some spectacle worth seeing?
I heard that the Changle Gang is going to hold a flower car procession celebration in Hangzhou City these few days.\nThe Gang Master Yue Wuji might participate personally.
It's said that Yue Wuji has an absolutely stunning appearance, a beauty like a goddess.\nDon't the common people in the city want to catch a glimpse of her beauty?
(Talking, they could hear the crowd stirring \nSomeone shouted in surprise：Here it comes, the flower wagon is here!)

(You look in the direction that person pointed.\nOnly ahead on the road could be seen a grand, ornately decorated three-tiered flower carriage, slowly making its way among the entourage of the Changle Gang.)

(The flower carriage is adorned with gold and jade, decorated with various exotic flowers and precious jewels.\nThe carriages are adorned with exquisite and auspicious patterns, clearly the work of skilled artisans. )

(The flower carriage stopped at a spot, drawing thunderous applause and continuous exclamations of surprise from the spectators on the roadside.\nFor a moment, the entire street seemed to be illuminated with a dazzling array of colors, shimmering and brilliant.)
Wow, it's really the Changle Gang; they've pulled out all the stops!\nJust the silver used for this single flower carriage would keep our Xianxia Sect going for a whole year.
Haha, why are you dissatisfied with our sect being poor, #PlayerName#?
Hehe, Senior Sister, your words ring true: a foreign nest is never as good as one's own den.……
I find these flashy decorations rather unremarkable and vulgar. They merely deceive merchants and common folk.\nOnly by trying can we know if Yue Wuji has the genuine stuff!
Hey Senior Sister Yu! This is Changle Gang's territory. Don't cause any trouble here!

(Not long after, these three tiers of flower wagons drove in front of you.\nOnly on the second level of the flower carriage, a circle of handsomely dressed and strikingly beautiful young men and women stood around.)

(They would occasionally gently run their fingers over the strings, producing delicate echoes, and at other times wave their feather fans, stirring waves of fragrant breezes.\nHe would toss flowers and pastries to the audience in all directions, causing a stir of cheers and excitement.)

(Above the third tier of the flower wagon, stood a young maiden dressed in brocade and silk, clad in a red robe.\nFace like the bright moon, skin as smooth as cream, eyes deep as autumn waters, brows resting like distant mountains; in every furrow and smile, there is indeed the charm to bewitch a nation.)

(You could see the woman frequently bowing and smiling as she waved to those around her,\nThe spectators were so captivated that they momentarily forgot to compete for the pastries being thrown from the carriage.)
Wow! It's so beautiful!……\nIs this the Sect Master Yue Wuji of Changle Gang?\nWhy so young? You don't look like it at all.……
Hmph! You're eyeing me like this-have you never seen a beautiful lady before?\nFrom looking at Yue Wuji's appearance, she's about on par with Master Sister Jiang and our little junior sister.
Oh well, speaking of that, Senior Sister Yu still holds a slight advantage over her.……
Senior Sister Yu? Senior Sister Yu?! Hey, what are you doing, Senior Sister Yu!

(Suddenly activating lightness skills, he shot up from the crowd, drawing a chorus of astonished shouts from onlookers!\nThen he leaped up, gracefully landing on the third tier of the flower carriage and caught sight of the woman.)
(Eyeballing Yu Caiwei standing right in front of him, she shows no signs of panic, merely giving a calm smile)\nMiss has great lightness!
I just wonder why you've come up to disturb our Changle Gang's flower cart parade?\nA disciple of either the Shenji Sect or Sword Forging Villa……
May I ask, are you Yue Wuji, the Sect Master of Changle Gang?

(Dazzling starlight flickered in her eyes as she smiled and covered her mouth,\nTrue beauty, like a flower half-opened with dew just beginning to condense, is both reserved and charming.)\nOh, Miss, you don't recognize our Sect Leader?
I am Yun Caiyi, the adopted daughter of Gang Leader Yun.\nShe has other matters to attend to, so she asked me to participate in the flower truck parade in her place.
Pity, pity. But since you are her foster daughter, you should know a few exquisite techniques.\nI specially came here today to exchange ideas and techniques with you. Please step forward!

(Witnessing Yu Caiwei draw her weapon, the surrounding spectators let out another round of exclamations.\nThe disciples of Changle Gang around him reacted immediately and drew their weapons, surrounding him.\nAbout to climb onto the flower car and take down this troublemaker!)

(Lei gently waves their hand, dismissing everyone else.) Changle Gang disciples step down.\nThis little girl means no harm, and besides, she has exceptional talent, making her a promising martial arts prospect.

Today being such a joyous occasion, letting the hometown folks enjoy a good play and feast their eyes is not without its merits.\nMiss, let's leave it at that. You'd better be careful and don't hurt yourself.

(In the flutter of her skirt, she surprisingly pulled out a gleaming silver curved blade thinner than a butterfly's wing from somewhere.\nShe then gracefully bowed and struck a pose, truly as if she was always ready to dance elegantly.)

(The audience below erupted with another round of exclamations of approval and astonishment, all extending their necks and tiptoeing to get a better view.\nAfter all, who doesn't want to see the legendary martial arts prowess of the Changle Gang!)

(As can be seen on the flower carriage, Yu Caiwei's long sword flows like a practiced artist, resembling a meteor chasing the moon, with her ingenious techniques appearing one after another,\nYun Caiyi's curved blade moved like the moon, dancing freely as swiftly as a raging wind sweeping clouds.)

(Between their swift movements, the flashing blades and intertwining swords formed a picturesque dance, like two fairy maidens dancing on a flower-covered carriage.\nThe clash of sword and blade rang out clear and sweet, as if accompanying the two in a melody.)
(Watchers gaped in amazement or held their breath, afraid of missing such a breathtaking dance.\nEvery time the two girls employed their clever tricks, applause and cheers echoed incessantly.)

(In the blink of an eye, the two exchanged dozens of blows,\nYu Caiwei, despite her efforts, had shallow cultivation and gradually found herself struggling for breath. It seemed she was about to retreat.\nYun Caiyi also gradually slowed down her speed.)
(Murmuring softly) Miss, this is our sect's ultimate skill. You've seen it now.\nBut you are still young to possess such power; your future prospects are limitless.
(Softly) If you want to learn this martial arts, why not join our Changle Gang, and I can teach you myself, okay?
Sect Leader Yun, thank you for sparing me!\nJust that I am already a disciple of the Xianxia Sect; I can only accept your kindness in my heart.
Pity, pity. If you change your mind, come to Changle Gang to find me.\nWe shall meet again, Miss!
(Saying this, he didn't wait for Yu Caiwei's response and swung his blade, creating a gust of wind.\nHe lifted Yu Caiwei and slowly lowered her from the flower carriage.)

(The crowd erupted in thunderous cheers as Yun Caiyi's victory became apparent.：Long live Sect Master Yun! Long live Sect Master Yun!\nCloudy Yi smiled and waved at everyone, then winked at Yu Caiwei and you.\nThen they rode off in a flower-covered carriage for a long distance.……）
(The spectators nearby also bustled about, following the flower carriage as it slowly moved away,\nHere at last peace has returned, leaving only scattered petals and pastries on the ground.)

Senior Master Yu! Are you trying to die?!\nFortunately, the Leader of the Changle Gang is magnanimous and shows restraint in everything.\nOtherwise, I'll have to chop you off the flower cart with one swipe!
(Pondering, he picked up a pastry from the ground.\nShake off the dust and take a casual bite.)
Mmm, delicious, with a scent of osmanthus\n(puts the remaining half in front of #PlayerName#) Would you like to try a bite too?
Oh, Senior Sister, it's so late, you're still thinking about snacks.\nLet's hurry and run! Don't let that group of Changle Gang catch us and beat us up!
You're making a big deal out of nothing, it's fine, really.\nThe one on the flower car is Deputy Leader Yun Caiyi of the Changle Gang; she had no intention of making things difficult for me.
Oh, that's good……\nBut Senior Sishixi, you really shouldn't be so reckless in the future. You might anger someone by accident.……
This is nothing; those seniors have very proficient nourishing qi skills and won't take notice of us.

Right, speaking of which, did you see that Cloud Clothing's lightness technique?\nTruly, as rumored in the Jianghu, graceful like a startled swan, agile like a soaring dragon.\nI have been reflecting on this since just now, and already have a faint understanding.
(She then proceeded to detail the key principles of Yun Caiyi's martial arts moves, each word being a precious gem and completely accurate.)
Sister Senior Yu, did you learn all of this in such a short time just now?\nA bit too fast, right?……
So what? If I can manage a few more moves,\nI might have figured out the steps to Dream Drunken Fish and Dragon Dance entirely, which is truly a pity.
(took the remaining half of the pastry and put it in his mouth, then bent down to pick up a few more pieces)\nTake some back for Auntie Jiang and Little Junior Sister to taste.
#PlayerName#, I need to return to the Sect to practice my skills first.\nYou shouldn't linger in Hangzhou for too long either, in case you miss your chance again.
Alright, alright, Senior Sister, take your time\n(Speaking of being distracted, I'm more worried about you.……）
Senior Brother Gu! Why are you in such a hurry? Is there some major event happening?
#PlayerName#!I was looking for you!\nHasten to gather your weapons; follow me to Baling Village. Urgent!
Ah ah ah? What's going on?
It's Lu Renqian, Uncle Master Lu!\nWasn't he previously posing as a menial worker to gather intelligence in Baling Village?\nMaybe we revealed our position by saving ourselves!
Right now, he is in Baling Village and being hunted by the Iron Palm Gang!\nMaster has already gone ahead to meet us.
Oh, we need to hurry over there as well! Let's go!\nWe cannot let Uncle suffer the same fate as Big Senior Brother at the hands of the Iron Palm Gang!
(Baling Village, several hours ago……）
Sect Leader! You truly have foresight like a god.\nThe disciples dug three feet into the ground throughout Baling Village and indeed found a cellar!
The walls of the cellar seem to bear the ancestor master's precepts.\nPlease hurry and come over to take a look!
Haha, just as I expected \nThe martial arts lost by the ancestor master seems to have truly been found by me, Xia Tianxiong. Let's go!

(The two quickly walked to the village center, where they found a stark entrance to a dark underground cellar.\nAnother Elder of the Iron Palm Gang, Ye Yiming, has been standing by to greet them for some time.)
Congratulations, Gang Master! Congratulations, Sect Master!\nThis Baling Village has really unearthed a cellar! Truly heaven favors our Iron Palm Gang!
HA HA, too bad those Xianxia Sect thugs,\nLiving here for so many years, yet I never knew the good things were right under my nose.

Hmph, they simply do not know \nThis Great Senior Miao Yuan Immortal inscribed her final teachings on two stone walls before her death.\nOne is located at the rear mountain of the Xianxia Sect, while the other is in the cellar of Baling Village.
Since Baling Village was then my Iron Palm Gang's territory,...\nSo this move by the Senior Patriarch can be seen as leaving a precept for both factions to uphold, thereby demonstrating fairness.

But I never expected the small thieves of the Xianxia Sect to launch a surprise attack and seize Baling Village while our sect was weak.\nThus this cellar was buried in the dust of history and gradually forgotten by people.
Only after I spent the summer translating hundreds of historical texts on the Tripitaka did I uncover the slightest clue to this cellar.\nOnly then could it see the light of day!
Sect Leader is wise! Your elderly wisdom and strategizing skills truly stand unmatched in the Jianghu!\nJust……Subordinates still have one matter unclear
Since there is also a precept in the rear mountain of the Xianxia Sect,\nWhy don't we see the Xianxia Sect disciples who have mastered their ancestor's true teachings?

This Rear Mountain of Xianxia Sect, I and the former Sect Leaders have sneaked in to investigate secretly.\nThe cave was located in a remote area, and with the damp air, the stone wall inscribed with the warnings had long since weathered and deteriorated.
'The only words that can be clearly seen on the stone wall are fen.…Agreed…Defeat…Wang…Just four words'
These four words are already familiar to all of you disciples.\nDidn't we previously speculate that the full meaning was split before combining, defeat turns the vanquished into victor?

Not quite. When I explored that cave again later,...\nDiscovering that the remaining four characters were carved using Xianxia Sect's sword technique.\nSo the marks are sharp and profound, not fully weathered away.
And the other four characters were carved out using our Iron Palm Gang palm technique.\nThe traces are relatively wider and shallower, making them difficult to discern after weathering.
Sigh, using the Xianxia Sect sword technique and the Iron Palm Gang finger method to carve words on a stone wall,\nOnly Grandma Senior Master could possibly wield such power.
These four additional characters, if carved using the Iron Palm Gang's technique,\nEven if it is weathered and corroded, the Gang Master's cultivation might still be able to recognize it.
Not bad. I carefully felt around the stone wall and confirmed these additional four characters.\nCombined they form Divided, we fall; united, we rule！
Divided they fall, united they rule?
Not bad Divided, we fall; united, we rule。
The patriarch's intention is to teach us how to collaborate and work together with the Xianxia Sect for mutual benefit?\nBut why would she split us into two factions? Isn't that going a bit too far?
At first, I had my doubts, but after discovering the secret of Baling Village's cellar, I was startled to realize,\nThe elder master's precepts may have been deliberately split into two parts.

To merge the precepts of the Xianxia Sect with those in this dungeon,\nOnly then can one truly learn her martial arts techniques, which is the true meaning of divide and both lose, unite and become a king!
No wonder the Sect Leader is so obsessed with Baling Village, willing to spare no expense to take control of this place.\nIt was for the other half of the ancestor's precept in this cellar!
Haha, Senior Patriarch is unparalleled in the world with her dual expertise in fist techniques and swordsmanship.\nTo obtain her true lineage's secret skills would be worth any price!
Why wait? Gang Master, lead us down to show us around!

Not now. This cellar is hidden so well that it might contain the shocking secrets of the Iron Palm Gang and Xianxia Sect.\nI will go down alone to take a look, while the other two remain outside with the disciples.
But Gang Leader!……Would it be dangerous for you to go down alone?
Haha, Elder Ye, you don't trust even my martial arts?\nJust keep guarding the cave entrance; don't let a single fly in, hear me?!
(somewhat reluctant, but also helpless)\n……Yes, Gang Master
(Summer Hero cast a glance around, then bent down and ducked into the cellar.\nOnly two elders and a group of disciples remained, staring at each other at the entrance to the cellar.)

(About half an hour later, as the guards grew bored and began to doze off,\nSuddenly, heavy footsteps were heard from the entrance of the cave, indicating that someone was climbing up from the cellar.)
Sect Leader! Have you found the True Transmission of the Ancestor Patriarch?
(Face pale as iron, lips tightly closed, not uttering a word)
Sect Leader?
Don't ask anymore!!!

Ye Yiming, go lead a team of elite disciples and completely seal off the entrance to this cellar.\nDay and night guarded; no one is allowed to enter!\nWithout my permission, anyone who dares to approach shall be put to death! Do you hear me!!!
Yes yes yes, Sect Leader, I'll handle it right away, I'll handle it right away.……\n(turning her head, she hurriedly ran off)
Sect Leader……

Han Song……I also know that you have your doubts.\nBut in this cellar, there are no true transmissions of the ancestor master's martial arts.\nRather than hiding something else……This is no trivial matter; it must not be disclosed under any circumstances!
Sect Leader……Subordinate understands!\nSubordinate will swear to guard this cellar entrance with my life and refuse entry to anyone!
I've always trusted your work. Once we exterminate the Xianxia Sect and all is settled,...\nI will reveal the secrets within the cellar to you all, but for now, we must not rush things.……

(Saying this, he looked suspicious and walked towards the branch pavilion of the Iron Palm Gang in the village.\nNot having walked a few steps, he turned back to give an unreassuring reminder.)\nHan Song, do not allow anyone to approach this cellar. Those who violate this order will be executed without mercy. Remember this!
It's the Sect Leader! Subordinate swears by life and death!
(Seems slightly more at ease, but turns his head to continue heading toward the branch headquarters.)
(On the other side, inside the Iron Palm Gang's branch hall in Baling Village,\nA juggler in a headscarf nonchalantly sweeps the corridor outside Summer Hero's bedroom.)

(Saw the Iron Palm Gang's two Elders and most of its disciples drawn over by the new cellar dug at the village entrance,\nWhile correcting, they flashed an eager look and darted into Summer Xiaoxiong's quarters with a quick move.)

(As this man pulled back his headscarf, it was none other than Lu Renqian, who had been posing as a menial worker in Baling Village!\nHe entered Summer Xiong's chambers and began rummaging through everything, searching high and low.)
This damn summer moon, where did you hide the tide rise and waxing moon secret technique?……\nI wonder when those pesky fish will return. I'd better hurry up.
(Searching until reaching the bedside, another round of fumbling ensued before suddenly stopping mid-way.)\nSummer Hero really hid this secret technique under his pillow.……
(on inspection, his face immediately lit up with joy)\nTide Rise, Moon Full, Success! Ha ha!\nIt's truly like finding a needle in a haystack, yet it comes effortlessly.
Since we've got the scroll, it's time to make our exit.\nIf the Iron Palm Gang discovers that their treasure has been stolen, they'll find it hard to leave.
To ensure safety, let me send a message via homing pigeon.\nFind Junior Disciple Jiang to come and meet us, to avoid any unexpected incidents.……
(Just thinking this, suddenly I heard many hurried footsteps coming from afar.\nHe muttered a curse and quickly put on his headscarf before climbing out through the window. )
You guys should take the branch entrance disciples and be responsible for daytime patrols.\nThe others will be responsible for night patrols, accompanied by disciples summoned from the main den.
Remember, without the Gang Master's permission,\nNo one was allowed to approach the cellar entrance, let alone step a single foot inside.\nViolators will be killed without mercy!
(hearing the disciples echo in unison Yes, Elder Ye!, with a sneer on their faces)\nHaste to go! Don't expect me to be merciful if anyone dares to slack off during guard duty!
(A group of Iron Palm Gang disciples consecutively promised and hastily ran off in all directions.\nYe Yiming observed the scene with a satisfied expression, then glanced around the room.)
(Suddenly, a servant in the corner caught Ye Yiming's attention,\nI see this person carrying a pickaxe, hurrying towards the deputy hub entrance.)
(Sigh, just digging up an old cellar. Why the excited reaction?……\nForget it for now. The priority is to steal the High Tide Full Moon Technique, and we'll come back to check this cellar later.)
Wait! You're just a lackey-what are you rushing around for here!
(Trouble, when I saved a few stinkin' boys from the Xianxia Sect before...\nHave I perhaps been discovered by this woman?)
Ye, Elder Ye……This compartment's toilet is clogged, and yellow liquid is almost spilling everywhere.\nI'm in a hurry to go outside and find a tool so I can get back and clear it up quickly.
It must be someone being careless again; they've blocked up the toilet!\nHurry up, hurry up. Fix it quickly before I see it.……
Yes yes, Elder Ye, I'll go right away.\n(letting out a sigh of relief, he quickly turned and ran toward the door)
……Wait!
A drop of cold sweat. Elder Ye, is there anything else you wish to instruct me?
I feel like I've seen you old guy before.……
Hehe, I've been working in Baling Village for some time now and naturally ran into Elder Ye a few times.\nJust figured that we small folk aren't worth your notice, Iguess.
That's true, but the miscellaneous duties within Baling Village call me Steersman.\nHow did you know my last name is Ye and that I hold the position of Elder?
Ah, this I heard mentioned by other Great Heroes of the Iron Palm Gang, so I kept it in mind.\nHow about I call you Captain in the future?
……Sure, go ahead\n(Watching Lu Renqian walk away, his expression gradually turned gloomy.)
(This guy feels somewhat familiar.)\nAnd yet, they remained unfazed by my interrogation and answered fluently.\nDoesn't seem like just ordinary menial work
Moreover, it's better for fewer people to know about this cellar incident at the moment.\nThis old guy must have heard a few words or phrases just now.……
Since it's going to be like this, might as well do it all at once.\nDon't blame me for being ruthless; blame your own bad luck!
Old man, may I ask one more thing? Have you ever heard of the martial arts of our Iron Palm Gang?\nFor example, there's a technique……
Gold Splitting Jade Smashing Palm!!

(Ye Yiming lunged forward with breathtaking speed and struck the servant's back with a swift palm.\nThough the orderly had prepared and dodged to one side, he was still injured by the force of the palm strike.)
Bitch, you're ruthless. Feel my sword!\n(Draw the hidden longsword from the mace handle and strike several blows in succession!)
I didn't expect this yeli to have such extraordinary skills. There was no time to resist properly, and I could only barely avoid the vital points.)\nShadowless Chaos Sword!
(The moment he looked up, the zheyi had already darted away.\nLowered his head to check the injuries, found them not serious, and hurriedly activated lightness to catch up!)
(shout loudly)\nThe Xianxia Sect bandits have infiltrated! Quickly catch that old attendant! Catch that old attendant!
(Hearing Elder Ye's call, the Iron Palm Gang disciples were momentarily taken aback,\nThey hastily drew their weapons and surrounded towards the direction the two were fleeing.)
Damnit, the Iron Palm Gang is surrounding and intercepting us. It looks like we're really going to meet our end in Baling Village.
My old life, losing it wouldn't be so bad,\nBut the key is to find a way to hide this secret technique so that Junior Disciple Jiang and the others can find it.
Dog thief, I wondered why I felt familiar with you-turns out it's the Xianxia Sect!\nYou have nowhere to run now; die quickly!
A stinking old woman biting at me like a mad dog-look, sword!
Others may not recognize you, but I do. Xianxia Sect Lu Renqian!\nThis Baling Village is now well-defended; you must be finding it hard to break free!
Hmph, dared to hurt me; today I shall make you pay back double!\nHere it comes!
Haha, I also have this move!\nLu Renyan, surrender and suffer less!
(Under the assault of the Iron Palm Gang's two Elders, Lu Renqian gradually grew weary,\nFor a moment, his techniques proved inadequate, and he was hit by two palms consecutively!)
(At the same time, a group of Iron Palm Gang disciples arrived here,\nSeizing this opportunity, they surged forward and surrounded Lu Renqian.)
(spit out a large mouthful of blood, heart sinking into despair)\nIt seems today is really going to be the day I give up my spirit here!\nToo bad; it still fell short in the end!
Blast the Iron Palm Gang! Even if I Lu Renqian failed today, I'll take someone down with me!
Who will accompany me down to the Yellow Springs to kill!!!
Senior Brother Lu! Coming coming!\nHow can I help you?……So injured so severely?
Cough cough cough, junior disciple, you have the nerve to ask!\nCome earlier, and I wouldn't have had to worry!
I didn't pause until I received the pigeon message.……\nAlright, Senior Brother. The enemy is strong. Let's retreat and deal with them later!
Map Quan, how long has it been since our fellow brothers fought side by side?\nCough cough cough cough, it's also a pleasure to have a good and thorough fight today!
Senior Brother Lu, stop being so stubborn. I'll protect you as we fight our way back.
Cough cough cough. You little stinkard, do you think you can protect your senior brother? I should be the one protecting you!\nToday, you'll see the power of my senior brother!
Qing Yingquan? Ha ha, you're just in time!\nToday, I'll bring both of you senior brothers down at once! Come on!
Here they come! Master is badly injured!
I am fine, but Senior Master Lu was injured.\nThe Iron Palm Gang has many members and is powerful. You should also be extra cautious!
Protect Uncle Lu, don't let the villains take advantage.
As my respected senior master, do I need to be protected by a bunch of stinking boys?\nRoll away, get lost! Watch as Uncle Senior shows off his awesome power!
Fist-wielding dog thief, dare to injure Uncle Lushi of mine, here's my move!
Oh no! This can't be happening!\nA mere Xiavax disciple has injured me so severely...
Elder Ye, though this person is young in years,\nTheir power is no longer inferior to ours; we must never underestimate them.
Cough cough, the kid's kung fu is pretty good.\nPractice for a few more years and I'm sure I can catch up to Uncle Landmaster.
Ah, Uncle Senior Lu, there's no need for you to strain yourself now.\nWatch out, the Iron Palm Gang is surrounding us again!
The thief of Xia Xi, give this a try!

Below are the rivers and mountains, above are the sun and stars.

The imperial path should be clear and peaceful, radiating harmony and enlightenment to the court.
Time comes to its end……Times without hope can bring about unexpected change.
Adversity reveals true character; each moment is forever recorded in history.

Well said! Precisely When times are hard, one's true character is seen; each deed is recorded in history.\nUnjust wealth may come easily, but it can erode one's righteous spirit.\nConfuses the mind, leading one down the wrong path.
If this continues, one is bound to end up with a notorious and vile fate.

The Way of Righteousness is long and fraught with challenges, while the Path of Unrighteousness may seem like a shortcut but leads to endless depths.\nI hope these words resonate with you, for today's lesson must not be forgotten.
As my master is already in his forties, there will come a day when he will precede us all.\nAs long as you remember this Righteous Spirit Song, your master's righteous spirit will always be with you.
What does Master say!\nYou have the gall and righteousness of a true hero, with a heart as upright as the heavens. By the heavens and earth, they are sure to live a long and healthy life!
Haha, very well, let's take #PlayerName#'s good luck.\nIt's getting late, so go home and enjoy your meal in peace!
Yay! Finally time to eat!\nThe rice from this land of plenty smells so good; I'm going to eat two bowls this time!
I've been training all day and I'm starving! I'll eat three big bowls!
I'll eat four big bowls!
Hah! Now I understand why our granaries ran out so quickly…
Stop! You're the Rainy Night Butcher, aren't you?\nThe people of Jiangling have no grudge with you. Please show mercy and spare their lives!
Hahahaha! So you've heard of the Rainy Night Butcher!\nWhenever rain falls at night, I get the urge to kill, and I don't stop until I've slain nine people.
Bad timing. I've already killed my nine today and was just heading home satisfied.\nIf you're eager to die, come find me next time!
You fiend! Your crimes are countless and your sins unforgivable.\nToday, I, Jiang Yingquan, will seek justice for the people of Jiangling!
Justice? Hahahaha! Justice is worth nothing!\nSince you're so determined to die, I'll oblige you!!!
Ugh! You villain, enough!
Hahahaha! With skills like that, you dare play the hero?\nWhat justice is there in this world? Call it out and have it save you!
(While Yu Rentu is locked in battle with Master, Shen Tui somehow circles behind him unnoticed,\nthen pulls out a large bag of lime powder and smashes it over Yu Rentu's head!)

Master... this is... the finest lime powder your disciple stockpiled...\nI guarantee that villain... won't be opening his eyes...
If you can still walk, run!\nThe villain is blinded. Your Master can hold him off!

(Before he can finish, Yu Rentu charges forward, one hand covering his eyes and the other wildly swinging his blade.)\nKill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill! Kill!
Master, your disciple is late!
Xuhua, though Tui'er blinded Yu Rentu with lime powder, he's still extremely dangerous.\nGo seek aid from Wudang Sect. I'll hold him here!
Master, he's gone berserk. If he escapes, the local people will suffer another massacre!\nBetter that Xianxia Sect stand united and stop him here!
Good. I have always prided myself on righteousness; today I must lead by example.\nXianxia Sect disciples, follow me to punish evil!
Yes! Master—'Heaven and earth possess a righteous spirit, which takes manifold forms.'\nXianxia Sect disciples, draw your swords!

Below, it becomes rivers and mountains; above, the sun and stars.
In people, it is called the noble spirit, vast enough to fill heaven and earth.
When the imperial road is clear and peaceful, it breathes harmony through the court.

In desperate times, true integrity is revealed, each name recorded in history.
(Clutching his chest, obviously badly wounded.)\nCough, cough... Is this really the time to recite poetry?!\nLet's defeat the enemy first, everyone!
Sect Leader Jiang, fear not! Song Lianting of Wudang Sect has come to help!
Sect Leader Song! Finally! Quickly, help us restrain this villain!

Under siege, Rainman Tu's eyes were blinded, and he gradually struggled to keep up.\nHe let out a mighty roar and charged forward with the tyrannical stride of Yama Palace. Dark energy enveloped his body as gusts of wind surged outward!

Under the sandstorm's onslaught, the apprentice wobbled left and right, struggling to withstand it.\nHe could only watch helplessly as the Rain Harvester charged through the encirclement like a killing god, fleeing into the thick forest.
Huff, huff, finally drove away the villain. Looks like he won't be coming back to cause trouble.
This was all thanks to Master Sect Leader Jiang holding back this villain; otherwise, the people of Jiangling would have suffered again.

Haha, Jiangling is clearly under the control of the Wudang Sect.\nHowever, Sect Leader Song arrived very late and paid no heed to the lives and deaths of the people here.\nNever thought it was the territory of the Xianxia Sect!
Retreat, son! Do not be disrespectful!

Cough cough.... After all, Wudang is a prestigious and renowned school.\nWith such extensive territory under his rule and so many matters to attend to, it's naturally impossible for him to manage everything in detail.

But this time, our tardiness has caused the Sect Leader Jiang and the disciples of the Xianxia Sect to engage in a bitter battle. From both reason and emotion, we are indeed at a disadvantage.\nOnly Qian Sect Leader could have come to the rescue with such righteousness!
Righting the strong and aiding the weak is our duty as warriors of justice. Why should we make a distinction between us and them?\nSect Leader Song, no need to be so polite!

Qian Sect Leader is righteous and brave-hearted; I, Song Linting, admire you!\nI see that both Master Jiang and the Young Heroes of the Xianxia Sect have all sustained some injuries.\nThese medicinal pills are our Wudang Sect's secret remedy for injuries. I shall give them to you as a token of gratitude.

Additionally, Sect Leader Jiang may accept my promise from Song Lanting.\nThey will surely reinforce the defense in Jiangling to strengthen the Wudang Sect's presence. We must ensure that such a tragedy does not occur again today!
Sect Leader Song, good! With those words of yours, all our hard battle was not in vain!
I won't let this Rain Executioner get away just yet; I'll give him one more chase.\nSect Leader Jiang, we'll meet again!
This Rain Man Butcher's martial arts is incredibly domineering.\nFortunately, the Wudang Sect came to support us; otherwise, we might not have held out for long.

They say this guy originally came from a renowned lineage and could be considered a hero among the young nobles.\nLittle did I expect that on this rainy night, my entire family was cruelly massacred by nine bandits.\nFrom then on, his temperament changed dramatically. He entered Yama Palace and began to commit evil deeds.
Ever since then, on nights of rain, he would go into a rage and had to kill nine people to calm down.\nIt must be due to their deep-seated desire for revenge against those nine bandits!
Sigh, in revenge, one even discarded their own name.\nTruly lamentable, to become a figure feared by all in the Jianghu as the Rain Night Butcher.
This guy should have the guts to take revenge on those nine bandits!\nButchering innocents here doesn't make one a hero or a good man.

Well, this case is indeed an old unsolved mystery. Those nine bandits subsequently vanished without a trace.\nThe more this Rainbringer obsessed over justice and chivalry, the harder it was for him to accept the reality of disappointment, and he thus fell into the ways of darkness.

Cough cough cough cough. No wonder the Rainkiller always shouts that all notions of chivalry and justice are bullshit.\nOriginally, I began to understand and sympathize with him in such circumstances.
His plight is indeed tragic, but I believe killing innocent people is wrong!
Not good. Waging war and killing innocents doesn't help the situation.\nNot only can justice not be served, but the souls of the deceased cannot find solace either.

Too obsessed with justice, falling into the ways of evil when hope is dashed.\nI hope all my disciples heed this with great care. Even in dire straits, you must remain true to your nature and uphold the spirit of chivalry.
Cough cough, I see that among all people under the sky, only Master you could achieve this level...\nCould it be that demanding such saintly virtue from the world is as difficult as reaching heaven?
Junior Disciple Shen, you should say less since you're injured like this.\nGo, let me take you back to the Sect to have your wounds dressed.
Roaming around for a while, I didn't see a single person, let alone that villain Bai Cheng.\nCould it be that this person heard of my Great Hero's impending arrival and fled in advance?
Huh? There seems to be an inn on the side of the road ahead.\nWalked for a while and just got thirsty, so I'll drink two cups of tea to refresh myself.
Sir, please come in!
This miss seems somewhat familiar...\nAlright, alright. Bring me a bowl of tea, waiter.
Alright sir, I'll be right with you
Sir, what big business are you conducting out in these desolate wildernesses?
Cough cough cough, uh...\nI'm going to Yangzhou for a few days of sightseeing; it's just a coincidence that I'll be passing through.
(studied your face closely with narrowed eyes)\nOh, I see now
I heard that this place has a wicked bandit named Chi Baicheng...\nThis fellow has committed numerous wicked deeds and is quite frightening. I wonder if the honored guest has seen him?
This, I have never seen such scoundrels \nYou're a Miss who talks a lot. Quickly take the tea.
Alright, alright, I'm coming, I'm coming
Drink several warm bowls of tea comfortably, and it's time to hit the road.\nWaiter, check the bill
(Just about to pay, suddenly felt the room spinning, limbs growing weak)\nThis, this, this... This tea doesn't seem right. Could it be that Cui Baocheng has devised a cunning plan against me?
Dog thief Zhi Baicheng, I recognized you the moment I saw you!\nYou've been incapacitated by the Anesthetic Powder of Yaowang Valley. Surrender now!
Ah? Misunderstanding, a misunderstanding!
Though he temporarily gained the upper hand, his strength was fading quickly. It seems I'm done for today...
Chi Bacheng, you can take a lot of damage. Looks like I'll need to stock up on healing potions more often.
This knockout drug is really powerful; I can't move my hands and feet at all. Looks like I'm stuck here today...
Painful Indifference, Bai Cheng, just lie still!
After several more moves, just as you were about to explain further, you suddenly felt the effects of the medicine kicking in and your legs gave out, causing you to fall to the ground.
(currently binding you in multiple places and stuffing cloth in your mouth)\nHmph, villain, are you going to keep causing trouble? It would have been better if you had surrendered sooner.
Muffled sobs: Wu wu wu wu wu wu!
Wait for Ruan Zhi to arrive and then interrogate you properly.
Woo woo woo woo woo woo!
Yunhe, what's going on here?\nI went out for a brief patrol, and you already tied someone up here?
Haha, Ruan Zhi, Zhiji Bai Cheng was eventually caught by me. Does this finally make you admit defeat?
Cishi Baicheng? Your gaze is really good. Where does this guy resemble Cishi Bacheng at all?
Ah? No, not exactly.\n(Coming closer to you and squinting to take a careful look again) Ah, it seems I really did grab the wrong person!
Woo woo woo woo woo woo!
Done and done and done. What do I do now?\nIf Master finds out I've caused trouble again, he's going to skin me alive!
Hehe, why don't we just go all in?\nCut this person down with one slash and bury them there. Won't that mean no one will know about it?
Woo woo woo woo woo woo!
What are you talking about, Ruan Zhi! As a member of the Seven Sons of Chivalry and Righteousness, how could you!\nHow could you even come up with such a despicable idea!
Oh, just joking, just joking \nLook how scared he is, hurry and untie him!
Sorry sorry, I am truly sorry \nMy eyes aren't the best, and I mistook you for the villain Cishi Baicheng.
Cough cough, no problem no problem, nothing serious.\nTwo of you were also searching for Di Bancheng here?

Exactly, we heard that Chi Baicheng is recruiting in Yangzhou, as if he's planning some major undertaking.\nTherefore, I specially dressed up as a waiter at the post station to gather some information. Unexpectedly, I offended Young Hero; I sincerely beg for your forgiveness.

Forgot the introduction. I am Li Yunhe from Yaowang Valley, and this is Ruan Zhi from Dayin Pavilion.\nWe pursue criminals as ordered by our respective Sect Leaders and are collectively known as the Seven Righteous Heroes alongside another five Young Heroes.

I am #PlayerForceDescribe##$PlayerName#,\nI've heard of seven young heroes in the Jianghu, skilled in martial arts and upholding justice.\nIt is indeed the two of you. It is a pleasure to meet you both.
Haha, it's not as impressive as the legend either.\nWe are but novices and cannot compare to the senior masters in the Jianghu.
Mainly, the other five are just empty titles. You only need to remember us two, Young Hero.
Will Ruan Zhi, die from being modest?\n#PlayerName#, the effects of this Mafoshan should not last much longer.\nTake these prescriptions and use them to nourish your body-I consider this my apology.
I've heard that the elixirs from Yaowang Valley are incredibly miraculous. I'll gladly follow your lead then.
No need to apologize; I was in the wrong today anyway.\nWe must continue to track Zhi Baicheng's whereabouts and will no longer interfere.
OK, if either of you find this person's location, please send a message via homing pigeon.\nI will race against time to come and help. (And share a portion of the reward while I'm at it.)

#PlayerName# not only doesn't blame me for my recklessness but is even willing to offer help. Truly a righteous heart.\nThanks in advance. With your help, we'll be able to apprehend these rogues easily.
Ruan Zhi, look at them and learn from them properly!\nWell, at least you still call yourself one of the Righteous Seven!

Haha, from what I can tell, #PlayerName# must have come for the bounty on this person.\nFor the record, if I, Ruan Zhi, were to discover this person's whereabouts first,...\nAccording to the rules of the Jianghu, I need to get a significant share of this bounty!
We should act heroically and right wrongs without expecting anything in return, Ruan Zhi. Why do you keep thinking about the reward all the time?
Yeah yeah, I was thinking about splitting the bounty.\nYou're so upright and principled, if you have the ability, just don't do it!
No, don't bother with it! You can split my share between #PlayerName# and you.
Haha, great great! Deal! I've been waiting for you to say this!\n#PlayerName#, I'll head off to find Chi Ba Cheng right away. Goodbye!
Ruan Zhi, you tricked me with a taunt, right?! I'm not done with you yet, don't leave!!!......\n#PlayerName# farewell!
You watched as one ran and another chased, hurrying away from the place.
...These two-while one has an unwelcoming gaze and the other is old and cunning-I feel they aren't quite trustworthy.\nAh, I hope they can find Chi Bancheng's whereabouts.
#TargetInteractName#, what a coincidence! You're gathering herbs here, I see!
Late, Late Bai Cheng! You dog, you finally showed up!!!
Wait wait wait, it's me, #$PlayerName#!
Oh! It's #PlayerName#!\nSorry sorry, my eyesight really isn't great; I almost mistook you for Shi Bicheng again.
Cough, cough, #TargetInteractName#, no harm done \nBut your gaze would have real trouble navigating the Jianghu.
Haha, #PlayerName# said right \nI used to study medical texts and cultivate herbs only in Yaowang Valley and rarely wandered into the Jianghu.

Just a few years after the Yellow Crane Alliance, various sects dispatched disciples to capture underworld figures.\nMaster sees that I have some natural talent and has specially sent me out to undergo some training.

This time pursuing Bai Cheng, I journeyed alongside Ruan Zhi.\nWhile their actions may seem strange, but their nature is fundamentally good.\nI relied on him throughout my journey to ensure my safety.
Inherently good? I can't help but feel skeptical.\nSpeaking of which, why isn't Ruan Zhi accompanying you this time?

Aye, we had been following Zhi Baicheng's trail for quite some distance and finally saw a glimmer of hope.\nFor some reason, suddenly there were rumors spreading in Yangzhou about an epidemic, and many common people had already fallen ill.

Thinking of the urgency to treat the common people, Ruan Zhi went to investigate the situation in Yangzhou first.\nI'll gather more herbs on this mountain to prepare for medical needs, then meet up with him.
Unfortunately, my eyes aren't great, and I spent a lot of time without gathering enough herbs.\nOh, it looks like an epidemic is about to break out, and I don't know what to do.
What's hard about that? #TargetInteractName#, if you don't mind, I'll join you in gathering herbs.\nJust let me know what herbs you need.
#PlayerName# wants to help? That's great!\nI need ephedra, licorice, Huangqin, honeysuckle, and chrysanthemum, so there should be plenty of these on the mountain.
You help me gather more of each type, please.\nIn case the plague spreads, it's wise to prepare accordingly.
Good, these are common herbs and not hard to find. I'll take care of it.

Hmm? What's this long piece of white rope? It's quite long.
White Rope, where did you get white rope out here in the wilderness...?
Hold on! This is clearly a silver ringed snake!\n#TargetInteractName# Watch out!

Okay, I've got it \nThanks for saving me, #PlayerName#. Otherwise, I'm afraid I would have been bitten by a poisonous snake again.
Another bite?
I have poor eyesight and often get bitten by venomous snakes when collecting herbs.\nHaha, it's been hundreds if not dozens of times, and I've long gotten used to it.
Fortunately, I understand the toxicity of various snakes and insects, so I always find a way to neutralize them.\nThere were several times I nearly failed, but fortunately, Master rescued me in time.
Well, that's... I don't know if I should say you're lucky or just plain fortunate.\nAnyway, I've already gathered the herbs you need. Let's see if they're sufficient.
(took a look and immediately beamed with joy) That's enough, enough. With what I gathered, this should treat many people.\n#PlayerName#, I thank you on behalf of the people of Yangzhou.
These words, aiding the dying and healing the injured is our duty, what could be tiring about that?\n#TargetInteractName#, take these herbs to Yangzhou quickly. Saving lives is crucial.

Good, then I'll head to Yangzhou to treat the civilians.\n#PlayerName#, goodbye!
