#PlayerName#, you've come indeed!
I heard that you two are investigating the source of the epidemic here, so I specially came to help.
Ah, originally this only needed to be split between two people for Chi Baicheng's bounty. Now it has to be divided among three.
What are you saying, Ruan Zhi? We #$PlayerName# have a righteous heart, coming here to investigate the epidemic.\nWhy would I be after a bounty like you are!
Um... Yes, what #TargetInteractName# said is correct.\nI just wonder what this epidemic has to do with Black Dao's Five Ghosts and Cishi Baicheng.
I had been tracking Shi Bicheng's whereabouts with Ruan Zhi in this area previously.\nHe seems to have recruited a bunch of outlaws and is planning something big.
Almost simultaneously, an unknown epidemic also emerged in Yangzhou city and worsened.\nThese two events are too coincidental
So, did the two of them suspect that this might be Bacheng Chisi's doing from behind the scenes?
Not certain yet \nHowever, we found that among Chi Baicheng's recruited outlaws, several were disguised and lurking within the city.
They sneak out every night and wander around the city separately, unknown what mischief they are up to.\nThen meet in a quiet place by the South Gate.

Since we don't know the enemy's strength, relying only on me and Yunhe Little Sister, whose eyes aren't too good,\nFearing it would be difficult to take down completely, they thought of seeking your help, #PlayerName#.

Got it, but I've heard that the Black Society's Five Ghosts are greedy and lustful, and they like to rob people.\nSpreading disease in Yangzhou for them seems to be unprofitable and counterproductive.

Well, perhaps they are doing this for money, and there might be someone else behind them.\nThus, for now, we need to capture those outlaws inside the city first. Only then can we investigate the reason for the epidemic's spread.
Alright, let's not delay. I'll follow whatever instructions you two have.

That night, the sky was overcast,\nInside Yangzhou city, except for the Flower and Willow District and a few bustling streets that remained brightly lit,\nThe rest of the areas were mostly shrouded in darkness, with the sounds gradually subsiding.
You propelled yourselves with lightness, following those outlaws through the winding streets of the city.
These guys are up to something. After visiting the market, meat shop, and tavern kitchen, who knows what they have in mind.\nThese places are all closed at night. Could they be going to steal things?

It doesn't seem like it. When they left the house, each of them was carrying a few small bags.\nAfter wandering around aimlessly, the number of items in my hand kept decreasing, as if I had left them here.
For now, it's crucial to track them down. We can investigate these places later.

Continue tracking these individuals to Yangzhou's South Gate. Here, a small stream flows from the upstream of the city's water source.\nOnly to see these few people standing by the stream, starting to whisper and plot something.
Oh, Senior Brother, why did you have us place those things inside the city for the Five Ghosts of the underworld?
Who cares? The underworld can just pay up!
Hey Senior Brother, I heard not only Shi Baocheng but also the Black Society Five Ghosts are going to arrive in Yangzhou soon.\nThey must accomplish a great matter here!
Go mind your own business!\nKnowing more in our line of work means dying younger, got it!
Yes yes yes, Senior Brother's words are correct.
Tonight after we finish this job, we'll slip out through the southern gate and head for home with our earnings.\nAfter that, don't bother or ask about it.
Good senior brother
(Ah) Oh, they're leaving the city tonight \nIt seems we can only act here to apprehend these three individuals.
Well, if they escape, we might scare the grass and alert them.\nBut with the three of us, one against each, we should be able to handle it easily.
Okay, I'll handle the weakest one \nCan you have confidence in entrusting the strongest one to Yunhe?
Ruan Zhi! Who are you looking down on! I'll take care of it, just see my Medicine King skills!
Evil bandit, where are you going!
Oh no! Things have been discovered!
Evil bandit, where are you going!
Oh no! Things have been discovered!
(The thief seeing the situation go badly, tossed the object in his hand into the stream before turning to flee.)
(Chase and stab with one sword, killing this person on the spot.\nLooking back, the packages had drifted quite far downstream.)

Ruan Zhi!
The two of you stood by the streambank, anxiously waiting for a moment.
(Just as Ruan Zhi leaped out of the stream like a carp jumping over the dragon gate,\nHe was holding a small bag in his hand.)
You, are you okay?
No need to worry! Ahchoo! Ahchoo!\nI strained to grab hold of this one package; the rest were washed away by the stream.
Let me see what treasures are hidden inside...
Opening the package, the three of you exchanged puzzled glances, unable to say a word.：\nThe package contained rotten meat from poultry and livestock.
What are you up to, rotting flesh?\nThankfully, I worked so hard and ended up getting nothing but trash.

Oh no, this isn't that simple \nI've heard in Yaowang Valley that there's a method to spread disease between two warring armies.\nIt involves throwing diseased and dead poultry and livestock using catapults into the opposing army's ranks.
These outlaws are heading to crowded places like the market, butcher shop, and tavern.\nThey must have placed these putrid carcasses in these locations to spread the plague!

So it's a surprise! You actually had a moment of clarity, Cloud Crane.\nI couldn't understand why the plague in Yangzhou continues to spread despite prohibitions. It turns out these guys are causing all the trouble!

Ahchoo! Ahchoo! Finally traced the source of the epidemic. Looks like getting drenched wasn't in vain after all.\nNow that I've achieved such significant merit, don't I deserve some extra reward money?
It's time already and you're still thinking about bounties!\nWe need to collect the rotting flesh they scattered and burn it all together.\nThis is how we can cut off the source of the epidemic.
Ahchoo! Ahchoo! That's right.\nBut... several packages of rotten meat are still flowing downstream with the stream.\nThis is the main water source for the city. We can't afford...

We will notify the authorities tomorrow morning to advise residents not to drink the water from the city's sources.\nThough it might not completely stop the spread of the plague, it could still reduce the risk of infection for the common people.
Now that we're here, we can can only take it one step at a time.

#PlayerName#, thanks for your help this time. I see you seem to have sustained some minor injuries.\nThis secret medical text can heal injuries and refine your breathing. Take it and study it carefully; you will surely find it highly beneficial.
We will go immediately to clean up the rotten flesh thrown by the bandits. Goodbye!
Good, I hope both of you have smooth travels and must control the spread of disease within the city.\nIf you run into difficulties, just come to me for help.

Inside the Medical Hall in Yangzhou, it was already crowded to the point where one could hardly move.\nA few sick beds were filled with the severely ill, while those with less serious conditions mostly sat on the ground leaning against the walls.\nSighs, complaints, coughs, and cries echoed through the Medical Hall, tugging at one's heartstrings.

Only to see a woman dressed as a physician swiftly moving among the patients and beds-this is Li Yunhe.\nShe was drenched in sweat but didn't bother to wipe it away, constantly asking about the patient's condition and directing the servants to prepare medicine.
#TargetInteractName#, it's been a while \nWhy has the plague become so severe in Yangzhou?
#PlayerName#! Since you left last time, Ruan Zhi and I have been searching the city for the foul meat that the thieves scattered around.
How unfortunate these decayed remnants are so fragmented and difficult to find.\nAnd since some of it ended up in the water sources, it ultimately failed to stop the spread of the epidemic.
After the plague rapidly spread throughout the city, over a hundred citizens have fallen ill so far.\nEven Ruan Zhi, who had been helping all along, fell ill.
You glance to the side,\nI see Ruan Zhi lying on a straw mat, coughing uncontrollably.

Cough cough cough cough, #PlayerName#, here I am laughing at you.\nUnexpectedly, as the Great Hero Ruan Zhi of the Seven Heroes of Righteousness, I don't even have a bed.\nLying on reed matting really feels like a tiger fallen to plain ground being bullied by a dog.
Don't be sarcastic here; the beds are for serious patients. Many common people don't even have straw mats.\nCome, drink your medicine!
Ah dear, suffering so much! #PlayerName#, for mercy's sake!
Even Yunhe didn't fear catching your illness; this shows such caring attention.\n#TargetInteractName#, quiet down and focus on getting better.
But this medicine is abnormally bitter. You little girl must have added something to seek revenge for past grievances!
Painful medicine benefits the sick; less talk, just give me the drink!
Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah!
What are you doing! Just messing around!\nHeard there's an unlicensed lass practicing medicine here? Step forward!
What, illegal medical practice? I am a disciple of Yaowang Valley named Li Yunhe, apprenticed to Huangfu Qingshan...
Hell, I don't give a damn where you came from!\nWithout my permission to practice medicine here, it's illegal practice!
You seem so familiar to me \nHey hey hey, you're supposed to be #$PlayerName#!

Cough cough cough cough, what a mess. This guy is one of the Five Ghosts of the underworld, Shi Bicheng!\nYou son of a gun, you're really in Yangzhou City. This bounty is mine for sure! Cough cough cough cough cough!

Foolish child.... How could you possibly be your Uncle Guo's opponent?\nPromise Father... don't go to die... don't seek revenge with Uncle Guo...
No way! If I cannot kill Guo Huai with my own hands, I, Lv Wuyang, swear I will not be a person!!!
Wuyang! According to Father... Mother died from illness shortly after giving birth to you...\nYour father is now left with only Wu Yang as a relative...

Father also knows that indulging you too much is like raising a child to be spoiled-ultimately harmful...\nWhy must Father keep trying to... make up for what he owes your mother by giving it all to you...
Woo woo woo woo woo, Father! Father!
Your Uncle Guo hurt me... it was an accident... you mustn't hold a grudge against him...\nWuyang... Come here...
Lvyexing placed both palms on Lvwang's shoulders,\nGushing inner power continuously flooded into Lu Wuyang's body.
Father, what are you doing?
Your father can't leave you much, just the cultivation of the last fifty years...
Father had quite a few silver tickets on him... along with these weapons, armor, and Wudang secret texts.\nYou can take it all... it's enough to live a carefree rural life.
Don't step into the Jianghu again; listen to your father's final words... Wuyang...
After saying his piece, Lu Tianxing transmitted all his inner power to Lu Wuyang.\nWith his power depleted, Lu Tianxing was already on his last breath, and he finally closed his eyes slowly.
The Wondrous Hero of Penglai, Lu Tianxing, met his end in the wilderness.
Father! Father! Father!
Lv Wuyang cried out to heaven, but it was too late; once a life is lost, it cannot be regained.\nHe could only forcibly suppress his sorrow and bury Lu Tianxing there.
Dad... Dad is dead... I have nowhere to go...\nWhy live like this?
Ah, Great Hero Lu, you once had a name for valor, yet you died so mysteriously now.\nAlas, what sorrow and lamentation!
It's you? Phantom you dog!\nIf it weren't for you forcing me to poison them, how could I have come to this point!
I shall sacrifice you to the heavens; die now!
Ohoho, Little Hero Lu, your words are incorrect.\nDidn't you also long ago dislike Xiang Wentian and want to get rid of him?\nI just helped you...
In the end, if not for that fellow Xiang Wentian meddling in things.\nWith Guo Huai running out to meddle in other people's affairs, how could the situation have escalated to this point?
It's not me or you, but Guo Huai and Xiang Wentian.
......Right! A debt of blood must be repaid!\nI will make Xiang Wentian and Guo Huai pay!

Ah, too bad Xiang Wentian has #$PlayerName# and the Righteous Seven to help him, and Guo Huai has friends all over the world.\nYoung Hero, do you really think you can avenge them alone? The chances seem slim.
Yes... Although I have obtained Father's full strength, I remain outnumbered and outmatched...\nWhat should I do...
Haha, our Four Great Assassins publicly take money for our services.\nActually, it was to serve a mysterious force. That is"Bloodclothe Alliance"。
Bloodcloth Alliance?

Not bad. Although the Bloodstained Cloak Alliance operates underground, our influence is vast, with spies scattered across the entire country.\nThe young hero, for now, has no other choice but to join the Blood Cloak Alliance if he wishes to avenge and seek revenge.
If you truly wish for revenge, please come with me.\nI will report to Commander Shangguan Feng and plead for an additional favor to have you join his ranks.
If you don't want to seek revenge, then keep weeping and wailing here.\nHehe, good day to you!
(while gazing after the retreating silhouette of the Meiyin, they murmured to themselves)\nBloodclothes League... Bloodclothes League... Alright, let's go with Bloodclothes League!
Lu Wuyang knelt and thumped his head on the grave of Lu Tianxing three times.\nHe quickly stood up and followed in the footsteps of the shadows.
Two figures darted and dodged through the forest.\nIt soon faded into the gradually encroaching night....
#PlayerName# has indeed arrived. The Great Hero Guo is just preparing to award the rewards.
Haha, how could I possibly be left out of this reward?
Young Hero #PlayerName#, you met us previously at the Immortal Residence Inn,\nFoiled the plots of the Four Great Assassins and Lu Wuyang, saving Shopkeeper Wu Yous life.
After adding that, in the Battle of Longxi County, you fought to the death.\nBringing Zheng Zhenhai to justice right here can be considered a great effort for a cause well-fought.

I have come this time with rewards from the Dayin Pavilion and the Penglai Sect.\nAmong them, the Dayin Pavilion was established to thank you for rescuing Shopkeeper Wu.\nAnd the Penglai Sect expresses its apology for the deeds and actions of Lu Tianxing and his son.

选项: Choose a potion;ChooseZhenHaiBounty;0|Receive reward silver 4000 taels;ChooseZhenHaiBounty;1
内容: #PlayerName#, you may choose one secret martial arts manual from these two factions.\nTake this and improve your skills greatly. Train well and go!
Thank Great Hero Guo

As for Xiang Wentian, given your successful capture of the imperial troublemaker and the bandit chief Zeng Zhenhai,\nSect Leader Zhao Polu of Flying Dragon Sect has decided to specially promote you to the position of Elder.
I hope you will continue to serve the court faithfully and cleanse the Wulin of evil.
Thanks, Great Hero Guo. I Xiao will not fail the expectations of Sect Leader and you, sir.

All right, rewards have been distributed. I also have one more thing to ask.\nWhile correcting, did Young Hero Xiang bring Jin Zhentai's body to the officials for inspection and examination, and did they find any clues?
Great Hero Guo, I was just about to report to you.\nBesides the knives and hidden weapons on Zeng Zhenhai's person, as well as some silver coins and trinkets, he also found several silver notes.
Oh? What's special about these silver bills?
These silver drafts have substantial amounts \nAnd they all came from the largest money shop under the Feifeng Treasury in Xiliang.
Zhe zhen hai yilai daogong guangnan xilu \nEven if you are saving money, you should go to the banks in Fuzhou. How could you end up all the way in Xiliang, a thousand miles away?
And before that, Zhenhai had also fled in the direction of Xiliang from Fuzhou.\nCould there be someone in Xiliang City who could meet and assist him?

So I suspect that the Xiliang Flying Phoenix Treasury might have some unsavory dealings with Zeng Zhenhai.\nPerhaps his contemporaries from back then are lurking right now in the Flying Phoenix Treasury.
Well, that's indeed possible \nThen I request that Young Hero Xiaogang visit the Phoenix Treasury in Xiliang to gather intelligence. If you obtain any leads, please inform me as soon as possible.
Okay, just in case we get a lead at that time,\nAlso please have #PlayerName# come to help again and capture the murderer together.

I cannot refuse... although I have one thing that remains unclear to me.\nWhat was the situation surrounding that notorious massacre that occurred in the Jingcheng many years ago.\nWhat does Zeng Zhenhai have to do with this?
Why would the two of you spare no effort to investigate this bloodshed?\nStill hoping that Great Hero Guo will clarify!
#PlayerName# put in a lot of effort this time, so I won't hold back anymore.\nThis is a long-forgotten case from the depths of the Jianghu. Hear me recount it slowly.

Many years ago, when I was a fallen rogue wanderer, I received help from a wealthy Li family in the capital city.\nThis household is known for its generosity and often provides relief to the poor in the surrounding countryside. As a result, they are widely praised and their reputation for kindness has spread far and wide.
A drop of water, a spring in return.\nSo after I became famous, I continued to take good care of this household.

Until one day I was shocked to hear that on a rainy night, nine bandits had murdered that family.\nMen, women, and children-every member of the family perished at the hands of the bandits. The household's wealth and fine personal possessions were also thoroughly looted.\nOnly one young man survived by hiding in the well.
What bandits could be so daring as to commit such a family massacre right under the imperial throne?

Alas, just as the First Taiyue Fengshan Grand Ceremony concluded and brought chaos to the land, martial arts factions continue to clash.\nTherefore, even in the capital, such tragic incidents occur frequently.

But what puzzles me is that there are many of my Beggars Sect disciples guarding around this household.\nThese nine robbers managed to handle the case so swiftly and efficiently, suggesting that there might be an insider working from within in concert with them.
Too late to say anything now, so I can only take that last remaining youth as my disciple.\nPersonally guide him in cultivating martial arts to repay the wealthy family's help from years ago.
Could this be... the Great Hero Guo whom he kept mentioning...\nThat disciple who fell to the evil path?
Not bad; this matter is known to few in the Jianghu.\nMost know of this only out of consideration for me and avoid mentioning it.

That boy is named Li Renjie. He originally possessed exceptional natural abilities and was a rare martial talent.\nUnfortunately, since that night when my family was slaughtered, I have developed hysterical episodes and often lose control, becoming deranged.
I specially took him to Yaowang Valley to seek medicine from Hero Doctor Huangfu Bin.\nHow can such a mental illness be casually cured with medication?
But I still treated him as my own child and carefully instructed him.\nThe care I put into him exceeds that for my own son Guo Yongrui by a few percent.

Until one rainy night, he suddenly went berserk and killed nine people in the capital city.\nAt that moment, in a fit of anger, I revoked all of their martial arts from the Beggars Sect.\nBut considering his tragic background, she did not deliver the fatal blow...

I didn't expect him to fall into the evil path thereafter, requiring him to kill nine people on rainy nights.\nCompletely became a notorious killer in the Jianghu, feared by all.\nThis matter is undoubtedly the greatest stain on my life as Guo Huai, one that can never be washed away...
On rainy nights...... killing nine people in a row...... doesn't this person then become......\nThe Rain Tyrant, ranked fourth among the Seven Evils of the Present Day?
Haha, not bad. After he fell into the way of evil, he changed his name from Li Renjie to Yuren Shuang.\nOnly because he kills nine people every rainy night can he quench his anger.
Ah, he must have assigned these nine people,\nTreat them as the nine robbers who killed his entire family that year.

Ironically, I Guo Huai have lived a life of integrity, never doing anything that would haunt my conscience.\nA disciple who could have been carefully cultivated turned into the mass murderer Rain Butcher. Truly, it is fate playing a cruel joke!

Since then, I have vowed never to take on apprentices again and have become increasingly fair and unforgiving in both my dealings with others and myself.\nDo not commit evils because they are small, nor neglect good deeds because they are trivial. This is to warn oneself against making the same mistakes again.

I have always been so strict with Guo Yongrui.\nWhen he previously protected the thief Wang Tianyi, he almost struck him down with one palm.\nIt was also out of fear that he might go astray like Rain Butcher, falling into the path of evil.
Seeing his entire family perish before his eyes is such a shock that few could endure it.\nThis Rain Executioner, suffering from hysteria and losing himself to madness, was perhaps understandable.
Ah, Great Hero Guo does not need to blame himself too much.\nEssentially, this all stems from the bloody crimes committed by those nine robbers many years ago.
That is why I feel even more responsible for bringing those nine thieves to justice from back then.\nThis is also why I have persistently pursued the truth of this case without giving up.
Heaven watches over us; recently, I received a tip-off,\nThe neighbors of that household from the reward notice surprisingly recognized Zheng Zhenhai!
Zhen Hai used to be a guard at that household back then.\nHe surprisingly survived that rainy night \nThen he ran to Guangnan West Road and transformed into the leader of bandits.
Doesn't that mean...\nThis Zhang Zhenhai might have been the insider who colluded with the bandits from within?

Not bad. At the moment, this is the only lead we have-Zeng Zhenhai's-which is why I'm personally handling the arrest of this person...\nDidn't expect that human calculations couldn't match divine providence; the Four Assassins still managed to gain the upper hand and eliminate this person, cutting off this lead.

However, the four assassins acting together indicates that this matter is indeed of great importance and is likely related to the Blood Robe Alliance.\nThis also strengthened my resolve and that of Great Hero Guo to pursue this case to the very end.
As long as Guo Huai draws his last breath, he will see this case to the end.\nBring those criminals to justice to console the spirits of so many innocent deceased!
Hearing both of your explanations has really cleared up my doubts.\nThese scoundrels are truly monstrous and cannot be forgiven.
Great Hero Guo, Brother Xiang, if there's anything you need from me, just speak up.\nI will help you, #$PlayerName#, to get to the bottom of this case!
Okay! Young Hero Xiao, you go to Xiliang Flying Phoenix Treasury to gather intelligence.\nI will remain in the capital to continue searching for clues. This time, I must uncover this case completely.

Recompense must be rendered; how can one disregard their life so lightly? With the Divine Sword piercing the heavens, who will settle this right and wrong.\nXiang Wentian is heading to Xiliang and will certainly not disappoint everyone's expectations. Goodbye!
Two of you, farewell!
They say that a tomb robber has appeared around Jinyang, causing quite a stir in the area.\nIt looks like we should ask the nearby residents to see if they have any tips or clues.
This elderly man, I've heard there's been a tomb raider in the vicinity lately. Do you know anything about it?
Sure sure, Jinyang ancient city has a long history and features numerous royal tombs and noble graves.\nSo there are often grave robbers who target this place.

But this time, the tomb robbers were said to know some martial arts, and the officials sent people to investigate for a long time without catching them.\nIn these eight or ten villages, many ancestral graves have already been desecrated. Truly a sinful act!
Old sir, do you know where these tomb raiders usually operate?
Recently, this guy seems to be operating in the area around Jinyang's southern necropolis.\nI wonder how many graves will suffer this time.
Oh... The world is declining, and people's hearts have changed.\nIn times of war and chaos, not only the living suffered, but the dead found no peace either.
Is Jinyang to the south... Thanks a lot, sir!
This is the place where the notorious tomb raider was said to appear.
You searched around thoroughly and surprisingly discovered an open tomb.
It looks like it was just dug up not long ago. Could the tomb robber be inside the tomb right now?\nNo pains, no gains. Let's go in and see what we find.

Trudging along the dark and lengthy corridor, you finally step into the main burial chamber.\nOnly in the center of the tomb chamber lies a stone coffin, with numerous ancient treasures scattered around it.
Hmm? There are so many treasures scattered here, which means this place hasn't been robbed yet.\nWhere did that tomb robber go......
Just as I was thinking, suddenly three figures leaped out from the shadows and surrounded me!
Haha, little thief, you fell for Old Man's clever plan!\nThis technique is called Luring the Snake Out of Its Den, and Catching the Turtle in the Cauldron.
Throughout the Wulin, few have managed to last three rounds against my Invincible Divine Fist Hao Dali.\nTiny tomb raider, wise ones yield now!
Don't waste time with idle talk \nSet up our Chain Triple Slaughter Array and let that villain feel the power!
Wait wait wait, what's going on?
Oh, this scoundrel knows a thing or two!
Senior Brother, what should we do now?
Two brothers, go ahead; don't worry about me!
No, Senior Brother, didn't you say we don't need to be born in the same month and day?\nDo you want to die on the same day as me?
Three brothers, you've mistaken us for someone else.\nIt's me, #$PlayerName#!
Hah! Ha! Here comes a Mountain Press!

内容: Ouch, Brother Powerful, stop it \nIt's me, #$PlayerName#!
Ah? Brothers, stop it! You've hit the wrong person!
#PlayerName#, how would you be here?
Ah, I've just heard that Jinyang produced a tomb robber.\nHe wants to catch the thieves here
Now we've truly brought the flood into the dragon temple. The three of us brothers came here to catch a thief.

Blame it on you, Wu Mou, with such a rotten idea?\nSticking to this tomb chamber in hopes of catching the thief was like waiting for a rabbit to appear. In the end, instead of catching the thief, #PlayerName# ended up getting bumped into.
I didn't expect #PlayerName# to be here...\nOh, this tomb robber is really cunning... Where on earth did he go?......
(At this moment, a bell-like laughter rang from behind, and you turned to look,\nOnly to find that one female thief had already plundered all the treasures in the tomb during your fight.)
Haha, keep playing. I won't disturb you four.
You are... Murong Xingchen?
You damn woman, you nearly destroyed us three brothers last time!\nWe have to apprehend you today!
Fail once, learn wise; this time we will definitely not fall for your tricks again!
Cough cough, what are you guys talking about? I can't understand a word!\nI'll take this treasure and go. No need for all of you to see me off.

While correcting, Murong Xingchen reached out to pocket the last treasure on the stone coffin.\nBut suddenly, a series of clicking sounds from the mechanism echoed, and the entire tomb chamber shook violently.
Oh no, it seems I accidentally triggered a mechanism.\nEveryone, run quickly
While finishing their sentence, Murong Xingchen took off using qinggong.\nDisappearing into the darkness of the tomb passage with just a few steps.
Thief, don't run!
Ah, Senior Brother, the entire tomb chamber is about to collapse! We should run quickly!
Damnit, she got away again...\nForget it, my life is more important, retreat.
You four sprinted all the way to the exit. Finally, you made it out before the tomb passage collapsed.\nThen came a loud rumbling from behind. The falling rocks completely blocked the entrance.
Huff... Ha... Second Brother, Third Brother, #PlayerName#, have you all come out...
Came out... came out...\nFortunately, fortunately... I almost became an offering artifact...
Cough cough, everyone is safe then \nJust didn't expect the tomb raider to be Murong Xingchen.\nWhy would she become a tomb raider instead of a regular flyer thief?
Hmm, it seems like they've realized that making a living as a live person these days isn't easy.\nPrepare to expand business channels and engage in this grim trade.

Hmph, who cares what business she's in \nAs brothers in the Flying Dragon Sect police force, it is our duty to apprehend her and bring her to justice.\nBy advancing in rank and wealth, he embarked on the pinnacle of his life.
What are you two brothers still waiting for? Let's keep pursuing!
Okay! #PlayerName#, let's get a move on first.\nPlease come back and help us catch her if we find the bandit's whereabouts later.
Sure, we can make money together when the time comes, and the bounties will be shared by all!
Alright alright, three brothers, take your time\n(Ah, just being sold out by Murong Xingchen would be a blessing... don't say you have to catch her...)
#PlayerName#, finally. We brothers three are ready.
Sure, let's head out quickly
Hold on hold on, where are the three of you heading off to?
Of course, it's to arrest that tomb raider, Murong Xingchen, one of the Seven Evil Men!
Uh, do any of you know where she is now?
Hmph, we have already gathered the information \nThis thief has lately been targeting an abandoned grave in the western part of Henei Township.
She is likely already committing the crime inside the tomb now.\nAs long as we get there in time, we can catch her in the act!
Alright, since the three of you have already devised your strategy,\nThat matter should not be delayed; let's set off right away.
Is this the desolate tomb that Murong Xingchen was staring at?\nIt's quite unremarkable, really

Though this desolate tomb may not seem remarkable, it is said to be where Zhao Yinzong, the Prefect Commissioner, is interred.\nThe tombs are intricately intertwined, and I have no idea how the old woman thief found this place.

The tomb seems to have been recently excavated, which means Murong Xingchen is likely stealing from inside.\nThis time we'll use a trap to catch her like a fish in a barrel; we're sure to capture her this time!
#PlayerName# has strong martial arts skills, so could you please go ahead and scout the way?\nThe three of us will stay at the back to prevent that thief woman from fleeing again.
All right, then you'd better keep up
Haha, Younger Sister Cuomeng, long time no see.\nI didn't expect you to have taken up tomb raiding as your new line of work!

Haha, Older Sister Shangguan doesn't know about this.\nLately, this business of life has been increasingly difficult. Little Sister had no choice but to turn her eyes toward these deceased individuals.
Right, I suddenly remembered that I have other important matters to attend to.\nGo ahead, I'll take my leave!
Wait! Trying to leave?\nHand over the map of the inspection graves first!
Map? What map? Did you mean Older Sister? You must have gotten it wrong...
Ha, don't try to pretend you're stupid to me.\nYou've been digging up so many graves recently-aren't you trying to find the map to Zhao Yizong's tomb?

We in the Bloodstained Alliance had our eyes on this tomb of shame for a long time, and didn't expect you to claim it first.\nHand over the map nicely, Older Sister promises not to make things difficult for you.
Older Sister Shanggang, you're accusing me unjustly \nLately, my expenses have been high. I merely wanted to earn some travel money.\nEverything inspection tomb, what map, I can't understand at all.
I know you won't comply quietly \nBut with this tomb passage so narrow, even if your lightness skills are high, you still can't fly like a bird, right?
Guys, take her down for me
Huh? This wench is actually surrounded by people! Truly, heaven has eyes!
Good fellows, let's capture this bandit together
Senior Brother, Second Brother, Third Brother, Fourth Brother, you've finally arrived! Come help me out!
Senior Brother, Second Brother, Third Brother, Fourth Brother? Are you talking about the four of us?
Hmph! I didn't expect you to be prepared as well and to have found four helpers.\nNo problem, take them all down!
Ah? Misunderstanding, a misunderstanding!

You were slaughtering in the tomb room with skies weeping and earth sobbing, ghosts wailing and wolves howling.\nMurong Xingchen somehow sneaked up to the coffin and picked up a map, stuffing it into his pocket.
Only to hear the familiar mechanism click and rotate with a series of clicks.\nThe entire tomb then shook violently again
What a damned woman! We're here to protect you, and you go off to trigger the mechanism again!
Haha, Senior Brother, Second Brother, Third Brother, Fourth Brother, I'm sorry.\nLittle Sister takes her leave first!
By God, she's not getting away this time, chase her!
What's going on? The tomb is starting to collapse!\nForget it, my life is more important, retreat.
You followed Murong Xingchen's footsteps and fled out of the tomb.\nFinally, they surrounded her in a secluded area.
Huff... Ha... That darn old woman is too fast... See if you can escape this time!
Cough cough cough. Good fellows, we've had no grudges and no conflicts lately,\nWhy are you guys harassing me, a weak woman?
Past no grudge, present no grievance? You have the nerve to say that!\nYou wicked woman tricked my three brothers so badly; we were nearly dismissed and investigated!
Just don't waste time talking to her, Senior Brother.\nWe should all rush in and arrest her.
(pout sadly)\nFour brave warriors, I had no choice but to leave without bidding farewell earlier.\nDidn't I also proactively return some of the stolen goods to preserve everyone's official positions?
Well said, let bygones be bygones for now.\nBut lately, you have been tomb raiding and committing numerous crimes.\nAs police officers of the Flying Dragon Sect, we also have the duty to arrest you.

(bent down to wipe away the tears)\nWu wu wu wu, little miss had no choice but to do this.\nPreviously, the orphan we had taken in fell seriously ill. If we hadn't stolen some items to sell, the medicine fees would have been unaffordable.

Ah? This actually happened?\nWhy didn't you say so earlier? Our three brothers could have pooled some money to buy medicine for you!\nDigging graves and tomb raiding like this can't be a sustainable strategy, right?
Come, Wang Cai and Wu Mou, hand over the salary you received a few days ago.\nGo buy medicine for Miss Cuomeng
Senior Brother, stay alert! Don't fall for that witch's mind-tricking scheme again!\nNo matter how many times you say it, tomb robbery is illegal, and today we must bring you back to be questioned!

Ah, think for a moment, you four brave warriors.\nThese gold and jewels buried underground cannot be enjoyed by the dead.\nIsn't it a waste of the forefathers' efforts just for it to deteriorate and rust away?

The young lady thought it would be better to dig them up and use their remains for some good deeds. This way, the deceased can accumulate virtuous karma even in death.\nThis was a win-win great thing, how did it become a crime?
Huh... You know, there's actually some merit to what you're saying.\nThen you plunder tombs, why did you run into Prince Zhao Yizong's attire mound this time?\nThere's nothing valuable in here anyway
To be frank, little lady came here today,\nIt was to find the legendary treasure of Zhao Yizong, the Fengzhang Warehouse.

Legend says that after Zhao Yizong suppressed numerous evil factions and bandits, he established a Fengzhang Warehouse.\nHe not only allocates all confiscated wealth to it but also sets aside a portion of the annual financial surplus from Flying Dragon Sect.

It was said that he planned to use the enormous sum of five million taels to buy off major sects once he amassed this money, thus unifying the Wulin.\nWhile various sects disagree, use this money to recruit warriors and clear the world by force.
How... much? Five million!!!

Not bad; according to the young lady's speculation, this treasure vault is very likely hidden within Prince Zhao Yizong's tomb.\nIt was exactly his lordship's tomb map that I retrieved from the monument to the fallen.

Just that this inspection tomb is extremely large and densely filled with mechanisms and traps.\nWith Shangguan Feng and the Blood Robe Alliance causing trouble from the sides as well,\nWith my own strength alone, venturing in here likely means trouble.

So Miss Xiao sincerely invites all of you brave heroes to join me in exploring the treasures in Prince Zhao Yizong's tomb.\nIf several brave men are willing to cooperate, splitting the treasure equally later on would be quite delightful, wouldn't it?
Good, this deal is mine, Wang Cai will handle it!
Wang Cai, you're confused!\nThis tomb raiding is illegal and unethical. How could we possibly join in such wrongdoing?

Hey, Senior Brother, those words differ \nDuke Zhao Yizong possessed great talent and military strategy, and was generous and magnanimous.\nWe go in and retrieve two treasures; he will certainly not mind.
Wu Mou, how could you...
The five of us-including #PlayerName# and Miss Kongmou-make a perfect group.\nEach person can get exactly one million taels of silver out of the five million.
Our monthly salary is only about thirty to forty taels.\nSenior Brother, calculate how many years it will take to save up one million two taels of silver!
Getting one hundred thousand taels of silver would be enough wealth to last dozens of lifetimes!\nDo we three brothers really need to roam around and hunt down thieves with all this hardship?
Oh... You two are really... greedy and money-grabbing!

Additionally, this warehouse contains countless amounts of silver.\nThere might also be divine weapons and armor left behind by Zhao Yizong, along with the ultimate martial arts treatise, Long Yizong Gui Zang Gong.
What do you think, #PlayerName#?\nWould you be willing to join me and share the treasures of this Pile-Filling Warehouse?
Cough cough, since both of you brothers agree, I'll go along to broaden my horizons as well.
Why you too, #PlayerName#?
Oh Brother Hao Dali, such an opportunity truly comes around but once in a blue moon.\nWho in the Wulin does not want to see what this famed tomb of Du Dianjian Zhao Yizong looks like?
Well... alright, alright. But I don't want any treasure or world-shaking martial arts skills.\nI was only worried about #PlayerName# and the two brothers' safety, which is why I had to agree.
Good, since the four brave men have agreed to join us, let's establish this alliance here.\nShare in joy and suffer hardship together, dividing the treasures from Zhao Yizong's tomb.
You always give me the premonition that you're about to pull off some scheme... I can't help but be wary.....

Brother Hao, you are mistaken. Now that our interests align, we are in the same boat.\nEven if this lady wanted to play some tricks, I would have to wait until I find the treasure... cough cough cough!
Let me get back to the map in my hand, according to its display.\nZhaoyinzhong's tomb is located near Zhuxian Town in the northwest of the Jingcheng.

We should act quickly and determine the location of the tomb before Blood Shirt Alliance does.\nPlease join me and go to Zhuxian Town to investigate the intelligence.\nAfter finding the location, notify #PlayerName# to come and dig for treasure.
I will await your good news then \nGoodbye!
Fellow brothers! It's been a few days since we last saw each other.\nI hear the rumors about inspecting the tomb have caused quite a stir throughout the city. What on earth is going on here?
#PlayerName#, I've given this matter a lot of thought, but I still can't figure it out.\nYou know, the three of us brothers have always been discreet and reliable in our work.

Hmm.... Maybe that guy Shangguan Feng wanted to foil our plans.\nSo he deliberately spread the word to draw these Wulin individuals here.\nShe would have to join the Bloodcloth Alliance assassins in muddling through.
Since we've come this far, at least we have the map and can gain a step ahead.\nBy the way, where are Miss Songyue and the other two brothers?
They also feared that others might beat them to it, so they went to search the tomb first.\nI deliberately stayed in Zhuxian Town to bring this message to you, #PlayerName#.
Since that's the case, let's set off right away!\nMiss Cong Mang and the two brothers are, after all, at a disadvantage. If they encounter Blood Robe Alliance members in the tomb, it won't be good.
Though our three brothers are skilled in martial arts, two hands ultimately can't match four.\n#PlayerName#, go gather some helpers. We'll meet in the tomb.
...I've always been worried that my two brothers might have met with some misfortune in the tomb....\nNo no, I'll take my leave first!
Ok, Brother Dali, take care. I'll be right behind you.
You followed the markers on the map and finally located the whereabouts of Duidianjian's tomb.\nBefore a barren hillock overgrown with weeds stood a stark grave marker with no inscriptions.
Is this really the tomb of Deputy Inspector Dou... It's quite unremarkable.
This wordless stele is mysterious in meaning. Is it meant to leave the merits and faults for future generations to judge?\nFrom this, it seems that Zhao Yizong truly has exceptional breadth of mind.

Circling around to the back of the hill, they found that the black tomb door was already wide open.\nThere were numerous weapons and bloodstains scattered by the door, clearly indicating a fierce fight had taken place.

Truly, it seems that the Bloodclothes Alliance or other Wulin individuals have also discovered this place.\nWe have to hurry and go inside to compete for the treasure with Miss Cuomeng and the others!
After facing countless dangers, we finally arrive at the entrance of the main tomb.\nUh... Brother Hao Dali, why are your nose and face swollen?
Ah, never mind. You fell for that witch's trick again!\nWe were supposed to go together, but that thief wife insisted on me leading the way in front.
The tomb passage was already dimly lit, and I stumbled into a hidden tunnel with a single misstep.\nIf not for being strong and healthy, he might have really died here.
Ouch, ouch. Senior Brother, you just fell down, but I've suffered a lot more than that.
Oh, Brother Wu Mou, why does your butt have an arrow stuck in it?
Ouch, that really hurts...\nNot yet, Little Auntie Songmen…That witch harmed me!

Before they were walking along smoothly, that wretched woman had to go and pull the sword out of the statue's hand.\nThe hidden weapon mechanism triggered, and I couldn't dodge in time; I got arrowed in the butt right there...
Dog thief! Daring to compete with your grandpa Wang Cai for treasure, here's my move!
Brother Wang Cai, it's me! What's with your eyes? They're red and swollen.
Cough cough cough, #PlayerName#? You're finally here!\nWe three brothers were thoroughly ruined by that wicked woman!

That wretched woman knew there was a mechanism on the tomb room door, yet she encouraged us to believe that there were nothing but piles of gold and treasure behind it.\nI rushed forward to push the door and was sprayed with toxic smoke in the face and hair.\nMy eyes still can't focus properly!
Wang Cai, how could you be tempted by greed and betray your principles!\nI had warned that this wench's sudden offer to collaborate was unlikely to have good intentions.
Ah, three brothers and Miss Cheng Wu entered this tomb together.\nI guessed there wouldn't be anything good, but I didn't expect it to be this terrible...
Where is Miss Cumei now, my three brothers? Do you have any clues?
That wretched woman left the three of us behind and rushed into the main tomb chamber.\nWe were just about to follow her in and have a proper talk with her, but lo and behold, it's you, #PlayerName#.
Cough cough cough cough, #PlayerName#, you gotta speak up for the three of us brothers!\nBack then, we clearly agreed to split five million taels of silver among the five of us.
Wang Cai! It's already this late, how can you still be thinking about that five million taels?
Alright alright, three brothers \nLet's head to the main tomb chamber right away to see what's going on.
If there really are any treasures, we can discuss dividing the money later.
Haha, I've got another one \nAlthough there was no body of Du Dianjian in the coffin, it hid many treasures.
It's only fair to take more things... After all the trouble I went through...\nOkay, take this too.....
Cunmeng Xiaomei, long time no see!\nOlder Sister, I searched for you with great hardship.
Shangguan Feng, how did you find your way here?

Haha, dear younger sister, I have my Blood Clothing Alliance spies all over the Jiangnan region.\nWith so many Wulin practitioners helping to search, finding a grave is as simple as picking something from your pocket.
Alright, no more idle chatter. Quickly tell them where the fengzhuang ku is located!\nConsidering our past, I'll spare your life, Older Sister.
(Silently putting the things in her embrace)\nSister, I have already searched the area thoroughly. It seems the sealed storage does not exist within this tomb.
Although there's no Treasury Seal, there are still some gold and jewels as grave goods in this coffin.\nIf Older Sister desires it, I will give you half of what I have.
Hmph, such flimsy jewels wouldn't catch Blood Cloak Alliance's eye.\nI traveled great lengths just to obtain the five hundred thousand taels of silver in the treasury!
Haha, since the older sister doesn't want them, I'll take them all.\nGoodbye!
Haha, that won't work!\nNo one is leaving until I find the containment vault!
You hid by the door, able to see everything inside the tomb chamber clearly.
It seems Miss Congming is surrounded by the Blood Clothing Alliance. What are we to do...
Brilliant! This is indeed splendid!
Very good, what's very good? Brother Two, are you losing your mind?

Oh, Senior Brother, look at this woman and the Blood Robe Alliance fighting to the death, leaving both severely injured.\nWe aren't just like the mantis catching the cicada, with the oriole waiting behind?
Haha, brilliant!\nWith that witch dead, can't we split the five million taels among the four of us?\nHow much can each person get... Let me take out the abacus and calculate properly...
How can that be! We had a pact first.\nAlthough the old witch is unkind, can I Hao Dali be unjust?
The Blood Robe Alliance has been committing crimes for a long time and should have been arrested a long time ago.\nI, Captian Hao, am here to meet you!
Ah ah ah, Senior Brother, why did you charge in again?\nWell, since it's come to this, I Wang Cai will fight you to the end!
Two brothers... Well, it looks like I've ended up with these two idiots, Wu Mou really has no sense!\nBlood-Covered Alliance, taste my Wu investigator's skills!

Alright, the Bloodrobe Alliance has been committing numerous evil deeds. Today, they can't get away with it anymore.\nMoreover, to stand idly by while others suffer is not the deed of a great hero. I will go with you!
How could you... I clearly...
Well, I should have seen that Lady Cuomu would hold back. But I also have reinforcements on my side.\nBind them all up, don't let any of them escape!
Evil rogue, release Miss Cuomeng!
Hmph, Little Crimson-Meadow's ability to hire such a skilled aide makes this situation rather troublesome.
Pity! I know quite a few skilled warriors.\nThere are experts who are a hundred times more powerful than #PlayerName#......
Haha, that's right! Indeed we are the three brothers!\nLittle thief, don't you dare surrender quickly?
Solve those three dumb constables first!
Ouch, #PlayerName# help!
Constable, leave my Blood Clothes Alliance affairs alone next time!
Well, Detective Hao insists on getting involved!
The tomb chamber is narrow, making it difficult to move freely.\nYou are surrounded by the Bloodrobe Clan Assassins; neither side has gained an advantage yet.
#PlayerName#, fellow brothers, you go ahead first...\nI have my own way to extricate myself.
Miss Chen, this...
No! Though you are a thief, the orphans you have adopted are innocent.\nIf anything were to happen to you, wouldn't they be heartbroken?
Just go ahead and take the valuables, you sneaky woman.\nIsn't there still a child with a serious illness waiting for you to buy medicine for them?
Keep my treasure for me first \nIf I can make it out alive, Wang Cai promises to come find you and get it back.
You three... sold out and are counting the money instead of the people.\nReally... utterly stupid!
Haha, well said. Though I, Hao Dali, may be foolish, I live with an open heart and a clear conscience.\nBandit woman, get going! We three brothers will hold them off here!
Am I also stupid? No way!\nThis…Do you understand what it means to act foolishly for wisdom?
Damn, bandits are coming again! Fellow warriors, form the Linked Three Tribulations Array, now!!!
Can't move? Kill them all for me!
At this critical moment, I heard commotion outside the door.\nSomeone shouted in surprise：Flying Dragon Sect is here!
A hint of cold light arrived first, followed by a dragon-like gun blast.\nA armored figure strode forward and effortlessly countered all of Shangguan Feng's moves!
Bold thief, daring to cause mischief in my father's tomb!
Father... You are Zhao Yizong's adopted son and the Sect Leader of Flying Dragon Sect named Zhao Polu?
On account of your knowing my name, I'll spare your life!
The two engaged in combat for only a few exchanges, with Shangguan Feng consistently on the defensive.\nSeeing the situation worsening, he hastily blew a whistle.
Adjacent assassins from the Bloodclothes Alliance released hidden weapons, spraying toxic smoke.\nShangguan Feng retreated in a panic under everyone's cover.
The Flying Dragon Sect martial arts are indeed profound. We shall meet again!
Hmph. If that little thief dares to come back to the territory of Flying Dragon Sect and cause trouble again, there will be no mercy!
Dog thief, do not flee!
Fellow brothers, with the enemy many and us few, it's better not to pursue them...
Hold on, why are the four of you in my father's grave?\nIsn't he thinking of coming to rob a tomb too!
Cough cough, Zhao, Sect Leader Zhao, there is more to this matter...
Oh? Tell me about it!
This......that......

(with clasped hands and fist, kneeling on one knee)\nReporting to Sect Leader Zhao! We are three constables from Flying Dragon Sect.\nRecently, I heard rumors that grave robbers are planning to target the tomb of the late Sect Leader Du Dianjian. That's why they have come here to investigate specifically.
This #PlayerName# is a renowned martial artist who has long been famous in the Jianghu.\nThese are aids I have enlisted to help catch the thief.
Ah yes yes yes! I'm here to help catch the thief, ha ha, ha ha.
Hmph. This matter of catching the thief is internal business for Flying Dragon Sect.\nWhy didn't you report this to your superiors instead of bringing in #PlayerName#, a stranger?
If this gets out, won't my Flying Dragon Sect be ridiculed by the Wulin?

Emergency arises, and #PlayerName# just happened to be nearby.\nTo prevent the Sect Leader's tomb from falling into the hands of thieves and being poisoned, subordinates acted out of desperation.\nPlead for mercy, Sect Leader!
Well, considering your Loyalty efforts, it's only fitting that you've successfully repelled the enemy this time.\nThis Sect Leader won't pursue this further
Sect Leader is wise! Subordinate shall dedicate every drop of blood and tear, and devote oneself entirely...

Alright, let's get to the point. No need for formalities.\nAs you can see, although this is the grave of my uncle by marriage, Zhao Yizong,\nBut after all, it was just a symbolic tomb, so the sect did not assign heavy guards to it.

I never expected tomb raiders to be so insane, wantonly excavating tombs and disturbing the departed spirits of a generation's hero.\nTrue virtue is waning in these times, and human hearts have strayed from their ancient ways.
Yeah yeah, grave robbers are really despicable! #PlayerName#, you agree, right!
Ah? Yes...
Haha

Now in these turbulent times, with the world yet to find peace, the various sects are plotting against each other, each harboring sinister intentions.\nOur sect suffered a great calamity during the previous imperial ceremony on Mount Tai. My adoptive father and several high-ranking generals are all unaccounted for.\nWith the elite forces within depleted, it is now the time to rebuild and seek new talent.

Unfortunately, I, Zhao Polu, have mediocre talent and no grand ambitions. My martial arts fall far short of my adoptive father's, barely reaching one-tenth of his skill.\nWant to revive the Flying Dragon Sect but always fall short with just enough strength to maintain the status quo.

Now that the three of you junior constables have stepped forward to alleviate our burden and guard the vigil for Master Brother, I am exceedingly relieved.\nIf all the warriors of Flying Dragon Sect were like you, they would surely one day gain fame across the seas and intimidate all sides, reviving their former glory!
Today, I hereby promote you three to direct disciples of our sect!\nI hope you remain humble in victory and resilient in defeat, and continue to serve our sect with loyalty.
Thanks, Sect Leader! With your great affection, the three brothers promise not to disappoint you!
Is this considered a blessing in disguise?
Haha, now we three brothers are finally making it big!

#PlayerName#'s timely assistance was equally indispensable \nWe of the Flying Dragon Sect always show gratitude and revenge when owed, never forgetting a favor or a grudge.\nThese silver coins are to be paid as compensation for this occasion; please accept them!
I cannot refuse such courtesy, so thank you, Sect Leader Zhao.

I will station a strong garrison hereafter to ensure that no petty villains can disturb my honored father's spirit again.\nI must pay my respects to my adopted father here, so I won't see you all off. Goodbye!
Sect Leader Zhao, please take your time grieving. Goodbye!
Huh~What a close call! If Sect Leader Zhao discovers that we came to rob a tomb,\nThis time, we'll definitely be eating it out of our own pockets.
Haha, the mountain dweller just threw in a few words.\nDidn't you just trick Sect Leader Zhao over?
Third Brother, I think you've become overconfident!\nIf you misbehave again in the future, you probably won't have such good luck.
Hehe, Senior Brother, you are right. I won't do it again, I swear...\nHow come I don't see Lady Cumer?…Where's the thief woman?
Hasn't been seen for a long time.....\nIt must have taken advantage of the fight between Sect Leader Zhao and Shangguan Feng to slip away with its spoils.
But my treasure is still with her!\nA darned wench! Truly, I am furious!

Oh, Second Brother, don't worry just yet. Although we didn't find any treasure this time,\nBut thanks to Master Zhaohao's appreciation, the three brothers were promoted to direct disciples of Flying Dragon Sect.
The future career prospects are undoubtedly bright and promising!\nWhat's this tiny treasure worth worrying about? Might as well give it to that thief woman.
Sigh... Third Brother makes a very valid point, but... I can't help feeling a bit unsatisfied!

What am I unwilling about? This ill-gotten gain, even if offered to me, I would not accept!\nFrom now on, as direct disciples of Flying Dragon Sect, we can no longer make mistakes that would tarnish our sect's reputation!
Alright alright, yeah yeah, we'll follow Senior Brother's orders.
#PlayerName#, thank you for your help this time.
From now on, we three brothers will be people who can speak up in the Flying Dragon Sect.\nRelax, fellow brothers will definitely not forget you, #PlayerName#.

If ever #PlayerName# runs into any trouble in the future, feel free to come find me, Wu Mou.\nWho cares about those monsters and demons? With my clever plan, I'm sure to make him suffer.~Come~None~Back~
Good! Congrats to the three brothers then. Goodbye.

(Watching the three brothers happily leave, he couldn't help but sigh.)\nI've heard that Zhao Polu has been competing for power with Little Zhu Ge at Flying Dragon Sect for a long time.\nIt seems this is also aimed at cultivating his own Loyalty faction.

While the brothers may seem silly, they have had some good fortune this time and successfully advanced in their official career.\nBut who knows whether being drawn into Zhao Polu's circle will bring fortune or misfortune in the future...
Miss Chenmou, I saw the pigeon post \nRarely do you suddenly change your mind and not hog the loot.\n...even proactively invited us to come and share it...
Haha, deep down, my heart is also in turmoil.\nAfter much consideration, I finally made up my mind.
After all, before in the tomb, if it weren't for your #PlayerName# and those three idiots beating Shangguan Feng,\nFearing I shall fall victim to this disaster.
Though I'm a thief, I still have some sense of chivalry.\nIf one still fails to repay such kindness, they truly deserve to be considered no better than pigs and dogs.

Ah, you're still being so kind...\nTo be honest, Miss Congming has excellent martial arts skills, and her lightness technique is unparalleled.\nJoining any sect can also secure one's prosperity and nobility.
Why live in constant fear, always on the run?\nTo engage in such sneakery?
Haha, #PlayerName# doesn't know that \nI was sold to the Changle Gang by my parents from a young age, starting as a cleaner and eventually becoming a renowned performer.
Drunk in the winehouses of these many years,\nWhile accustomed to false affection and superficial interactions, they braved the coldness of human hearts and the vicissitudes of joy and sorrow.

Seeing the ugly faces of so-called noble clans and upright gentlemen too often,\nI deeply feel that one cannot trust people in this world, be they birth parents or close friends.\nIn this cold Jianghu, one can rely only on oneself.
Later, after escaping from the Changle Gang, I took up the trade of a gentleman on the roof.\nBecause only schemes in one's heart and silver coins in hand will never betray oneself.

Haha, not until meeting #PlayerName# and those three little constables did I.\nI only now realize that there are people in the Jianghu who truly carry passion and chivalry in their hearts.\nMaybe making friends with you four idiots isn't such a bad thing...
Four fools... Am I included in that as well....
Haha, proximity to vermilion tends to red, proximity to ink tends to black.\n#PlayerName#, you spend all day with those three idiots and inevitably ended up just like them.
Well, well, I never expected Miss Cuomeng to have such a tumultuous experience.\nNo wonder they act so capriciously...
Mischievous and unrestrained? Am I mischievous and unrestrained?!
Cough cough cough, no, no\n(None of them even have the self-awareness to realize they've all been listed as one of the Seven Evil People...)
That's good... Let me get back to the point. I brought out a total of three treasures from Dudpian's tomb.

内容:
One is the long weapon secret manual of Flying Dragon Sect, *Eight Directions and Six Seas Spear*.
Secondly, a divine weapon and a magical armor piece.
Thirdly, several rare treasures and a beautifully adorned saddle.
#PlayerName#, you can take any one of them. The rest will be divided between me and those three idiots.
Good,#PlayerName#'s part is already taken care of. Now we just need to deal with those three idiots...\nStrangely enough, I clearly arranged to meet them today. Why are they not here yet so late...
Thief old woman! Haha, I finally found you!
Hmph, really think to corrupt and degrade the three brothers with filth? Dream on!
Now we three brothers have been promoted to Flying Dragon Sect Censor.\nThose who wish to avoid fleshly suffering had better surrender quickly!
Ah well, it seems you three don't want this one? Very well, then this Miss will take it, hehe.\n#PlayerName#, we'll meet again another time. Goodbye!
Thief woman, don't run!!
Watching the three chase Murong Xingchen away,\nYou couldn't help but shake your head and laugh bitterly.
Miss Congming walk slowly...\nThree brothers, stop chasing them. With your lightness, you'd run yourselves into exhaustion and still not catch up.....
At the United Forces headquarters, Dian Luo, Jingang, Tianshan, and Kongtong factions gathered together.\nOne could say that top talents have gathered here, creating a spectacle like never before.
Only to see King Yama clad in armor standing atop the alliance platform.\nArching hands in a fist, striking with strong force.
Thank you all Sect Leaders for coming from afar to attend this conference meeting.\nThe reason for inviting all of you here is something I'm sure you are already well aware of.

Since Crown Prince Zhou Shizong Chai Rong's death and the subsequent failure of Du Dianjian Zhao Yinzong's ceremony at Mount Tai,\nWarriors rise from across the Central Plains, and chaos reigns over the land. The court is weak, its decrees unheeded.

Now, with the various sects controlling their own territories and maneuvering against each other, they are like scattered sand, posing no concern.\nBy contrast, our various schools in the western regions beyond the border have strong armies and numerous experts, well-prepared and constantly training their troops.

Now that Dali has fallen, the Emei Sect has retreated to the mountains and no longer poses a threat to my rear territories.\nTaking advantage of this favorable opportunity, if we unite and advance together into Central Plains,\nSure to be overwhelming, like splitting bamboo, with momentum devouring miles like a tiger!
A hero, one who harbors great aspirations and possesses wise stratagems,\nThose who harbor the mechanisms of the universe and the ambition to swallow and breathe in the heavens and earth.

Today, all of you present as Sect Leaders are martially unparalleled and the talents of an era.\nOne might come to judge situations and understand matters clearly.\nFinding this alliance to be a move with many benefits and no drawbacks.

I hope you all can join forces fully and don't let this old man down.\nAfter we conquer the Central Plains, we shall share the world between us.\nWe can all seize this opportunity to achieve extraordinary feats and establish foundations for a century to come!
These words rang out strong and clear, resonating through the air.\nThe crowd on the field was enthusiastic, nodding in agreement one after another.
Om mani padme hum. The Pavilion Master's wisdom is profound, each word a gem.\nThe old monk, as if doused by amrita, awakens from a great dream. May I follow Your Majesty Yan Temple Master's lead!

Haha, our Tianshan Sect has long dwelled in the bitter cold.\nHearing about the fertile fields stretching for miles in the Central Plains, I've longed to head south to test my skills.\nSuch a good opportunity, naturally, I cannot miss it.

Why so much idle chatter? I've long been displeased with those noble and righteous factions in the Central Plains.\nOne by one, they are properly dressed, yet all are nothing but frauds and deceivers.\nLord Yan wants to compete for supremacy in Central Plains-count us from Kongtong Sect!
Good. Since all three Sect Leaders agree,\nSo today, the four factions formally establish their alliance here to jointly attack Central Plains and divide the world!
To be honest, where is Dragon Palm Daoist Long Feng'e from the Five Poisons Sect?
Hmph. The Five Poisons Sect failed to obtain Dali previously.\nI believe Dragon Palm Sect's heart was unsatisfied, which is why it refused to participate in the alliance meeting today.
No problem, after we stabilize Central Plains in the future.\nShe will rue her actions bitterly
Today, I am gathering you not just for this alliance,\nIt's also to invite all of you to witness our first battle in Central Plains.\nExactly to capture this place, Alliance of Justice!

This Alliance of Justice is located in a remote area and has weakened forces. They are currently facing financial difficulties and need assistance to strengthen their position.\nThe great sects in the Central Plains are far away, making rescue difficult to begin with.

This Sect Leader, Wan Renshan, not only fails to recognize the situation, refusing to join our allied forces,\nWhile frequently assisting the Emei Sect, they consistently work against us at every turn.

Have you not heard what Han Feizi said?：Small in size but not contemptible, weak in strength but not fearful of the strong,\nThose who treat great neighbors with rudeness and contempt, and are greedy and incompetent in their dealings, can perish.

Therefore, in the first battle of the allied forces, I intend to make the Alliance of Justice my target.\nOn one hand, removing this pin planted by the Central Plains Wulin in the southwest to eliminate any future troubles.

On the other hand, as a warning to others, they raised the flag at Alliance of Justice to assert their authority.\nIt's also to deter those neutral small sects and factions in Central Plains.\nTo prevent them from taking a chance and hindering our military operations again.

Now that my Yama Palace forces are already prepared.\nOnly with a single command from this old man can the Alliance of Justice be utterly erased.\nUnknown to the three Sect Leaders, how do you see this?
Master Yan plans far into the future; the old monk cannot compare.
Why bother making such a big fuss about exterminating a small sect like the Alliance of Justice?
Oh, I thought there would be something really grand.\nNo time to lose, better get started!
A bull blade for killing a chicken-today's battle, Yama Palace is more than sufficient.\nAll Sect Leaders can just observe from the sidelines and await good news. I've embarrassed myself!
Commander Wu, order the Black and White Dual Ghosts to prepare for the advance.
Hmph, got it

Sect Leader! I came as soon as I received the message from the homing pigeon.\nNow that Yama Palace has allied with several sects, their military power is formidable and irresistible. While correcting, I wonder if Master Wan Sheng has any strategies to deal with this?
Now that we are here, there is no other way.\nOnly through battle can our resolve be made clear!
The enemy is strong; why not temporarily retreat...

#PlayerName#, this place is the foundation of our Alliance of Justice for a hundred years. How could I readily abandon it?\nBesides, even if we barely manage to survive, with such a vast world, where could we go?

Now that chaos looms over Central Plain, how can any egg remain unbroken when the nest is shattered?\nFor now, all we Alliance of Justice can do is fight with everything we have, and die to make our resolve clear!
Today, we invite #PlayerName# to witness this \nTo warn the Central Plains martial arts world of the brutality of this battle.
If by sacrificing our Alliance of Justice, we can rally the Central Plain's Wulin to unite against the evil sects,\nThat shall not be in vain for our final battle today!

Sect Leader Wansheng! During the battle in Dali previously, your Alliance of Justice provided us with great assistance.\nNow that Mount Wuyi has stepped back from the world's strife, my #PlayerForceName# hero still stands.
Today's battle, I, #PlayerForceName#, pledge to stand alongside the Alliance of Justice, sharing both fortune and misfortune!

Alright, a man's worth is shown when he dies with iron will. Now, let's see if we can mend the heavens!\n#PlayerName# upheld the code of brotherhood, not in vain did we fight side by side for all these days!
Such heroic spirit, ought to have a big toast.\nWhy, with the enemy troops arrived and battle drums sounding, Alliance of Justice disciples, draw your swords!
Gates gather Loyalty hearts, forging steel with righteous bonds. Severing villains and eradicating evil, their valor endures.\nDisciples of the Alliance of Justice, follow me!
On the brink of death, do you still have the mood to recite poetry?\nYou won't cry until you see the coffin!
Don't cry!
The enemy force is strong; we cannot engage in a direct confrontation.\nIt seems we must first leverage the fortitude of the city walls to thoroughly defend ourselves before slowly taking action.
Haha, thought the Alliance of Justice couldn't withstand a single blow.\nSurprisingly, you're quite combat-effective
But with one move from this lady, the outcome became clear.\nYou don't need to fight desperately anymore!
A trapped beast still fights, and a hero would not die without resistance.\nDog thief, today let you see the spirit of the Central Plains Wulin!

The Alliance of Justice members fight with the Yama Palace disciples as if facing death, engaging in close combat.\nThe situation was so severe that it could be described as ghostly wails and wolf howls, with the heavens and earth changing color. The battle entered a temporary stalemate.

The Sect Leader of Wan Renshan seemed like a divine being incarnated, clad in multiple wounds, with blood-stained robes.\nStill standing tall outside the Alliance of Justice's main entrance, his gaze intense and unwavering.
Well, what a Alliance of Justice, just like those relentless cockroaches that never die in swarms.\nI underestimated you all!
Just then, suddenly sand flew and stones rolled, making heaven and earth obscured in darkness.\nAccompanied by a tiger's roar and dragon's cry, a black hurricane swept towards Wan Renshan.
Arriving here is the newly appointed Deputy Head of Yama Palace, Wu Jueyi!
Hmph! A bunch of failures-this seat has to take personal action!
Sect Leader Wan, be careful!
(The figure suddenly staggered back three steps, but still stood firm!)\nOh!
Okay!\nTruly a man! Even after being shot, I remain standing firm!
(Coughed up a mouthful of blood)puff...... Of course!\nGather Loyalty subjects... Forge with righteous steel... How could you demons and heretics understand?
Haha, what bullshit principles. I only know that the weak are prey to the strong, and the victor is king!\nTo blame it, blame your poor martial arts skills. Come on and attack!
Hm, come on!
The bandits kept coming one after another, seemingly endless.\nWe are now exhausted, and I'm unsure how much longer we can hold out...
Haha, #$PlayerName#, your martial arts are quite good. With time, you'll surely become a great master.\nRegrettably, it is a waste to lose strength at the Alliance of Justice.

#PlayerName#'s martial arts are truly capable of turning a collapsing tide and supporting a tottering edifice.\nWe Alliance of Justice disciples should also take this as an example and bravely fight our enemies!
#$PlayerName#, you haven't mastered the skills yet. Go practice and come back another time!
Ugh... Truly, the Leader of the Seven Evil Ones, Apotheosis of Coldheartedness, lives up to its reputation!\nEven with an arm missing, they still possess such power.
By this point, Yama Palace has suffered significant losses.\nBut after all, with many on their side, they still maintained a formidable military presence.

By contrast, the Alliance of Justice faction had long been in a state of widespread devastation and heavy casualties.\nMost of the skilled practitioners inside the gates have already sustained severe injuries, leaving only a few disciples making their final stand.

Sect Leader Wan! Although your Alliance of Justice has diminished in strength, you have still managed to hold back my Yama Palace's army until now.\nUnited in resolve, not a step back-such willpower truly deserves my utmost admiration!

Too bad today as my great army now stands before your city walls; ye have no chance of victory.\nIs it really worth risking the lives of all the factions at the Alliance of Justice just for a posthumous reputation?

I still hope, Sect Leader of Dali, you will review the situation and follow the example of Emei Sect's contribution to Dali.\nAs long as you surrender with your city, I can assure you that my side will not make things difficult for the heroes of your faction. You will be treated leniently.
......By this time today, we are at our wits' end, with no ammunition left and no food.\nThe Alliance of Justice can be surrendered both upstairs and down, but my Wan Renshan cannot be betrayed!

Gather the Loyalty and virtuous, forge them into sturdy steel, strike down the wicked, let their heroism be remembered, this is our ancestral law, and must never be violated!\nIf Wan Renshan were to yield to the tyrannical threats of the villains, how could I face my ancestors at Alliance of Justice in the underworld?
Good! Since Sect Leader Wan has resolved to sacrifice himself for a greater cause, this old man will see it through for you!

(Diana flew forward and personally sparred with Wan Renshan for several moves.\nThe two had a significant disparity in power, and Wan Renshan had even sustained severe injuries before.\nBefore long, danger surrounded them, leaving them unable to defend.)

(seizing the opportunity, King Yama concentrated all his spiritual power on the blade to perform his signature technique：Knife Technique for Murder!\nA slicing blade of energy, accompanied by a whirlwind of dust, raced straight towards Wan Renshan.)
(Avoidance Is Unavoidable, So I Must Give It My All)\n!!!!!!
Sect Leader!!!

Seeing Master Palm about to be executed on the battlefield, you feel a surge of blood rushing to your head,\nWhat to do when the opponent is truly an expert like a cloud of masters... whether to intervene and lend a hand...

The allied forces of the heterodox factions are strong in both manpower and resources, making a formidable show of force that cannot be resisted by any single faction.\nFor now, we can only prepare for battle day and night.
