Yeah, with no way out, I started doing this gentleman thief stuff.\nNow known among the people of the Jianghu as the Four Ugly Bandits, he has achieved some measure of fame.
Hmph, Masked Bandits Quartet? You go too far!\nBeauty or ugliness is bestowed by heaven at birth; judging a person by their appearance is not the deed of a gentleman.
I see your four brothers have formidable skills; they will surely achieve great things in the future.\nHow about changing it to Four Legendary Thieves?
Four Legendary Thieves? Great name! Great name!\nBrother, I raise a glass to you!

Young Lord possesses martial arts that are beyond mortal comprehension, and surprisingly, they do not disdain our four brothers' crude appearances.\nYou're one of the rare good guys I've come across, and I'll raise a glass to you!
Haha, as long as one harbors a heart of chivalry, they are all my fellow brothers Zhao Yinzong.\nCome on, let's do it!

Now that the world is not yet at peace and villains are rising up.\nThose hypocrites are truly repulsive \nZhao Zhengning would rather die than associate with him! Brothers, you say that's true or not.
(Lifted the wine jar and drank several gulps)\nRight! Right! Right! You said it, Brother!
Several people clinked glasses and exchanged toasts, showing a mutual regret for not meeting sooner. They continued eating and drinking for a while.\nBefore long, the sky began to grow dim.

Several brothers, the wine we drank today was truly delightful. Too bad that all gatherings must come to an end.\nSeeing that it's growing late, Brother, I still need to escort Jingniang to Henei Township.
Stay overnight in Henei Township and continue on our journey to the Jingcheng tomorrow.\nIt's late, so brother I'll take my leave first. We'll meet again another time!
Zhao Yizong and Jing Niang bid farewell to the Four Brothers together.\nThen he stepped out of the inn and approached the Red-Spotted Scales, ready to dismount and depart.
Miss, traveling to Henei Township from here will still be several hundred miles.\nWe must hurry our steps to avoid the sun setting.
Yes, Young Lord......\nAh, Great Heroes, there's no need for you to come out and see us off...
Only the four brothers followed out of the inn without saying much.\nApproaching Zhao Yinzong, they suddenly bowed their heads in unison.
Aye aye aye! What are the four fellows doing?\nAre you trying to break me, little brother!
Young Lord is as righteous as the clouds in the sky, and his martial arts are beyond human comprehension.\nWe four brothers are already in complete admiration!
Not bad; despite our four ugly appearances, you call us brothers.\nSuch demeanor and spirit are truly rare in this world.

We four brothers have wandered in the Jianghu for many years without encountering a wise ruler.\nSeeing you today, I know for certain that you will achieve a magnificent and earth-shaking career in the future.
If you do not discard us, my fellow brothers are willing to follow you faithfully, serving you tea and water.\nIf you do not agree, we four will not be able to rise from this bow!
Ah, we were meant to be brothers, yet you all treat me thusly.\nCome on, come on. Get up first and then we can talk.
Brother Zhao doesn't agree, then we won't get up!

Young Lord Zhao, though I am but a woman,\nYet one can also see that the four of them share a sense of chivalry, and are quite kindred spirits with you.\nThese great heroes are genuinely pleading with you; they really want to become your disciples.

According to Young Lord Zhao, this trip to the Jingcheng is precisely when he wants to establish his career and achievements.\nWhy not accept them as your left and right arms, and work together to plan great affairs? Wouldn't that be a win-win strategy?
Miss saying this is indeed reasonable...\nOkay! Since that's the case, I'll accept the kind offer of the four brothers.
But between us, you must still call me Brother and not treat me as a superior.\nIf the four brothers do not agree, then I fear Brother Zhao cannot comply!
Good, follow Brother Zhao's instructions!
At your service!

Then I beg you four to first escort Miss to Henei Township for a night's rest.\nThe next day, we'll continue our journey to the Jingcheng. After sending Miss back to her household, we can plan our next move!

Brother Zhao, there is one more matter I forgot to report just now.\nThis Henei Township is where the Sandbank Bandits' base of operations resides.\nThe chief of Huangshazhai Fort might also be here right now.

This bandit group from Yellow Sand Village has been operating with impunity in the Jinyang area for many years, making quite a name for themselves.\nLegend has it that their Great Chief's Blade is also superb beyond description and unmatched by anyone.

At the time, the bandits who abducted this Miss to here were likely from Yellow Sand Camp.\nNow, Big Boss is also offering a reward to hunt down Miss.\nIf we were to rush to Henei Township, wouldn't that be walking straight into a trap?

So in my humble opinion, it would be better to avoid their main force and go around them.\nTo avoid a direct conflict with the leader of Huangsha Village, do you think, Brother Zhao, this is acceptable?
So that's it. Since the big boss is in Henei Township... we need to go there even more!
Brother Zhao, how do you mean that?

Fellow brothers, Zhao thanks you for your kindness.\nBut Henei Township is a mandatory pass to Beijing. If we detour, the journey would be far too long and arduous.\nWon't that just cause unnecessary trouble again? This is the first point.

Second, since Big Boss is offering a reward to hunt for Jingshang everywhere,...\nThen even if we detour to send her home now, we still can't escape the possibility that Big Boss will kidnap her later.\nThis is just a temporary fix, not a permanent solution!
Sigh... Brother Zhao, your meaning is...
I will go alone to Henei Township \nChose Big Boss and utterly wiped out all the bandits from Yellow Sand Camp!

Thus, on one hand, it is to alleviate a great harm to the people of Jinyang.\nOn the other hand, this could permanently eliminate any future threats to Miss and prevent her from being endangered again by powerful individuals.

Brother! That Yellow Sand Camp bandit gang is said to have over a hundred members; each one is an old hand at battle.\nAdd to that, the Big Boss's Blade is divine, and he has been famous for a long time.
Brother's martial arts may be strong, but in the end, two fists can't match four hands.\nSuch a suicidal move is truly unwise; I beg you to think it over carefully!

Ladies and gentlemen, back when I was Zhao Yizong in the Guanxi region, I killed the bully Dong Da to protect the bridge and obtained the steed Chi Tan Lin.\nAside from the bandit chief Song Hu in Huangzhou, there was also a notorious thief Li Ziying beaten to death with three sticks in Shuozhou.
Later, they also wiped out King Li Jieniao of Luzhou's family, executing all of their dozens of subordinates.\nHow have I ever feared these spirits and scoundrels over the years?

Four brothers, no need for further words. I'll head to Henei Township right away to meet with the chief of Yellow Sand Grove!\nPleasure having the four brothers escort Jingniang from behind. Just wait for my good news.
If Brother I make a mistake and fall to the Great Boss's hands,\nThen I beg you to take a detour and escort the Miss into the Jingcheng!

After uttering these words, Zhao Yizong's sense of righteousness surged within him, and he roared to the sky.\nThe four brothers saw this and knew they couldn't persuade her, so they could only protect Jingniao and follow behind.
Six people walked quickly in the direction of Henei Township, gradually disappearing from sight.

At that time, as a mere attendant, I witnessed this matter from start to finish.\nHe couldn't help but mutter in amazement. Truly a remarkable event in the Jianghu.\nThus, it remains fresh in memory to this day.

But when I mention this to others in the future, no one seems willing to believe someone like me.\nYet she had once shared such a connection with Zhao Yizong, the future lord who would one day dominate the winds and clouds.
Ah, sometimes the servant wonders if he might have heard or remembered something incorrectly.\nMaybe it's just someone with the same name... It's not certain though.
Shopkeeper, the story you told was quite good.\nThese fifty taels of silver are considered your reward.
Oh, thank you very much, sir! Thank you so much, sir!\nSeveral gentlemen, do you think what I said is the truth?
A smile that's half genuine, half fake-what difference does it make?
The three of you didn't waste any time, stood up, and left the Yue Lai Inn.
Ah, listening to this, I find myself increasingly convinced that Zhao Yizong is a chivalrous man.\nSuch a brave warrior would not become a tyrant like the Bloodclothes League Grand Commander...
Perhaps the defeat in the Taiyue Grand Ceremony was too great of a blow.\nDriven mad by it, he fell into the evil path.
Thus for now, we must continue to follow its lead.\nProceed to the next stop Henei Township。
I wonder if Zhao Yizong will really run into the chief of Yellow Sand Camp in Henei Township.\nWhat great battle will erupt between the two of them again.
Arriving in Henei Township, everything will become clear.\nLet's not waste time; let's go!

You asked around in Henei Township to find someone who might know about the great battle between Zhao Yizong and Huangsha Village many decades ago.\nSadly, this matter occurred so long ago that it is hard to find anyone who experienced it firsthand.
But a few elderly villagers told them that inside the tavern at the village entrance,\nA famous elderly storyteller might know about this.
You heard this and hurriedly went to meet with the person, inquiring about the events of that day.
Cough cough cough. I've heard that several esteemed guests have traveled far just to hear me, an old man, recite stories.\nI am truly overwhelmed by such favor!

I have been telling stories for over thirty years, and I am most skilled in the tales of the Zhou Dynasty's Conquest of the Shang, the Struggle between Chu and Han, and the Three Kingdoms era.\nIf my honored guests do not mind, I shall start with King Wu's campaign against the Shang dynasty...
Old timer, these three stories are all old hat; we've heard them many times before.\nThis time, I came to hear something different.

Oh? These three esteemed guests have refined tastes, so Old Woman must also display her reserved skills.\nToday, I shall talk about the Marriage of Wang Zhaojun, the Usurpation by Wang Mang, or the An Shi Rebellion-what do you think?
These tales, while somewhat novel, are all familiar stories to them.\nWe have come today to hear some lesser-known tales.
Oh? These three honored guests wish to hear a particular story? Please let me know!
Zha Yizong fought fiercely in Huangsha Village, Master.\nDo you know this story?
The storyteller was also startled by this \nHaving understood your intentions, I won't waste any more words.
He adjusted his appearance and firmly struck the gong with his hand.\nA flash of sharp light passed through his eyes, and he seemed to have aged decades.\nIndeed, full of vigor and spirit
Alright, then Grandma will speak of the next segment today. This tale is called：\nFour Odd Thieves Join Forces to Battle Huang Sa Village, Zhao Dianjian Sends Jing Niang a Thousand Miles!

It was said that Inspector Zhao led the Four Legendary Thieves, his brothers, and Zhao Jingniang away from the YueLai Inn.\nHe made his way south without stopping and finally arrived at Henei Township before dark.
Only to see that the streets of Henei Township were empty of people.\nHouse by house, all doors and windows were tightly shut as if avoiding some great calamity.
Several hearts wondered at this, but they continued on ahead.\nFinally, at the end of the street, I see a household hurriedly locking their door.

(It is The last house at the end of the street, it must be clarified first.)\nThis senior brother, what's the situation in the village?\nWhy are all the doors and windows closed, even the inn has shut its doors to guests.
Oh, little brother, you have quite a bold streak. How dare you come into the village at this hour!\nHave you never heard of Yellow Sand Fort's bandits?
Ha ha, we are outsiders passing through. We didn't hear of a place called Huangsa Village.\nThese bandits are really this formidable?

That's quite severe! Huangsha Village has three masters.\nThe third master is named Diguozhou Jinjin. He possesses the Golden Clock Armor and Iron Clothing hard-training martial arts.\nClaims to be unbreakable by knives and unhitable by guns.

The Second Boss is named Zhang Guang'er and boasts impressive lightness.\nClimbing mountains and diving into the sea, it's all as if walking on flat ground.\nClaimed to be able to travel three hundred li per day, even ordinary horses can't keep up.
The Big Boss was even more mysterious, with no one knowing his surname or true name.\nHe wielded his blade with such prowess that for decades, he had never met an equal beyond the pass.
I hear that tomorrow these three masters will lead the elite troops of Yellow Sand Camp.\nCome to Henei Township to capture a young maiden.
Therefore, households in the village remained shut tight, not venturing out.\nThat's exactly why I'm afraid we've run into these troublemakers-we'll end up eating our words!
(Since all three masters are coming here, we might as well do it in one go.\nJust cut him off cleanly and root out all the trouble. )
So it is. Brother, we brought our little sister along and had hoped to do some business in the capital.\nThere's nowhere to go for now. May I beg your kindness to let us stay and rest for one night?
We set off early the next morning and did not linger.\nPlease accept these twenty taels of silver as tonight's room charge.
Oh, with all the chaos, why are you bringing a girl?\nGo ahead then. We have a few empty rooms, so staying overnight shouldn't be a problem.
But bandits will raid the village early tomorrow morning.\nYoung Lord, be more careful and do not provoke a strong man.

内容: The villagers greeted Zhao Yizong and his companions into the house to rest.\nBoil water and cook meals, settling everyone comfortably.

Zhao Yizong and the Four Legendary Thieves discussed their strategy and planned to meet Yellow Sand Camp tomorrow.\nAnd so each returned to their rooms to rest and recharge, leaving no events to speak of for the night.

On that night, Zhao Yizong took advantage of the rare free time to diligently study martial arts, feeling a significant improvement in his skills.\nBefore long, it was early morning of the next day. A sudden burst of horsehoes shattered the silence.
I could see a gang of bandits riding into the village with whoops and whistles, raising a mighty whirlwind of sand.\nThe leader was none other than the legendary Big Boss of Yellow Sand Camp!
And Zhao Yizong and the Four Legendary Thieves followed the plan accordingly.\nDarting out from the side, she blocked the bandits' path.
(Halt your horse and ask loudly)\nWho are you, and why are you blocking my path?
Dare to address you, could you be the Big Chief of Yellow Sand Village?
Not bad, sir. You exude an air of nobility that doesn't seem like that of ordinary folk.\nI wonder what business you have here. Are you perhaps thinking of surrendering and joining us?
I have heard much about the renowned Big Boss of Yellow Sand Village.\nWe have come to offer our treasures today.
Oh? Presenting treasures? What valuable items are these? Show me!
This is a maiden \nI've heard that the Big Boss has been searching for this woman everywhere recently.
The small one and several brothers happened to run into this woman at the YueLai Inn yesterday.\nHe bound her right away and specially prepared her for the Big Boss.
So it is. Very good, very good.\nHow is that Miss doing? Has she been injured at all?
Rest assured, not a single hair was harmed.\nI bound this woman in a secluded place. Please, the boss, come with us to verify her identity.
Zhaoyingzong exchanged glances with the Four Legendary Thieves.\nPreviously, the plan agreed upon last night was to pretend to offer Zhao Jingmiao to the Big Master.
First take this person to a secluded place, then act together to execute him on the spot.\nAfter Huangsha Village was left leaderless, it naturally became easier to deal with.
No rush, I still have something to take care of.\n(Saying this, he untied the burlap sack from another horse and threw the two robbers to the ground.)
Brothers, when I founded this Yellow Sand Village, I established three rules.
Do not rob the poor, do not kidnap virtuous women, and do not fight with fellow village brothers.\nViolators will be dealt with severely by this big boss!
These two were originally scouting intelligence around the Jingcheng when they saw a Miss as beautiful as a flower.\nHe couldn't resist his desires and rashly made a move to kidnap.
After that, the two of them fought to death over this woman, killing several fellow travelers in the process.\nThis way, even the two rules of Bad Camp are violated beyond forgiveness.

To strictly enforce discipline, our leader has decided to execute these two individuals on the spot today.\nThen send back the captured misses along the same path, gentlemen. Do you have any objections?
Hold on! Boss, spare him!
Oh? Second Boss Zhang, what insightful opinion do you have?
Big Boss, these two are confidants of mine and Third Boss. They have some familial connections as well.\nIf we just kill him now, it won't look good for us and our subordinates.
Why not let them off this time, Elderly Sir.\nAfter we return, I will definitely give him some good education.
Right! Just because bandit brothers raided for a woman, what's the issue?\nBig Boss, I think you're making a mountain out of a molehill. You're basically looking for trouble.
This way, Big Boss, you're giving us two brothers face.\nWhy not pretend nothing happened and everyone can be happy about it?
Hmph, masters two, there are laws in the country and rules in the village.\nIf one tolerates their subordinates acting recklessly, what's the difference from bandits and robbers?
Hey, we're robbers and bandits by nature...
Third Master! Stop talking nonsense.\nIt seems Big Boss means to execute these two on the spot, right?
Not bad! Second Boss, don't you agree?
Since Big Boss has made up his mind, how could there be any reason to disagree?\nBoss, go ahead!
Okay! Since that's the case,\nThen before all these brothers, I shall execute these two villains on the spot!

Those two villains looked like they were about to die, their faces pale as death, crying out for their father and mother.\nThe Great Principal didn't waste any words and raised his precious sword to chop over both of their heads.
It was too late to say, when the Second Boss Zhang Guang'er suddenly bellowed loudly.：Move!\nHe shot out countless hidden weapons from his hands, targeting the Great Boss's back.
At the same time, it was clearly pre-planned.\nThird Master Zhou Jin drew his twin swords and sliced downward towards the First Master!
(Unhurriedly dodging the dual daggers, he was caught off guard and hit by several darts)\nAh! You two household heads have dared to rebel!

Master, don't blame your brother for being unbrotherly; you should blame yourself for being heartless.\nYou risked your life for me for so many years, yet you won't even give this woman a little face.

Brother Two need not waste words here; all are our confidants.\nEveryone rushed to settle things with the Big Boss first before looking for the Young Miss.\nHehe hehe, you'll be the new groom tonight!
Haha, haha, I never thought those two brats would suddenly be so bold as to forcibly take a woman.\nSo it was the Second Boss who gave the orders!
Hmph, Zhao Jingniang is a beauty like the moon, and I fell for her at first glance, Brother.\nIf not for Big Boss's own rules, I would have already taken her by force.

Big Boss, you've set too many ridiculous rules. The brothers in the camp have long been discontented.\nBeing a bandit still doesn't allow me to do wrong and indulge in luxury, it's really too suffocating.
Master, we've been brothers for so many years.\nAcknowledge defeat and beg for mercy; brothers will only torture your tendons.\nLet you have a way to live, how about that?

Hm, I founded Huangsha Village with the intention of upholding justice and bringing order to the chaotic world.\nHow could we let it fall into the hands of these two villains, aiding evil and causing chaos in the world!
Go ahead and attack together \nToday, let you all experience my Big Boss's Blade!
Big Boss, since you remain stubborn, don't blame us for being ruthless, Brother.\nLet me see you off with peace of mind-here, take this!

Seeing Great Boss surrounded and attacked by a group of bandits, in grave danger.\nZhao Yinzong held his spear and was about to step forward to help, but was blocked by the Four Bandits with one hand.
Brother Zhao, what do you mean by this?\nNow that the bandits are fighting each other, they can settle it with life and death.\nWe gain from sitting it out; why join this muddy waters?
From the words of the Big Boss, it seems he is also a man of chivalry.\nSuch brave heroes would never sit idly by and let someone die.
Oh, Brother Zhao, don't be confused \nWhat hero are you? Just a fleeting bandit at the end of the day. No matter how good you think you are, where can you really go from there?
A hero is judged by his deeds, not his origin; whether a bandit or a beggar,\nAs long as you have a heart for chivalry, you are my Zhao Yinzong's brother.
Four brothers, aren't you also thieves? Why do you disdain bandits now?\nIf you are unwilling to lend a hand, I can go alone!
Brother Zhao makes a reasonable point \nBy the way Lord Greatview speaks and behaves, he should also be a heroic figure.\nShould not fall into the hands of pests like Zhang Guer and Zhou Jin.
Not bad; we four have already made a pact.\nTo be by Brother Zhao's side on horse and off, it makes no sense not to join in battle!
Ah, what the senior brothers say is true; I was a bit hasty just now.\nBrother Zhao, let's go and give them a good beating today!
Kill them all!
Okay, Da Dangjia, don't panic! We five are here to help you!
(Hearing that someone was aiding him, he instantly wore a look of joy,\nBut upon seeing Zhao Yizong and the others, hope faded once again.)
Ah, this brother is still young and likely has not yet attained great prowess.\nThe other four are described as peculiar in appearance and do not seem like martial artists.
These Second Boss and Third Boss have a rather ruthless style of martial arts.\nSeveral brothers, let's hurry. There's no need to waste your lives here.
Help me by sending Zhao Jingmang back to the Jingcheng. Don't let her fall into the hands of the Second Boss.\nIf I survive this trial, I shall surely repay you with generous gifts.
I never thought that the chief of Yellow Sand Village would be a man of great principle.\nDon't worry; with Zhao Yizong here, I'll ensure your absolute safety.
Ah? Little Brother, why do you feel so desperate at such a young age.....
Where do you think you're from, meddling in things that don't concern you and ruining my fun, little brat!
Haha, Third Brother, don't worry so much \nOnce I take care of this person, I will force the little miss to reveal her whereabouts.

But Zhao Yizong's iron spear whirled about, like a golden dragon enveloping him and an jadeine snake coiling around his body.\nFacing the wind as it carries autumn leaves like sticks, close to the body, they fall like petals.\nBeating the bandits in all directions until they scattered in seven different ways.
Good lad, how did you become so skilled in martial arts?\nThe Thirty-Six Strategies advise flight as the best course of action. We'll meet again...
You're known as Flying Everywhere; today, we won't let you fly away!\n(Saying this, the spear moved as swiftly as lightning, striking the bandit's heart from behind.)
(let out a cry of pain and fall to the ground,\nBlood gushed like a fountain, and he died on the spot!)
Two, Elder Brother! Stinking brat!\nGrandpa, my divine skill protects me from knives and guns. Come on, let's see if you can match me!
Just as I thought, can you block my shot?\n(Fueling the Huicaiguan technique, he charged at Zhoujin's chest with a powerful strike)
(Seeing this, he hurriedly concentrated all his cultivation power in his chest,\nWith invincible strength, fully withstand it)

But before they could react, there was a loud blast of metal, and Zhao Yinzong's iron spear had already vanished from their hand.\nHaha, stinky boy, your gun must have flown out of your hand from the shock!
Isn't the gun at your chest?\nJust now, my hand touched the thief's blood, causing it to slip.
(Looking down, I saw the steel gun sticking out of my chest, piercing me straight through.)\nUgh, you little stinker! You dare break my divine technique...
Sorry sorry, I'll get it right away \nHe ran his hand over his garment briefly before drawing the iron spear out.
(The bloodstained hole in his chest immediately sent his soul to the heavens, rendering him silent.)
Zhang Guanger and Zhou Jin, these two are the prime culprits. They have both been executed today.\nQuickly lay down your weapons and spare your lives!
Remaining bandits saw the Third Boss and Second Boss, both of whom were extremely skilled in martial arts.\nThey had already perished on the spot, leaving those present trembling with fear.
Hearing Zhao Yizong's words, he no longer dared to resist.\nDropping their weapons, they all prostrated themselves on the ground and shouted for mercy loudly.
Cough cough cough cough. This little brother of yours, your martial arts are truly impressive.\nI wonder, little brother, what is your surname and name? And what do you do for a living?
Zhao Yizong then recounted the events leading up to and following the Thousand Li Delivery of Jingnang to the Big Boss in great detail.

I was planning to lead you to a secluded area with four fellow thieves and finish the job with one shot.\nI never expected the Great Leader to be a straightforward and chivalrous person. It's all been a misunderstanding.
Now that both bandit leaders have been eliminated, we can rest easy and escort Jing Meng into the capital.\nBoss, we'll meet again another time. Goodbye!

Cough cough, little brother, please stop for a moment.\nThis time's incident is my Fort Master's failure to properly employ personnel.\nThanks to your world-shaking skills, you were able to turn the tide.

Little Brother saved my life today, and your martial arts are far superior to mine-I am already wholeheartedly submissive.\nAccording to the rules of the Jianghu, this Yellow Sand Camp's Great Head position should now be yours.
Haha, Great Leader, it's too kind of you. A true man sets his sights on the world.\nThe lords and ministers are but clouds to me; let someone else handle this matter of going rogue!
Oh? Little Brother has lofty aspirations-well done, well done!\nUnknown to little brother, what great plans do you have for your journey to the Jingcheng?
In the Jingcheng area, some of my Yellow Sand Village brothers also have stationed there.\nIf there's anything I can help with, just let me know.
Previously in Jinyang at Longquan Temple, I received guidance from a Shaolin elder.\nCalling me to the capital will bring its own set of opportunities.

Now that the world is in chaos and villainy abounds, I wish to rise up with you four brothers.\nContribute my meager body, exhaust every will to die, thereby upholding the righteous path and eradicating the wicked.\nRescue the people from peril, restoring clarity to the cosmos.

Good! You've saved the people from peril and restored clarity to the heavens and earth!\nBrother, when I founded this Yellow Sand Encampment back then, it was also to recruit like-minded individuals.\nTo pacify the world together and save all living beings.

Times make heroes, but grand ambitions ultimately yield to the pressures of survival.\nTo feed the brothers in the village, they had to resort to plundering.\nOver the years, though Huangsha Village had a grand reputation, it also became notoriously known as a bandit stronghold in the surrounding areas.

Though those who raid our camp are all greedy officials and unscrupulous merchants who are rich but lack compassion.\nBut disturbing the populace and harming the innocent continues to occur despite repeated prohibitions.\nAnd it is all due to my failure as the Great Master in employing people wisely and disciplining the army properly that we now have this rebellion by the two masters!

Today hearing Little Brother's passionate words, I only now awaken from my dream and regret it deeply.\nIf you, Little Brother, do not reject me, I am willing to join your ranks and follow your commands at all times, Little Brother.\nAs long as it can bring peace to the tumultuous world, I will ascend mountains of knives and descend into seas of fire; I will risk death a thousand times without hesitation!
Brother Zhao, I see Big Boss is also sincere and genuine.\nWishing to surrender and serve
This person's Blade is powerful, and yet they can command such a vast mountain stronghold.\nI see he's a rare military talent
Not bad; now that we wish to undertake a great plan, it is the time to put people to use.
Brother Zhao, why not agree to it \nWith this fierce warrior on our side, we will surely become a formidable force in the future!
Alright... since all four brothers have said so, I won't refuse anymore.\nBoss, in the future you and I will call each other brother.\nLet us rise together to stabilize this chaotic world!
Okay! Deal!
A bandit squad nearby heard that the Great Chief intended to join another faction and abandon Yellow Sand Encampment.\nWept and screamed to the heavens, desperately trying to hold on.

But... both the second and third heads are already deceased. If you, the big head, were to leave as well,...\nThese bandits having lost their discipline will surely cause chaos and wickedness in the world.

All right then, Big Boss, have the bandits return to the stronghold first and train day and night.\nIf there's anything you can do for me in the future, Brother will personally come to visit.\nWe'll raise a glass and plan our great strategies another time!
Brother Zhao's strategies are far-reaching; let's proceed accordingly.\nI will await O Brother's grace at Huangsha Village alongside my fellow brothers!

Agreements have been reached, and all are satisfied; each expresses gratitude.\nAfter bidding farewell to the Big Boss and the outlaws of Yellow Sand Camp, Zhao Yizong, along with the Four Legendary Thieves and Zhao Jingniang,\nHead for Jingniao's home in the south of the Jingcheng from Henei Township!
This passage, titled Four Oddballs Jointly Combat Huang Sazhai, Zhao Dienian Sends Jing Niang a Thousand Li,\nLater, a poem was composed to praise:：
Unswayed by private affections and fearless of might, he journeyed a thousand miles to see Lady Jingniang off.\nHan-Tang Liu Wu Fendushi, Sheiji and Hero Zhao Dalang!

With the storyteller's striking of the wooden clapper, everyone snapped back to attention as if from a dream.\nSurrounding the stage, where crowds of listeners had gathered, erupted into a chorus of cheers and applause.
The elderly gentleman spoke in vivid detail, recounting the story effortlessly.\nLet them feel as if they are right in the midst of battle, as if they have personally experienced a great war!
Cough cough cough cough, too kind, too kind. You flatter us, honored guests.

The old storyteller has been telling stories for over thirty years, but this is the first time I'm saying this particular episode.\nIf there are any inappropriate aspects, please allow us to apologize to all esteemed guests.
Old man, as you said, then the Jingmian household is located in the southern part of the capital city.\nIn a wealthy household's courtyard, is this really true?
Good, that's correct

Come on, let me show you a performance of breaking a big stone with my chest today.\nLet my fellow villagers see the firmness of my #$PlayerName# fists!
Ha ha, great! Let's go, we're starting the performance.

Miss Phoenix came to these parts not long ago to sell her talents.\nThank you all so much for your support, dear fellow villagers.

Strong Iron, say a few words to the fellow villagers.
Ah? This... Today I came here with Sai Huafeng to your esteemed place, not for anything else,\nPerform a chest-breaking stunt for all of you fellow villagers.
I hope those who have money will support this by donating, and those who don't have money will support with their enthusiasm.\nI, Tie Jinggang, thank you all here!
The people below cheered and jumped with excitement, creating a rather lively atmosphere.\nThey all eager to catch a glimpse of the mighty Hard Qi Gong's prowess.
Haha, you're pretty skilled at this, aren't you?\nFellow villagers have been eagerly waiting, so let's get started!
(You gave a slight bow to the audience and then lay down.\nThe little girl used all her strength to lift a stone slab and steadily pressed it on your chest.)
Ugh... Why is this stone plate so heavy...
Hehe, the green stone slabs freshly removed from the roadside are still damp with morning dew.

The props were used up from yesterday's practice, so we can only prop it up with a stone slab from the roadside.\n#PlayerName#, you have hard qi gong that can withstand three hammer blows. Just wait for me to break the stone slab.
Moreover, you even fear a tiny bit of my little girl's strength.\nHow are we supposed to blend in the Jianghu now?
Haha, looking down on who?\nYou just hit as hard as you can; do I scare you?
Okay! Fellow villagers, this lass holds a genuine iron hammer.\nMade entirely of wrought iron, it weighs twenty-eight catties.\nA single strike would be enough to kill even a bull.
Can this Steel Diamond withstand the hammer's strike with its peerless firmness kung fu today?\nEveryone, make sure to look carefully-don't blink!
One swing!
(A single strike leaves you feeling as if the heavens and earth are darkening, with stars spinning in your vision)\nCough cough cough cough!
#PlayerName#, you look pale as a ghost. Are you alright?
Just come! I can handle it...
Good! Two swings!
Three strikes!
Four hammers!
Cough cough, hold on hold on \nDidn't we agree on three punches?
Oh, the fake stone slab made of lime cracked after just three hammer blows.\nToday, no matter how much you hammer these qing shi ban stones, they won't break. #PlayerName#, just a few more tries.
You there, hurry up... I... can still hold on...
Alright! One go and see my Wrecking Wind Hammer technique!\nFive, six, seven, eight, nine, ten hammers!
The little girl struck several powerful blows, each one infinitely forceful.\nAnd with a deafening boom, the large stone slab was finally shattered into fragments!
The common people in the audience had never witnessed such a realistic chest smashing a large stone.\nAfter a brief silence, a thunderous round of applause and cheers erupted.

Thank you all, dear fellow villagers, for coming to watch. Considering our Steel Hulk putting on a life-risking performance,\nI hope everyone can chip in generously so we can bring you more exciting programs in the future!
Ding dang, fortune and health everlasting! Whether much or little, it's all good karma!\nThanks a lot! Thanks a lot!
Haha, sent it sent it!\nToday I really made a fortune. Let me count: one, two, three, four....
#PlayerName#, if not for your help today, I really wouldn't know what to do.\nSure, here is half of the promised reward. Just take it.
Cough cough, I used to think performing on the streets wouldn't require much effort.\nOnly by experiencing it firsthand did I realize how difficult it is to make money.
Ha ha, that's of course necessary. If there are other ways out,\nWho would want to live a nomadic life, facing people's moods every day? ...
Right, I think I went a bit heavy on you just now, #PlayerName#. Are you okay?
Relax, after all, I've trained in martial arts for many years; this little strength won't hurt me.
Wow, #PlayerName# is truly skilled in combat!\nI have a performer's skill that I've never really mastered.\nYou can take a look first. If you have time, you can also teach me.
No problem, I'll take it and give it some thought.
I also need to visit the Medical Hall to see my partner and sell some tonics.\n#PlayerName#, we'll meet again
Someday, if you have free time, let's perform something together again, #PlayerName#.\nNow the common people of Fuzhou city are still chanting your name, Tie Gangjing!
Cough cough, well... let's discuss that another day! Goodbye!
(After the little girl walked far away, he suddenly spat out a mouthful of old blood.)\nPfft! This little girl has quite a strong grip!
I seem to know why her last partner was lying in the medical clinic…
Fellow villagers, come take a look, see what's happening...
Miss Qu, you're out performing again, I see?
Hey, isn't that #PlayerName#?\nThanks to your help, my business has been doing better and better recently.
Better late than never \nHow about we perform a silver spear stabbing the throat together?
No need, no need. The wound from smashing a big stone with my chest last time hasn't healed fully yet.\nOthers sell their art for money, but you're selling your life, Miss.
Okay, no wonder my partner refused to come back even after his wounds healed.
Hey! What are you two yelling about here?
Heard that some little miss was performing for us in the Wild Dogs gang's territory without knowing her place.\nIsn't it you!
It's me, the young lady. What can I do for you gentlemen...
Damn it, you're playing dumb on me, huh!\nWithout the Wild Dogs' permission, you're not allowed to perform here. Pay your protection money now!
Dad! My good dad! Please...\nI, a lone weak woman, find it hard just to earn a meal in your wealthy land.

(Pitifully producing a few copper coins) This is the lucky draw of the day for your humble servant. May it be enough to buy wine for these lords!\nYou look more dashing and heroic after drinking, even more imposing than the door gods in the temple.
(A slap landed on the ground.) Are you saying I'm a beggar?\nThese scraps of copper coins aren't even enough to fill a tooth gap!
Business has been really bad lately, and I just can't come up with much.\nPlease give me a few more days to arrange the protection fees and send them to your place later, sir. What do you think...
I've heard you're doing pretty good business, little girl!\nIf you don't pay the protection money today, I'll smash your stall. Did you hear that?
You're really pushing your luck! Why waste time talking to them.\nThese bullying thugs must be given a severe lesson.
Oh no, #PlayerName#, you haven't worked as a performer before,\nDoes not understand the principle of a person under someone else's roof must lower their head.
I still need to make a living here.\nIf you anger the local kingpin, you'll have more troubles than you can count in the future.
Damn it, what are you muttering here?\nRefuse the toast and accept the punishment? You better ruin this mess for me!

What a bunch of arrogant tough guys. They must have caused quite a bit of trouble for the townsfolk in their everyday lives.\nToday I #$PlayerName# will take action to punish you and do some harm to you!
#PlayerName#...... Never mind.\nThis can't be tolerated either, so I'll fight back with all my might!
Dare to ask for protection money now!
Oh no! Please save me, hero!\nI dare not do it anymore. I really can't do it anymore!
With the last thug knocked to the ground,\nThe crowd of onlookers erupted in thunderous cheers and jubilation.

Thanks to everyone, my fellow villagers, for coming out today. I performed a stunt called Big Hammer Breaks Chest.\nI hope everyone can chip in generously so we can bring you more exciting programs in the future!
Ding dang, fortune and health everlasting! Whether much or little, it's all good karma!\nThanks a lot! Thanks a lot!
This little girl is still thinking about accepting tips...

Just as the onlookers were generously reaching into their pockets, someone suddenly shouted in alarm.：The officials from the town hall are here!\nUpon hearing these words, Qu Peihuan quickly put away the reward money and pulled on your sleeve, turning to run.
Cur, Miss Cur, why are we running?
Oh no, performances are not allowed in the bustling market square, so getting caught will result in a fine.\nThese thugs often collude with the authorities anyway. Let's just get out of here quickly!
A crowd rushed in, blocking the constables' way.\nYou ran into an alleyway under the cover of the common people.
Huff... Huff... Thankfully, the neighbors provided some cover.\nOtherwise, we'd have to spend today in jail.
Haha... haha...ahaha, this is really interesting.
Curly, Miss Curly, have you gone mad?\nThe stall was nearly knocked over, yet he could still laugh so happily.
I've long been annoyed by that bunch of thugs.\nCouldn't be happier just to jump in and run today!
That's true. We learned a new move today: Big Hammer Smashes Chest.\nIt's a bit of a waste, I fear the thugs and ruffians in Fuzhou aren't enough to handle it.
Haha indeed! Haha... Wuhuahuwahuahua!\n(laughing so hard, tears suddenly started falling)
Not again, Miss Qu, why are you crying?
Woo woo woo woo, I... I grew up all alone, wandering the four seas.\nNo one has ever taken care of me like #PlayerName#.
...Hi, what was I saying.\nPerforming together was pretty interesting, and they could earn some money.
From now on, we'll be partners, Tie Jingang and  Sai Fuhang.\nWe'll explore the Jianghu together, and I'll have your back.
Once we gain some reputation, we can head to the Jingcheng to perform.\nPerforming in front of the emperor, do you think that's good?
You... aren't you trying to fool kids?!
I, #$PlayerName#, a Great Hero, would never break my word!
You and me make a deal!
(gently brushing away the tears from her cheeks)\nPull my finger, for a hundred years we won't change, lying is bad.
Haha, #PlayerName#, you're so nice!\nWhat shall we perform next, breaking a large stone with our chest or stabbing someone's throat with a silver spear?
Cough cough cough, suddenly remembered there are important matters to attend to. Farewell, farewell!
Hey, hey! We agreed that it wouldn't change for a hundred years.\nHow much time has passed already?\nLittle dog! You're a little dog!
Oh no, are you okay, #PlayerName#!
These thugs are indeed a bit tricky to handle.\nA hero doesn't lose to temporary setbacks. Let's split up and escape, Miss Que.
Okay, take care!
Damn, he runs really fast.....\nProtection money not paid means getting beaten for nothing, real bad luck.
This road I opened, this tree I planted; hand over all your belongings, or you die!
Big King, spare me! All I have is these few taels of silver. My whole family depends on me...
So many empty words! Since you can't come up with the money to buy your life, just quietly wait to die, wah-wah-wah-wah!
Wait a moment...
Halt, bold thief!\nDaylight robbery on the street-what law is there left?
Right
What day is it today that so many people are meddlesome...\nForget it, tie them up together!
We've finally driven off those bandits, Miss. Are you alright!
Hah... Hah... So this is what it means to be a hero and uphold justice?\nIndeed, it was rather thrilling...
Thank you, Great Heroes, for saving my life. I have nothing to offer in return.\nOnly this silver, I beg you to accept it, Great Hero.
Okay, I'll take it
Uh... Shouldn't you be declining at a time like this?
Okay then, if you don't want me, goodbye!
Huh? Time flies...\nWhy don't you just give me my share then? Hey, hey!
Oh well, it seems my skills still need refinement.\nCan't even defeat a bunch of thugs
Miss, let's escape in opposite directions. The bandits... likely won't be able to catch us both...\nIt's already gone, so I'll slip away too.
Miss Shui, we meet again.\nI hear you've been acting chivalrously lately and have made quite a name for yourself.
#PlayerName#! What a coincidence!\nYou helped me last time, so today I'm treating you to a drink.
Huh? You look so refined. You actually drink?
A-a wandering hero has to know how to drink!\nDon't look down on me. Today I'll drink you under the table!
Heh, my apologies.\nThen today I'll witness Heroine Shui's drinking capacity for myself. Let's go!
Welcome, honored guests! What would you like to eat and drink today?
Bring me ten jars of your best wine! We're drinking until we drop today!\nWill a hundred taels be enough? If not, I'll pay more...
M-miss, there's really no need!\nA hundred taels is enough for fifty guests to drink to their hearts' content.
Besides, our wine is rather strong.\nOne jar is more than enough for the two of you...
Who are you looking down on?! I drink wine like water. Just bring it!
Easy, Heroine Shui.\nLet's start with one jar and taste it first. What if it's no good?
...Fine. One jar to rinse my mouth first.
Right away. Please wait a moment.
Heroine Shui, this wine smells strong. Are you sure you want to drink it?
Of course. Why wouldn't I?\nCome on. Today we'll settle who's the better drinker!
Very well. Then I'll risk my life to keep a noble lady company. Cheers!
Ptooey! So wine tastes this awful.\nThose Great Heroes drink like they're enchanted by it. Turns out it was all a lie.
Hahahaha! Easy, Heroine Shui. You still have nine jars left.
I'm done! I'm never drinking again!\nIt burns my throat and has this strange taste.\nI can't understand how anyone likes this stuff.
When you wander the Jianghu, bruises and injuries are unavoidable.\nAdd the wind, sun, and exhaustion from constant travel—\nwithout a little strong wine, it can be hard to sleep at night.
A pampered young lady like 'Heroine Shui'\nwouldn't understand the hardships of living in the Jianghu.
Huh? H-how could you tell?
Heh, I've traveled the Jianghu for a while now.\nSomeone like 'Heroine Shui,' dressed in fine clothes yet unfamiliar with the world, clearly comes from a wealthy family.
Alright... I thought I was doing a pretty convincing job of pretending to be a wandering hero.
Miss Shui, the Jianghu is dangerous and you're still inexperienced.\nPlease be careful. It would be best to return home sooner rather than later.
I... I don't want to go home...\nIt's getting late. I'll be going now. Farewell!
Sigh... Alright. Take care, Miss Shui...
Wait, weren't you treating me? You haven't paid the bill!
Ptooey! So wine tastes this awful.\nThose Great Heroes drink like they're enchanted by it. Turns out it was all a lie.
I'm not drunk... I can still drink...
#PlayerName#? #PlayerName#?!\nHow is your tolerance even worse than mine...?
Who exactly are you people?\nI'd rather die than go with you!
What a fiery little lady. Today we'll tie you up and make you the chief's bride! Hahahahaha!
Miss Shui, I heard a gang of villains has been after you. Are these the ones?
#PlayerName#! Yes, it's them. They've been following me for days...
In broad daylight, under a clear sky, you dare abduct a woman in the middle of the street? Take this!
A bunch of bandits, dare to forcibly seize civilian women anymore!
Ah, Great Hero! Spare me! Misunderstanding, it's all just a misunderstanding!
Still talking tough? Here it comes!
Wait, #PlayerName#, be easy on me
Miss, why are you pleading for the thief's sake now?
I recognized a few of them as your household servants inside...
Master Wang, did you come to fetch me back as per Father's orders?
Cough cough cough cough, Miss Xiaojia really is ice and snow intelligent.\nBut the daoshou's temper is explosive, so we dare not force them.
The master had us pretend to be bandits to scare the misses.\nSo that you will willingly return to the estate...
Haha, such trivial tricks won't scare me \nTell Father and Mother, I have made up my mind not to go back.
Oh dear miss, what good things are there in the Jianghu?\nWolves, tigers, leopards-exposed to wind and rain, living hand to mouth.
Why not return to your mansion and enjoy a life of wealth and leisure?\n...will find a good family to marry into later...
What days of luxury and leisure, spending each day staring at the mirror in a daze,\nIs there any difference between living and dying?

Uncle Wang, you watched me grow up \nKnowing I've always loved martial arts and training, free and unfettered,\nI hate embroidery and needlework, and I hate being married to take care of the children even more!
Oh... Miss...
Moreover, I made many good friends in the Jianghu.\nLike #$PlayerName#, this Great Hero is well-known in the Jianghu.\nWith them taking care of things, there won't be any danger.
This $#$PlayerName# Great Hero, is that true?
Cough, cough, Mian... I suppose you could say that...
Well... since Miss Elder has made up her mind, the old servant cannot force her.
The master had actually instructed beforehand that if this group of bandits couldn't take down Miss Lady,\nIt's noted that Miss Senior has learned enough to take care of herself.
This way, Miss can venture into the Jianghu, and Master can finally feel somewhat reassured.

This silver bill is entrusted to us by Master to give to the Eldest Miss. If it's insufficient, feel free to retrieve more from the household.\nMiss Senior, take great care and come back to the mansion often when you have time.
Father......I can do it......I can do it.
Originally these thieves were servants from the Water Maiden Manor... Fortunately, I didn't go too far...

My father has been constantly shouting that he never wants to recognize me again, and I didn't expect him to go so far as to put on such a show specifically...\nStill made Wang Jianfu bring so many silver bills.
Oh, how can there be parents who don't love their own children?\nYou should go back often and don't let the elders worry too much.
It's still early; I want to make a name for myself in the Jianghu.\nGo back and give Father a good beating!
Haha, Miss Water, oh no, Water Xia, then you should work hard.
Hmph, just wait and see!
The bandits are strong, Miss Raw. Let's escape in different directions.
Goodbye, #PlayerName#, take care!
Rest assured, I have things under control
How can I suddenly disappear like this? This won't do at all...
Master! Please accept me as your disciple!\nI want to learn your world-shaking martial arts!
Where did the girl come from? Off to play!\nMaster, accepting apprentices isn't just child's play; one must consider both talent and sincerity.
Master, disciple speaks with all sincerity and without any falsehood.
Hmph, we'll see about that. Show me the money first.
Master, may I ask how much the tuition is!
At least two hundred taels, with no upper limit.\nThe more money, the more sincere one becomes; with sincerity, miracles happen; without it, nothing works!
One, one hundred taels?!
Hmph, can't even come up with a hundred taels, and you still want to learn my world-renowned martial arts?\nIt's wishful thinking
A few days ago, the wealthy cattle farmer at the village entrance paid two hundred taels.\nMaster reluctantly taught him a three-character aphorism
But just with these three-word incantation,\nIt was more than enough to make him dominate the Jianghu and be invincible in Xiliang.
I see, I understand, Master!\nI'll go work and earn money, promising to gather this hundred taels as soon as possible.
Hmph, go on then, come back when you've earned enough for tuition.
Master, I'll go right away
This guy is so greedy, and he seems to have mediocre martial arts skills.\nFeels like a mere novice. Could it be the famous Immortal without appearance?
Oops! Sorry for the hug!\nAre you here to learn from our master as well?
Cough cough cough.... This... is just to come and watch the fun.
Young Hero, have you thought this through? Master is a legendary peerless master.\nThis is your last chance
Forget it, I'd better hurry up and earn some tuition money.\nIf Master should change his mind, it would be a regret forever after...
Did she really go to earn tuition fees? This Miss is truly straightforward...
Hey, young fellow over there, are you here to learn by training as well?
Ah? Me? This...
Hmph, this time coming out of seclusion, I will only accept three disciples.\nNow that Niu Fuhu and the just-now little Miss have been taken in, there is one spot left.

If you wish to learn my supreme martial arts, you must seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.\nJust one hundred taels for tuition; we offer no deception, your money or your life! Act now, the opportunity won't come again!

内容: Tuition one hundred taels? Whatworld-class martial art is this so cheap......\nWhy not give it a try?
Alright, it's just one hundred taels of silver!\nTo learn supreme martial arts, one thousand two worth it.
(seeing the shiny silver coins, he couldn't help but smile widely)\nHaha, you're easy to teach!
Okay, today I will teach you this three-character incantation.\nIt will transform you from head to toe, bringing you endless benefits.
I wish to hear more details
These three-word incantation is：Got it! Transform! Evolve!\nDid you hear me clearly?
Ah? To... transform... to?\nWhat does this mean?
Humph, though these three characters are simple,\nYet it encompasses everything, embodying the ultimate principles of martial arts.
Go back and ponder deeply, young man \nOnce you have fully understood the principles involved, I will teach you more advanced techniques.
Is that so... containing the fundamental principles of martial arts...\nOr could it be that he's intercepting the enemy's attack?
Counter, perhaps to neutralize the opponent's power....\nWhat is that convulsion?
Hey, Master? Master?!\nWhy did it disappear... Am I being tricked...
Haha, one hundred taels for an unparalleled martial art? Pulling my leg, I'll be on my way!
Hey, hey, hey! Wait, don't go, young guy!\nHow can you be so unaware of the power of my supreme martial arts.
Forget it, forget it. Given your excellent potential,\nI'll give you a discount; how about eighty taels?
A little cheaper, fifty taels is fine too; it's being sold at half price!
Thirty taels... twenty taels... ten taels!\nDamn it, he's completely disappeared
It's over now \nWe have to pack up quickly and make a break for it...
Master, Master! I think I've had a moment of insight!
Ah? Good, very good, a child worth teaching.\nThe master still has some urgent matters on this side....
Master, why are you hastily packing your bags in such a hurry?
This... lately, I've heard that my enemies are closing in. Master needs to retreat into the mountains for a while.
Master, with your legendary martial arts skills, are you still afraid of your enemies?
Cough, cough. Ordinary enemies are not worth the Master's attention.\nBut this time, the newcomer is none other than the legendary Devil Sovereign, Flying Heaven Devil King Niu Wuji.
Fly Heaven Demon Sovereign? Quite the impressive title!\nMaster, though my skills are still shallow, I swear to protect you safely with all my might!

Alright, alright, your filial piety is touching. Even so, Master considers it worth having you as a disciple.\nYou go to the courtyard first and keep watch for me. I'll think of a strategy to repel the enemy.
Yes, Master!
Miss Liu, why are you standing here in the courtyard as a punishment?
No no, I'm just keeping watch for Master.
Watchtower? Is something wrong? Does someone want to harm your master?
Not bad. According to Master, his senior's enemy, Flying Heaven Demon Sovereign Ni Wuji,\nHe won't be far behind with his revenge.
Fly Heaven Demon Sovereign Niu Wuji?\nI've never heard of this person...
Cough cough, Miss Liu, I have a few words that I'm not sure whether I should say or not.
All are wanderers in the Jianghu; no need for all that fussing.\n#PlayerName#, just go ahead and say it!
Miss's master; it always feels a bit strange.\nHe keeps going on about taking over hair dyeing and lacking martial virtue,\nSeems like your martial arts are still pretty ordinary.
I worry he... might just be a scammer.
Haha, what should I say \nMaster is the kind of immortal who doesn't reveal himself, #PlayerName# shouldn't worry so much!
Since I began training under Master, my skills have improved dramatically. You can't deny that, right?\n#PlayerName#, if you don't believe me, let's give it a try.
Oh? You serious? This conman really has some skills on him?\nAlright, then let's spar for a while. Step forward!
Miss Liu, thank you for showing mercy!
#PlayerName#, your technique is impressive. I have to admit, I lost.
#PlayerName#, thank you for letting me win!
Miss Liu has impressive skills, I have lost.
However, though these martial arts moves are unremarkable on their own, when performed by Miss Liu, they become extraordinary.\nYet it is ingeniously designed, ever-changing, truly rather peculiar.
As I said, you didn't believe me, right?\nMaster's teachings in martial arts are quite profound.
Given enough time, I will definitely master this peerless martial arts technique.\n#PlayerName#, just wait and see
Well then, I can only wish Miss Zhu Li to master the divine skills soon. Goodbye!
Old scammer, where are you going!!!
Ouch! You young folks these days don't follow the rules of martial virtue.\nDare to sneak attack a senior elder of the Jianghu!
You old scoundrel, still dare to be so obstinate?\nDeceived me with two hundred taels of silver and taught me three verses.
I practiced diligently for several months, but it was useless.\nOnly now do I realize I've been tricked by you old fellow.!
The oral chant is indeed real; it's because your training is lacking.\nTrue intentions bring results... It's all because your intentions weren't true enough...
Belief makes it so, right!
Ouch!
Got it! Sounds good!\nToday, I'm going to let you show off your supreme martial arts skill.
Come on, come on, come on, show daddy one!
Hit me hard!\nToday, if you can't fa, we'll beat you until you can fa!
Ow! Stop! Stop! Stop!
Master!!! Bandit, you are the Flying Heaven Demon Sovereign Ni Wuji?\nSuch audacity, daring to injure my master!
Flying Heavenly Demon Lord? What rubbish.\nYour master is a fraud, wouldn't you, little Miss, know that!
The master is not lying; I clearly mastered the Thunderbolt Five-hit Whip!
Okay then, you're teaming up to deceive me, are you?\nYou are the apprentice of this old trickster, so you must be the little liar as well.\nGuys, let's fight together!
(Leap up and tightly hug Ma Fuhu's thigh)\nHit me, not my apprentice! She's innocent!
Damn you, old fraudster, I'll kill you!
Ugh... Apprentice, hurry up!\nDon't worry about me; you're not his match!
Go into the Jianghu and spread your master's forbidden techniques far and wide!\nEven if my master dies... I can finally rest in peace...
Master! A day as teacher, a lifetime as father.\nToday, you want to move, Master? Step over my corpse first!
Woo woo woo woo, good disciple.... Master.... I'm sorry to you, Master!
Cough cough, everyone, there must be some misunderstanding today.\nWhy don't we sit down and have a calm discussion...
Sure thing! This old con has quite a few accomplices, let's take them down together!
Good stuff, the Miss has some skill \nYou, what kind of kung fu is this?
This first move is Receive, utilizing the power of four liang to deflect a thousand catties.\nNext offensive assault
This second technique Hua does not counter the attack.\nInstead, he turned the tables by using their strength against them.
This third move, Fa, is about releasing accumulated power sparingly.\nMerge the strength of your opponent with your own strength.\nThen unleashed in an instant, its power naturally doubles!
I see now. Ma Baoguo's mnemonic phrases are just misleading.\nBut Miss Liu is a martial arts prodigy found rarely in the world.

She forcibly integrated these three-word incantations to such an extent that she mastered them at the great completion level.\nIndeed, great wisdom lies in simplicity, returning to the essence of things!

(Faced with Liu Ruyue's incredibly powerful technique, he immediately fell to his knees begging for mercy)\nMartial Lady, spare my life! Martial Lady, spare my life! I didn't recognize a mountain among the trees...
(Pausing his hands in front, he lightly waved them away to dispel the strength.)\nMaster taught me that martial artists should stop at the point of effectiveness, valuing harmony above all.
Fly-Away Evil Sovereign Ni Wuji, today I won't harm your life,\nBut I still hope you will reform and return to the right path.
I will definitely change and start over! I will definitely reform myself and become a new person!!\nThanks for sparing my life, hurry up and go!
Master, are you okay!\nWhy am I so bruised and battered...
Cough cough cough cough. Master is getting old and his power has diminished significantly.\nBy now, Master has nothing more to teach you.
Master, what do you mean by this?\nDisciple hasn't even learned your single success power yet.

(This place isn't suitable for staying long; we should hurry to pack up the essentials and flee.)\nThe master needs to find a secluded place to rest and recover, which will bring you much inconvenience.
From then on, go out into the Jianghu to explore on your own. Remember to study diligently and practice hard.\nSpread my master's unique and supreme martial arts throughout the land.
Master! Disciple humbly follows your esteemed teachings!
(Luckily, the little girl hasn't caught on yet, or she'd demand a refund of my tuition)\nVery well, your master is proud to have you as a disciple. May our paths cross again. Goodbye!
Master left in such a hurry,\nIt seems there are even more troublesome enemies looking for him.
Haha, with him constantly boasting and cheating like that every day, of course he has many enemies.

This this this...... But after all, Xianxia Sect is just a small faction in Shu.\nWith so many famous martial clans and experts abound in the world today,\nQuelling them all completely? That's easier said than done.

Not bad; even Emperor Zhou Shizong Duan Chenrong and the Senior Inspector Zhao Yinzong were unable to accomplish this.\nBut how could we forget the teachings of our Master, that there is righteous qi in heaven and earth?
I #$PlayerName# was just about to test my righteous energy.\nEven if things don't work out, we can always turn back and seek self-preservation later.
But this will surely be a bloody and treacherous path strewn with thorns, gentlemen.\nIf you don't want to walk together, I, #$PlayerName#, won't have a single word of complaint.

#PlayerName#, what are you saying!\nOver these many years, you have saved my life at least eight times.\nEven if it's a sea of swords and a hell of fire, Yang Sichi will follow you, without any hesitation!
#PlayerName# and the Xianxia Sect treated me with deep kindness and sincerity.\nI won't be that ungrateful either!

Ha, the junior disciple and junior sister are correct.\nSo many challenges, they of the Xianxia Sect have overcome them all together.\nThose who flee at the last moment or give up halfway would not have waited until today.
Exactly, when it comes to a big decision, how could anyone leave #PlayerName# alone?\nDon't look down on us!
Hmph! If you say such things again in the future,...\nDon't call me Senior Sister Jiang!
Senior Sister Jiang.....
Though I can't quite understand what you're saying, it seems pretty fun.\n#PlayerName#, count me in!
White Cloud Master, this Jianghu fighting isn't exactly a fun pastime...
So what? #PlayerName#,\nI remember you seemed to take me to many places and saved me numerous times.
Can I also follow you this time, okay?
..., Baiyunzi, fellow disciples, since it's agreed, let's make a deal.
I hope you can help settle the chaotic world, #$PlayerName#.\nNo matter the outcome, we are life and death bound, never leaving each other's side! through thick and thin!
Ah! Bound by life and death, never to leave or forsake!

After Golden Dragon Sheng was executed, the Blood Robe Alliance, this worldwide enemy of all, finally fell apart. \nSeeds of unrest began to stir among the various sects of Central Plain, each vying for dominance in the Wulin.
In the midst of these raging waves, where will the Xianxia Sect go from here, and that remains to be seen in the days to come.
