Senior Brother Gu, I see a thoughtful expression on your face.\nIs there something troubling you?
#PlayerName#, recent conflicts in the Jianghu are you aware of them?

Hearing about the constant friction between Changle Gang and Thunderclap Hall over control of the Yangtze River waterway shipping.\nThe Tianshan Sect and Kongtong Sect have frequently clashed in the northwest towns.

In addition, Flying Dragon Sect and Shaolin Temple are discussing the Jingcheng's defense.\nThe Beggars Sect and the Dayin Pavilion erupted into minor conflicts in Yingtian, worsening relations between the two factions.

Now all the major sects are sharpening their blades and preparing, ready to act.\nThe chaos of the world is becoming apparent; it seems to be just as we feared.\nThe era of rival powers vying for dominance is about to begin.
Not bad, #PlayerName#\nWhat do you think about the situation recently?
The warfront has not yet fully opened, and Ba-Shu remains relatively calm.\nWe should seize the opportunity and quickly strengthen our faction's power.
Well, after these many years of development, our sect has long since shaken off its former decline.\nAmongst your efforts, we, the senior brothers and sisters, have all seen.
Hehe, Senior Brother Ku overstates it \nI just don't want to fail Master's instructions from back then, and I also don't want to let you all down.
#PlayerName#, there's no need to be so modest.\nThis achievement of our clan couldn't have been possible without your diligent management.
Still, if we really want to compete with those prestigious clans and sects,\nProbably still lacks the strength to do so.
Ah, after all, our sect was originally just a second or third-rate small sect in Shuzhong.\nIt was already quite an achievement to reach this point.
As for comparing with the Shaolin and Wudang, these prestigious sects with centuries of history,\nThe journey is long and arduous
How can one deal with the current situation,\nWe can no longer bide our time and slowly develop.
Gu Senior Brother's meaning is that we should take the initiative to attack.\nFurther expand their sphere of influence?
Exactly right
Actually, I had that intention as well \nBefore we agreed to work together to stabilize the chaotic world, I wasn't just joking around.
When times are tumultuous and complex, with countless matters to attend to,\nI have pondered over where to start for quite some days.
Oh? I wonder if #PlayerName# has come up with any ideas?
Indeed, I have some clues now... Senior Brother Ku, what's your thoughts?
Haha, I have some ideas as well \nFrom this, perhaps we can face off against them one-on-one.
Senior Brother Gu, could your thoughts be... the same as mine...?Iron Palm Gang？
Haha, no wonder heroes think alike \nNot bad, that's exactly what I was thinking.Iron Palm Gang！

Hmm, I guess Senior Brother Ku would also have thought of this.\nSince Xia Tianxiong's death in summer, the Iron Palm Gang has never fully recovered its strength.\nAs the first battle for this sect after going dormant, it's perfect for training.
Additionally, the Iron Palm Gang is not far from our sect, avoiding the long and arduous journey by boat.\nGiven our two factions' long-standing grudge, it can be considered a just cause.
Not bad, and the Iron Palm Gang lacks powerful allies in the Wulin.\nWe act against them, and it wouldn't easily provoke a public outcry in the Wulin.
Finally, our two factions do come from the same lineage; our roots run deep.\nNow that they can be united, it perfectly aligns with the elder master's teachings from long ago.
Preceptor's Admonition... Divided they fall, united they become kings!\nThus it seems that taking on the Iron Palm Gang as our first battle for the Xianxia Sect is perfect.
Senior Brother Ku, what's left to hesitate about?\nLet's quickly gather our disciples and prepare for battle......
Hold on hold on, #PlayerName#, you are now the Sect Leader.\nYou can't be so impulsive anymore
Though the Iron Palm Gang may not be particularly powerful, they have been operating in the Sichuan region for many years.\nIts main base defenses are tight; we must not be complacent.
The Senior Brother's words make sense. So, what should we do?
We haven't visited the Iron Palm Gang in years, so let's pay them a visit again.\nSee how Han Song has run the Iron Palm Gang and how many skilled disciples he has under his tutelage.
Well, knowing both oneself and the enemy ensures victory in a hundred battles.\nSenior Brother Gu, let's head out then!
Hear #PlayerName# 'commands.'
#PlayerName#, do you remember the first time you investigated the Iron Palm Gang?

Ha ha, remember remember \nBack in the day, we disguised ourselves as fishermen just to sneak into the Iron Palm Gang.\nNow with lightness, I can easily sneak in without having to endure such suffering.
Well, things have changed for the Iron Palm Gang.\nThe once arrogant and domineering Iron Palm Quartet is long gone, and the guild now consists of new faces.

Though our forces burned the Iron Palm Gang's main den in the past, it has since recovered and regained much of its strength through years of rest and recuperation.\nI see that order reigns here and defenses are stringent; it cannot be taken lightly.

Not bad. While Han Song may not match Summer Hero in terms of grand strategy and visionary thinking, he does excel in his maturity and steady approach.\nOver the years, the Iron Palm Gang has been managed efficiently, and among my disciples, there are many talented young men.
From this, it seems that if we rashly attack the Iron Palm Gang,...\nThere will likely be significant resistance
Not bad. We should first target its periphery to reduce its defensive capabilities and shake its military morale.\nAfter securing it in one move, that would be the safest strategy.
Senior Brother Gu, it seems you already have an idea?
I had already gathered intelligence that the Iron Palm Gang is currently flush with resources.\nAnd the crafting of armor and weapons for the guild members relies on a nearby iron mine.
We can send in a surprise force to seize this iron mine first.\nThis would cut off their funding and reduce the resistance when we assault the main den later.
That makes sense, Senior Brother Gu. When should we strike?
I'll scout around here for a while to avoid any changes in the situation.\n#PlayerName#, go back inside and get everyone ready with the senior brothers.
When the opportunity matures, I will send you a message by homing pigeon.\nCome at the right time and take this iron mine by force with your followers.
Good, I'll head back to the Sect to get ready.\nSenior Brother Gu, be more careful! Farewell!
Senior Brother Gu, I have brought our sect's elite forces. How is the situation?

I have been secretly observing for many days, and recently the Iron Palm Gang has been planning the sect's grand competition.\nThe iron mine defenses are weak here, making this a good opportunity for us to launch an attack and seize it.
A chance lost is never regained \nFellow senior brothers, do you have the confidence to tackle this place with me?
Haha, didn't expect to face off against the Iron Palm Gang after all these years.
Alright, we've been preparing for a long time.\nWe can use this opportunity to practice the martial arts we've just learned.
Though times have changed, everyone's martial arts are far superior to before.\nBut the cultivation of the Iron Palm Gang disciples has also made some progress.
#PlayerName# is right \nBe careful, or you might capsize in the culvert.
Senior Sister rest assured, with me Shen Tui present, it's only the Iron Palm Gang that will be sinking.
Back in the day, I was beaten to a pulp by the Iron Palm Quartet every single day.\nToday, I Yang Sichi will fight for a word back!
Senior Brother Yang, don't try to be too strong.\nLet's follow #PlayerName#'s command and don't lose our formation.
Junior Sister is right. Impulsive, impulsive.
Junior Sister Xia Bai, you have just recovered from a serious illness and your cultivation is still not back to normal.\nYou also need to be more careful
Good, with Senior Sister Lin and Senior Brother Yang in the front to lead the way,\nI'll cheer you on and root for you.
Haha, I never thought I would become a senior sister someday.\nRest easy, Junior Sister Bai is in Senior Sister Lin's hands!
Haha, just two days after Little Junior Sister became Senior Sister,\nWhy have I started to act like Senior Brother Yang and be so stubborn?
Finally became a senior sister,\nThis time, I have to show off a bit in front of Junior Sister Bai Xiaowei!

Though White Cloud Junior Immortal suffers from amnesia, his cultivation is sufficient for self-preservation.\nThe task of breaking through the array will be handled by me and the senior brothers and sisters. Just be extra cautious.
Ladies and gentlemen, we previously agreed to work together to stabilize the chaotic world.\nToday is our sect's first battle upon emerging from seclusion.
Believe me, the Xianxia Sect is united \nWill surely achieve victory and conquer this place; prepare for battle!
Sect Leader Han, you've remained well!
#PlayerName#, I didn't expect to see you after all these years.\nYou've suddenly bestowed such a grand gift upon me.
Sect Leader Han, these days the world is in great chaos with various warlords vying for power.\nIt's time to settle our respective scores once and for all.
Haha, #PlayerName# you're really pushing it \nBut I, Han Mou, am not someone's meat either.
Today, I will test your sect's Sword. Here is my move!
Only to see the disciples of the Xianxia Sect each display their divine prowess,\nSoon they routed the Iron Palm Gang disciples guarding the iron mine.

Great skills! I've heard for a long time that #PlayerName# has exceptional talent and strategical vision, working hard to govern well.\nIn just a few short years, he had developed the Xianxia Sect into one of the premier sects in Shu Zhong.
Today upon seeing, your faction has a multitude of skilled warriors.\nPower far surpasses what it used to be. Truly lives up to its reputation!
Sect Leader Han is giving me too much credit. It's just that I have achieved what I have today.\nAll thanks to Master's teachings back then and the unwavering support from fellow senior brothers.
We have come today to issue a challenge to your sect as well.
A month later, I will lead the elite of this sect again.\nHead to the Iron Palm Gang's main den and let's settle this once and for all.
Good, it seems #PlayerName# has made up his mind.\nYou're ready to face the Iron Palm Gang in a decisive battle!
Jianghu matters are settled in the Jianghu. Today, it is our army that has suffered defeat.\nCome to the Iron Palm Gang's main den another day, and we'll see who comes out on top. Goodbye!
Only to see Han Song blow the horn and gather the scattered soldiers.\nLead the crowd in retreating towards the Iron Palm Gang's main den.
#PlayerName#, we can't let them go like this.\nLet me go and deal with a few more troublemakers... kill them off...
Senior Brother Shen, no need \nSince we both come from the same lineage, there's no need to truly fight to the death.
#PlayerName#, now's the time for action, not female mercy!

If we indulge in temporary satisfaction today, it will not only tarnish our sect's reputation for benevolence and righteousness.\nAnd the already eased relationship with the Iron Palm Gang is likely to deteriorate further, making it hard to resolve the situation.
I get it, #PlayerName# wants to win by virtue!
Not bad. Though the Iron Palm Gang is not particularly strong in power,\nYet it can be considered one of the important forces in Sichuan.
If we fight the Iron Palm Gang to the death, not only will we incur their enmity, but it will also deplete our vital energy.\nIsn't that making the same mistake as all the previous Sect Leaders?

Only by subduing Han Song along with the entire Iron Palm Gang can we achieve a permanent solution.\nIn the future, the Iron Palm Gang could also become a significant aid for our sect in competing for dominance under heaven.
Well, winning hearts is above all, conquering cities comes second.\nSecuring this iron mine today counts as a significant victory. There's no need to exterminate everyone.
I see that the Iron Palm Gang's source of wealth has been cut off, and its disciples must be in a state of panic.\nJust wait for a little longer, and they will naturally collapse without resistance.
Big Senior Brother says it's right. Once we are properly prepared in the future, let's go to the Iron Palm Gang.\nWe'll be sure to settle this once and for all and take them down.
OK! #PlayerName#, relax.\nLet's head back and intensify our training to prepare for a decisive battle against the Iron Palm Gang!
Despite the efforts of the Xianxia Sect's disciples to fight to the death,\nUltimately, we were still unable to conquer this place.
#PlayerName#, your sect's martial arts are quite proficient.\nBut my Iron Palm Gang disciple still comes out ahead!
Well, I didn't expect to lose so quickly in my first battle.\nIt seems that our disciples need to enhance their strength.
The future is long; let's plan step by step.\nWait until I rise again and challenge you once more!
Good, Master Han will await your gracious visit at the Iron Palm Gang's main headquarters. Farewell!
Junior Sister Bai, have you truly forgotten everything?
Back when you first came to the Xianxia Sect, you knocked me down with just a few moves.\nDon't you remember this at all?
Ah? So that's how powerful I was back then!
Junior Sister Yu, why don't you demonstrate the techniques I used back then for me to see?\nMaybe I can remember something?
You were too quick back then for me to see clearly...\nWell, it's dead horse medicine, but we might as well try it!
Senior Master Sister is really formidable!
Junior Sister Bai, how about you? Have you recalled anything?
Ugh... I just feel dizzy and groggy.\nStill can't remember anything
That won't do! Junior Sister Bai, let's try this again.
Cough, Sister Yu, Baiyunzi has just recovered from a serious illness.\nYou don't need to be in such a rush either.
#PlayerName#, your junior sister did this. Didn't you ever think of any solutions?
The Jianghu is perilous. Just for Junior Sister to regain some of her strength,...\nAt the very least, they can survive in these turbulent times!
Ah, back in the day, to keep her alive, several sect leaders did everything they could.\nIt's just amnesia, and that's already the best outcome.
As for losing all his cultivation, Baiyunzi ultimately has extraordinary innate abilities.\nAs long as you practice diligently, you'll catch up quickly.
All right, all right. But as your Sect Leader,\nTeaching disciples martial arts and cultivation is an important duty.
Leave the matter of guiding Baiyunzi to #PlayerName#.\nYou're not allowed to be lazy either
If I find that White Cloud Junior Disciple's martial arts hasn't progressed in a while,\nYou'll definitely be questioned about this!
Alright, Senior Sister Yue's instruction is correct
Rest assured, a master can produce excellent disciples. With just a few pointers from the Sect Leader, I'll be fine.\nPangu helped Baiyunzi make rapid progress and return to his peak.
So be it!
Haha, then it's up to #PlayerName# to give me lots of advice.\nRest assured, I'll also work hard on my training.
Hearing those four words, effort in cultivation, really doesn't feel natural coming from your mouth....
White Cloud Apprentice, in the Jianghu one should strive to have many skills without them weighing you down.\nI just taught you the heart method verses of this martial arts skill.
Got it, got it. I didn't think practicing martial arts would be so simple.
#PlayerName#, I'm heading down the mountain to right wrongs and uphold justice!
Hold on hold on, though you've memorized the Heart Method verses,\nBut it's just scratching the surface of this skill.
After that, it still depends on your diligent practice.\nMaster this cultivation technique thoroughly before it can take effect in actual combat.
Originally, it was so troublesome...... Ah, I wish I hadn't learned it in the first place.\nSo, #PlayerName#, how should we study diligently and train hard?
Each martial art is divided into theoretical experience and practical experience.\nTo accumulate theoretical experience, you need to read the secrets in the Scripture Pavilion.
To gain practical experience, one needs to practice in the training ground.\nOr it can only be done by practicing against others...
Additionally, there are bottlenecks. Encountering a bottleneck requires seclusion to breakthrough.\nStill need to prepare elixirs and food....
(How do I feel more and more like a nag, starting to sound like Senior Brother Gu from back then?)
Oh no, #PlayerName#, stop reading already \nI feel a headache coming on and worry it might trigger an old episode.

You're just a little Miss; you can't even endure any hardship. How can you talk about recovering your strength?\nYour master, Master Sima Sect Leader, would definitely scold me for not disciplining you properly if he knew this!
I don't care. Is there any faster way...?\nWhy don't you just transmit your cultivation to me, #PlayerName#!
You're pushing it, aren't you!....\nWell, alright, alright, there's no convincing you
Ah? #PlayerName#, are you really going to impart your cultivation to me?
Dream on! But to enhance your martial arts cultivation,\nThere's indeed a faster way
That's me teaching step by step Guide You, tell me what are the crucial aspects of this cultivation method,\nHow can it be applied to fully leverage its power.
Of course, the higher my own cultivation reaches, the better the guidance effect on you will be.
So that's it! You should have said there was such a good method earlier.\nI didn't used to have to train so hard myself.
#PlayerName#, come and guide me quickly \nBut I am still recovering from a serious illness, my mind is rather foggy. You mustn't think I'm dumb!
I don't mind that you're not very clever.\nThis martial art has several techniques; I'll explain them one by one...
No wonder it's White Cloud Zi; you learn quickly.
Haha, #PlayerName#, you teach much better, don't you.\nHow did that go again?... A master teaches well!
It's rare to see you be humble for once, all right!\nBut there is one more phrase: called：Master opens the door, cultivation depends on oneself.
After that, it's up to you to study diligently and practice hard.\nMaster this cultivation technique thoroughly
Hm? Go on, #PlayerName#, give me more guidance.\nWhy didn't you just guide me to mastery of my power?

You little rascal, you've tried to slack off again!\nYou must know that the higher your martial arts cultivation rises, the closer it will be to mine.\nThe effectiveness of your guidance will decrease
So as you progress and delve into more complex aspects, it really comes down to understanding them on your own.
I understand, #PlayerName#. I'm not as strong as I used to be.\nYou're frustrated with me, aren't you? You think I'm clumsy and annoying!
I also want to get my strength back sooner so I don't hold everyone back.\nBut I tried really, really hard, yet I still can't remember anything...
No more, no more \nI'll guide you through it step by step!
Haha, thanks a lot, #PlayerName#!\nI just know you're not someone who is shallow or devoid of emotion.
No wonder Sect Leader Sima insisted you swear allegiance to me.\nThis old trickster, trying to play the floodwater diversion strategy, huh...
#PlayerName# is muttering something again \nHurry up, hurry up. Keep giving instructions.
Sure sure, but trying to do too much at once just results in poor execution.\nYou can point to it at most three times per month.And yet, the rest still depends on myself.
Listen up, this technique should be used like this...
Ladies and gentlemen, as previously agreed, the first step in pacifying the world is to subdue the Iron Palm Gang.
A few days ago, we clashed near the Iron Palm Gang's iron mine.\nI have already pretty much figured out their bottom line.
Now, everyone's martial arts skills have made some progress.\nIt's time to march against the Iron Palm Gang's main den and take them down for good.
Haha, if not for the Iron Palm Gang, neither my own nor Big Senior Brother's myriad adventures would have taken place.\nThis Iron Palm Gang has indeed developed a considerable connection with us.
Well, with the Iron Palm Gang, there have been so many grievances accumulated over these years.\nIt's time to put a full stop
Previously, he had been busy dealing with Yama Palace and the Blood Robe League, biding his time for so many years.\nFinally, I can showcase the might of the Xianxia Sect.
Hehe, finally managed to free up some time,\nNaturally, we must seize the opportunity to give these petty villains a severe lesson.
Ladies and gentlemen, though the Iron Palm Gang may not be considered one of the great families,\nBut it also has deep roots and operates locally for many years.
This is my first battle out of the Xianxia Sect, and there is no room for error.\nI hope you all remain vigilant and do not underestimate your opponents.
#PlayerName#, leave it to me to take the brunt of any attacks.\nWill not retreat half a step
Ah, Si Chi, while your martial arts have shown some progress, you shouldn't overexert yourself.
Ladies and gentlemen, I used my savings to buy some healing potions.\nEveryone, take these in case you need them.
Haha, Senior Sister Jiang thinks more thoroughly
I've made quite a few delicious dishes. Everyone can eat and drink to their heart's content.\nIsn't it only then that you have the strength to decide a victory over the Iron Palm Gang?
Wow, it tastes great! I'll give it a try!\nI didn't expect Senior Lin to have this talent...
Cough, cough, leave me some, little white...\nAlright, alright, how did this turn into a food festival? Let's get down to business.
Today's battle concerns the rise and fall of our Xianxia Sect.\nMust win the first battle and conquer the Iron Palm Gang in one go.
Fellow soldiers, mount your horses and follow me into battle!
#PlayerName#, upon hearing that your sect intends to contend with the Iron Palm Gang,\nI, Han, have been waiting here respectfully for some time.
Sect Leader Han, I see that your sect's main hall is well-defended with high walls and deep enclosures.\nIt seems they were prepared for today's battle as well.

Hmph, of course \nBack in the day when you and I were Sect Leaders of our respective factions, we both perished in the Battle of Baleng.\n#PlayerName# then agreed with the old man to turn swords into plowshares.
Thereafter, a large army besieged Baling Village to attack Yama Palace.\nI personally led the elite forces to provide support.
Now times have changed, #PlayerName# surprisingly led an attack on our main den.\nAre they not acting dishonorably?
Master Han, you and I did indeed agree to suspend hostilities at the time.\nBut no ceasefire agreement was signed
In the battle at Baling Village, our Xianxia Sect also defended Central Wulin against Yama Palace.\nWe barely managed to win after a fierce battle.
Since then, I have once again turned the tide and defeated the Wulin public enemy Si Zhonglan and the Blood Clothes League.\nI wonder where Sect Leader Han was at that time?
Cough cough, #PlayerName# makes a good point,\nYour sect has indeed done much to ensure the safety of the Wulin.
But today, the Bloodcloak Alliance has fallen apart.\nWhy does your sect have to resort to arms again and come into conflict with the Iron Palm Gang?
Master Han, with the great chaos in the world today and the myriad heroes contending,\nThe Xianxia Sect and the Iron Palm Gang are both struggling on their own. I'm sure you're well aware of this.
For now, we must follow the ancestors' teachings and combine the power of our two clans.\nCan stand firm in the tumultuous winds of Jianghu and ultimately achieve great endeavors.
Divided we fall, united we reign; our two factions share the same origins.\nIt's time to settle these century-old grudges!
Good! #PlayerName#, your grand strategy and deep insight are impressive.\nI, Han Mou, confess that I am inferior.
But Summer Xiong, the Sect Leader in summer, handed down his legacy to this old man.\nIf we just hand it over like this, it would be hard to convince everyone.
Today, if your sect can honestly and openly seize our main den,\nYour argument just now was convincing
I swear by heaven \nHenceforth, we will recognize the Xianxia Sect as our Sect Leader and never rebel.
But if you cannot conquer it, I regret that I cannot comply.\nPardon us and return home. Do not continue to indulge in fantasies.
Good. Since Sect Leader Han is so straightforward, let's make a deal!
Our two factions are already of the same spirit and share the same root. I hope both sides can show some restraint in this battle.\nDo not harm people's lives and create enmity.
Since #PlayerName# has such grace, I will instruct my disciples to do the same.
I shall test the high skills of Sect Leader Han! I apologize for any offense!
The Iron Palm Gang is relying on the city wall for defense and hoping to wear down our forces with arrow turrets.\nEveryone be extra careful
Hmm, the enemy defenses were very tight in this battle.\nWe must not underestimate our foes and act rashly, lest we become the target of everyone's anger.
In my opinion, we should first use our elite disciples to disable the outer tower defenses.\nTo steadily advance while maintaining formation is the most thorough approach.
Good, let's proceed steadily \nGradually deplete their combat power; we will surely secure the victory!
Factions' disciples paired up to fight below the city walls,\nInstantly, the sky turned turbulent, and howls echoed like ghostly cries.
Disciples of the Iron Palm Gang fought bravely but continued to retreat.\nUntil retreating to the depths of the sect hall, he was already surrounded on all sides with no other option.
Huff.... huff....\n#PlayerName#'s martial arts are unparalleled, and his disciples are all exceptionally talented.
This battle seems to be a loss for the Iron Palm Gang.
Fighting until now against our forces, your disciples are not men and women who fear death.\nSect Leader Han, the situation is settled. There's no need to unnecessarily start another fight.

The great trend of the world dictates that unity will give way to division, and division will eventually lead to reunity.\nIt seems that our centuries-long feud between the two factions is finally coming to an end.
Only to see Han Song sigh deeply into the sky,\nThen came a voice like a great bell, commanding the Iron Palm Gang disciples to cease their resistance.
Iron Palm Gang disciples, listen up!\nThe battle is over; lay down your weapons and surrender!
#PlayerName#, I admit my loss \nFrom today onward, the Iron Palm Gang will recognize the Xianxia Sect as our Sect Leader and follow #PlayerName#'s every command!
Today, following the patriarch's teachings, our two sects are reunited once more.\nI wonder if Master and Sect Leader Xiariang can also smile in the Heavenly Spirit Realm.
Cough cough, #PlayerName#,\nDuring the time when the two factions were in conflict, my Iron Palm Gang offended your faction multiple times.\nHan Mou hereby offers their apologies to you.

Sect Leader Han rest assured. Under Sect Leader Xia's tenure, your sect did indeed commit numerous wicked deeds.\nBut now that the leaders of the bandits have all been executed,\nThe Iron Palm Gang has also turned over a new leaf under your governance.
Moreover, our two factions are already of the same spirit and closely connected.\nThese old grudges should also be settled
#PlayerName# is magnanimous; I, Han, fall short!
Hearing these words, Han Song's face lit up with joy, and he led the disciples of the Iron Palm Gang,\nI prostrate myself and shout long live the king.
Subsequently, the two parties formally signed an agreement.\nThe Iron Palm Gang vows to become a vassal of the Xianxia Sect and will never betray them.
Who would have thought that what no Sect Leader managed to achieve for so many years...\nAnd #PlayerName# just completed it like that
#$PlayerName#, you are indeed the best candidate for Sect Leader.\nThe master did not see wrongly
Hehe, it still depends on the help of all my senior brothers to achieve this day's victory.
Back in the day, the Iron Palm Gang really gave us a tough time.\nToday, I finally got to hold my head up high.
Yeah yeah, I had eighteen different torture methods ready.\nUsed on that old Han Song... Never thought it would end like this....
Han Song is someone with loyalty and righteousness; he is not a deceitful villain.\nUnder his leadership, the Iron Palm Gang will be able to provide more assistance to our side in the future.
Today, the two factions finally reconciled after much difficulty.\nIf it merely increases killing, it might chill the hearts of all heroes in the land.
#PlayerName# is right!\nThe villains have already been punished, so there's no need to involve the innocent.
Wu wu wu wu, ah ah ah ah......
Yang, Senior Brother Yang, why are you crying again?

Back in the day, we went through so much hardship and fought against the Iron Palm Gang for so many years...\nBig Senior Brother fell off a cliff, and Senior Brother was also beaten to the point of severed meridians....
Hard as it was today, both factions finally reunited.\nIf Master knew about this, he would surely be overjoyed to tears as well!
Woo woo woo woo! Ah ah ah ah!!

Senior Brother Yang, your actions are too slow.\nThe assassin was driven off by us early on.

Senior Brother Gu, this plan to attack the Tang Sect's main headquarters,\nIt needs more consideration; there can be no room for error.

Yay!
#PlayerName#, die!
...Sure enough, the top assassin of the Tang Sect lives up to its reputation.

He actually felt more like...\nUh... more like...

Cough cough, Great Heroes,\nDon't spread this outside; I'm telling you this.

(pulled out that green-tinted bone fragment)\nDare to ask, Sect Leader Huafu, do you recognize the poison on this corpse?

Father! Father!\nThe opponents' attack is fierce; the disciples are barely holding on!
Now that it has come to this, I must summon the plan I spent so much effort crafting,\nRigged up the ultimate hidden weapon

White Cloud Apprentice Beware!\n(Fast draw and deflect the remaining needle)

#PlayerName#, under Mount Emei, I was attacked by the bad guys from Yama Palace.\nHave you ever stood up for me and saved my life like this?

Is this time the Maoshan Sect seeking revenge for Dao Wuming?\nDidn't Lord Dao Daolevator kill Shi Zhonglan...?
Well, well, since it doesn't concern me, I shouldn't trouble myself.\nIt would be wiser to leave first
In a dense forest,\nThe Maoshan Sect and the Five Poisons Sect are facing off against each other...

The Maoshan Sect has always been focused on cultivating Dao and rarely involved in the affairs of the Jianghu.\nWhy would they suddenly travel a thousand miles to Yunnan to fight against the Five Poisons Sect?
Let me hear what they are arguing about so I can understand the situation better...
Hmph. I wonder how many Maoshan Sect disciples have appeared in the Miaojiang lately.\nIt was you old fellow pulling the strings behind my back!
Master Lungzheng, it's a pleasure to meet you!
My Five Poisons Sect has no grudge against your Maoshan Sect.\nSpeak up. Why are you repeatedly attacking our disciples?
Dare to ask, Dragon Palm Sect Master, the former Dayin Pavilion Pavilion Lord Dao Wuming,...\nBut killed by your sect?
Dao Wuming? Haha, I haven't even seen him a few times.\nWhere does this deadly harm come from!
Moreover, Dao Wuming is the Pavilion Master of the Dayin Pavilion.\nIf the Dayin Pavilion isn't even seeking revenge, what are you guys from the Maoshan Sect doing here?
Dayin Pavilion's lord, Dao Wuming, is handsomely charismatic and incredibly wise.\nHe was already my close friend

In my early days of studying lightning and thunder magic, I accidentally fell into demonhood.\nIt was also due to Brother of the Dao Pavilion's full effort in saving that I managed to preserve my life.

I secluded myself for several years to practice the Heavenly Scripture of Augmented Mysteries, and only completed it the day before yesterday.\nUnexpectedly, upon release from confinement, I heard the shocking news of my dear friend's demise.
So Daoist, leading the Miaoshan disciples, rushed here to Yunnan by night and day.\nIt's to seek justice from your sect!
Ah, Your Excellency and Dao Wuming have a deep friendship.\nI'm so moved, I almost shed tears!
As everyone knows, Dao Wuming was killed by the traitor Da Yin, Shi Zhulan.\nIf you wish to seek revenge, you may have chosen the wrong person.
If you wish to take revenge on Zhong Lan, the headmaster does know where this person can be found.
He was attacked by #$PlayerName# and the leaders of various factions.\nEventually perished alongside the King of Hell \nIts head and body lie in the Ten Thousand Poison Pool of our sect.
Haha, hurry up and go retrieve it; there might still be some bones left.
I would not have believed that Brother Dao was harmed by Si Zhonglan.\nOnly after consulting the current Head Ji Qingfan did we fully understand the background.
Si Zhonglan was originally a righteous martial artist revered by all in the Jianghu.\nI have quite a bit of acquaintance with him as well.
Had I not been initiated into your sect's Thread puppet Manipulating coercion,\nHow could he possibly do such wicked things?
Old man, even if you want to hold the puppet bug accountable,\nYou should also find Heartless Calm as the mastermind behind this.\nWhy would you cause trouble for the Five Poisons Sect!
Ji Xinkuang was originally a disciple of the Five Poisons Sect.\nOnly the Five Poisons Sect can forge this entwined insect charm.\nShouldn't I be finding you guys instead?

Oh, old man, I think you've overexerted yourself in seclusion and damaged your brain.\nQi Xinkuang had long left the sect years ago, yet the current Grand Sect Leader still wanted to cause him trouble.
And this thread-piercing insect charm, though crafted by our sect,\nBut whether users do evil or good with it, this teaching has no say in the matter.
If your friend is killed by a sword forged at Sword Forging Villa,\nDon't you intend to seek revenge at Sword Forging Villa?
Dragon Palm Sect, Jianghu rumors say that the Five Poisons Sect contains,\nThey are all lawless barbarians who do not understand reason or submit to teachings.
Today I see; your intelligence,\nNot under any of the mainline Central Plains sect leaders.
Hmph, of course!
Since it's like that, I'll just come out and say it.\nThe thread puppet is incredibly peculiar and can control one's mind, leading people down a wicked path.
The Bloodcloth Covenant used this to first kill Emperor Shizong Chai Rong.\nAnd manipulated Si Zhonglan to poison the Dao Pavilion Lord,\nIndirectly, it led to great chaos and the Wulin Crisis.
Such wicked magic truly goes against the Heavenly Path and brings endless calamity.\nAs long as this thing remains, there can be no peace in the world for a single day.
As a cultivator, one should uphold justice and suppress demons.\nSo I have come here to ensure that this thread-piercing insect no longer brings calamity to the mortal world.
Haha, it's easy to say, but how do you plan to ensure it?

I've heard your sect possesses a secret manual called the Ten Thousand Poison Holy Classic.\nDocumented all methods of refining toxins and the principles of their mutual generation and inhibition throughout the land.\nThe threaded silk insect must also be recorded there.

As long as the Venom Master teaches hands over the Comprehensive Toxic Arts Scroll to this poor Daoist, it will be easier to study the countermeasure against the Tethered Pestilence Parasite.\nI shall let bygones be bygones and no longer hold the Dragon Palm Sect responsible for aiding in the persecution.

Haha, winding around for so long,\nOriginally, you wanted to steal the Ten Thousand Poison Sacred Scriptures from the Five Poisons Sect!\nIsn't that why they say the people from Central Plains are nothing but shirted beasts?
This Ten Thousand Poison Martial Arts Canon is the unspeakable secret and foundation of our Five Poisons Sect.\nHow could I possibly give this old man such an important task so easily?
Moreover, what in hell is upholding justice by heaven's mandate?\nFrom what this Grand Master sees, you want to learn the method of cultivating Silk-string Pupa.\nThen go ahead and use it yourself!
Dragon Palm Master, do not judge others by your own standards.\nSince you refuse to give it, I can only take it myself.
Come on, let me see if you have what it takes!

内容: Two sides stood with swords drawn and bows bent, about to engage in battle.\nWhat should we do about it?
Hold on for a moment! There seems to be some misunderstanding here.\nPlease hear me out, #$PlayerName#......
#$PlayerName#? Why do you have to show up everywhere...
The head patriarch was just about to scold this old Daoist when \nIf you're not going to help, stay out of the way!
I have heard much about #PlayerName#'s righteous reputation.\nWhy don't you join me in upholding justice today?
Hold your horses for now. Let me speak first...
You refuse to aid us? Could it be that the Five Poisons Sect has sent help instead?\nCould #PlayerName# have also been affected by the thread bug... in that case, it makes sense.
#$PlayerName#, you're not helping, but you insist on blocking my way.\nThen don't blame me for not being polite!
You two don't understand human speech, right?\nSure, I'll block the middle of the road today...
Then see my move!
#PlayerName#, don't panic. I'll subdue you first.\nWhile pressuring the Dragon Palm Sect about the thread insect solution definitely will not let you be controlled again!
Oh oh oh oh, you're really here!
Hmph! What a group of Central Plain Heroes!\nTo bully this weak woman, you really have no shame at all!
#$PlayerName#, He Zudao, wait for this grandmaster \nToday's actions I, Long Feng'e, shall repay a hundredfold!
Dragon, Dragon Palm Sect? Ah....\nThis temper of Dragon Palm Master's is still so stubborn.
Cough cough cough, thank you #PlayerName# for your help!
The poison skills of the Five Poisons Sect are indeed formidable.\nWithout your intervention, we might have met with a tragic end.
Just this time #PlayerName# helped me out \nAlso made enemies with Long Feng'e from the Five Poisons Sect.\nI genuinely feel bad about it
Great Hero, there's no need to be polite. We are fellow practitioners from the Central Plains Wulin.\nOne ought to intervene in such cases and offer aid, as the saying goes.
Hmm, #PlayerName#, if you turn out to be as rumored...\nRighteous heart and courage, upholding justice
In this way, I can rest assured handing over this secret technique to you.
This is... the Five Poisons Sect's Ten Thousand Poison Sacred Classic?!\nGreat Hero, how did you come by this?
Just now during the fierce battle, I took advantage of Long Feng'e's unpreparedness,\nUsing the secret technique of remote object retrieval from Mount Moshan, he took it out from his travel bag.
This Immortal Poison Manual records the methods to deal with all toxic substances in the world.\n#PlayerName#, if you copy this back, it can serve as a backup in case we need it.
Thus, I thank Great Hero He for your kindness!
I will bring this secret scripture back to the Maoshan Sect and study the method to unravel the thread pupa.\nWe must not let such evil spirits continue to wreak havoc on the Central Plains Wulin!
The Great Hero is eager to help others and acts with righteous virtue; I admire you.\nGoodbye then!
Surprised, #PlayerName# has such a reputation for chivalry and righteousness.\nNow they have even lost all discernment, aiding the Five Poisons Sect, a den of heretics and outsiders!
Hmph, well, today you've outdone yourselves \nBut one day, Immortal will see justice done for the fallen of Central Plains!
What, Great Hero? Ah....\nThese great heroes have tempers that are one stubbornness worse than the last.
Haha, that's right! These Central Plain Heroes,\nOne by one, they cling to outdated ways and remain stubbornly ignorant.
Clearly like a toilet stone that is both smelly and stubborn \nInstead, each one considers themselves highly enlightened, believing they have grasped some fundamental truth of the world.
#PlayerName#, as the current Grand Master, I consider you one of the few rational individuals in Central China.\nYou must be quite tired of these great heroes.

From today on, you should join the Five Poisons Sect under my guidance.\nI broke my usual practice and imparted the Ten Thousand Venom Manual in its entirety.\nWith your skills, you are guaranteed to dominate the Jianghu and have no opponents.
Cough cough, thank Dragon Palm Sect Leader for your kind offer.\nI am already the Sect Leader of Xianxia Sect. It might not be appropriate for me to join the Five Poisons Sect as an apprentice.
Hmph, I suppose that's why they say the people from Central Plains are unadaptable.
Go ahead, really. This Immortal Venom Codex is meant to be passed down only to the descendants of the Miaojiang region.\nSince you're not being tactful, I don't want to pass it on!
The head of the Daoist sect still needs to expel the remaining Mao Shan disciples from Miao Jiang.\nTo avoid any more trouble, I won't stick around to handle it.
#PlayerName#, when did you change your mind?\nThe current Grand Master will be eagerly awaiting your arrival at the main temple of the Five Poisons Sect.
Thank you for your kind words, Master Dragon Palm....I'll take my leave.
The fiercest dragon and tiger combat, blades flashing in dazzling light,\nHe Zudao and Long Feng'e, along with their respective followers, acted simultaneously.\nCouldn't do anything to you
You merely had to shout, forcibly separating the two factions.\nThen he gave a gentle smile and pressed his fists together in a courteous gesture.
#PlayerName# great skill! I've heard that your martial arts are formidable.\nToday's meeting surpasses even the legends of Jianghu.
Immortal, thank you for letting me win!\nI have heard that you are one of the Five Great Heroes of Central China, alongside Guo Xia.\nI daresay he is not one to make unreasonable demands.
Of course
Cai Xinkuang is a traitor from the Five Poisons Sect.\nWhen I fought this person before, Master Dragon Palm also lent a hand.
So if one were to attribute all the sins committed by Qixin Kuang to Long Zhang Dao,\nThat's a bit unreasonable, isn't it!
As the head of the Five Venom Palm sect, she failed to recognize talent and taught improperly.\nDon't they have any responsibility at all?

Still, there are bound to be individuals within the Maoshan Sect who engage in misdeeds.\nIf Jianghu folk use this as an excuse to cause trouble for your sect,\nThat might be beyond your sect's ability to handle as well.
Hmm... #PlayerName#, your words make sense.\nFor this reckless act, I shall not pursue it further.
But this Silk Infestation is truly incredibly wicked.\nTo prevent him from continuing to plague the Central Plains Wulin, I must obtain the Ten Thousand Poison Sacred Text today.
This Ten Thousand Poison Manual is a secret that the Five Poisons Sect does not transmit.\nGreat Hero, if you force your way today, wouldn't that go against the code of chivalry?

I've heard that the Maoshan Sect also has a secret method called the Heavenly Scripture of Concealment.\nIf I were to forcibly seize what I consider to be the salvation of all under heaven today,\nYour faction probably won't comply willingly either
......Hmm, #PlayerName#, that's a valid point. It's me who has been careless.

Great Hero Ho, while your desire to avenge the Dao Pavilion's lord and uphold justice is praiseworthy,\nBut one should not harm others in the process; otherwise, it will only intensify the conflicts within the Wulin.
Dragon Palm Sect, this Silk Thread Parasite is indeed incredibly dangerous.\nMultiple times they brought chaos to the Central Plains and the world.\nSo please do not refine this substance anymore.
I wasn't planning to refine this item...\nThe unexpected events before were indeed due to my lack of consideration.
As long as Master Dragon Palm vows not to refine the Silk-threaded Reeling Pestilence,\nThat Great Hero, you can now rest assured.
Well... This is just a temporary solution.\nWhat if Master Longzhang reneges on his promise, #PlayerName#?
Hmph! Long Feng'e always speaks with action.\nYou won't be as fickle as those people from Central China!
Two of you, I have repeatedly prevented conflicts between the two factions previously.\nYou can ask my disciples \nThus, this sufficiently proves my neutral mediation stance.
If you two trust me, I will act as a guarantor for Dragon Palm Sect here.\nEnsure she will never again cultivate the Tethered Silk Cultivator.
If Dragon Palm Sect later goes back on its word,\nThen I shall go to the Five Poisons Sect myself to confront them.\nNo trouble yourself, Great Hero
But Great Hero He, your Maoshan Sect must also ensure,\nFrom today on, no longer trouble the Five Poisons Sect.
This way, the long-standing disputes between the two factions can be settled.\nI wonder if you two trust me, #$PlayerName#?
Well, with #PlayerName#'s martial arts and character,\nSince you are willing to guarantee this matter, I can rest assured now.
This silk-stringed insect is both difficult to refine and not very useful.\nThe current Palm Sect leader couldn't care less about that.
As long as your Maoshan Sect ensures you won't keep causing trouble in the Miaojiang,\nI promise not to cultivate the Tethering Worm Cultivations anymore. Should that suffice?
Alright, then let's make a deal \nToday, the two factions shook hands in reconciliation, and all past grievances were swept clean!
Hmph, though this matter could be easily resolved by our sect as well.\nBut this time you #$PlayerName# mediated the conflict, you've saved me a lot of trouble.
Haha, these Central Plain Heroes,\nOne by one, they cling to outdated ways and remain stubbornly ignorant.
Clearly like a toilet stone that is both smelly and stubborn \nInstead, each one considers themselves highly enlightened, believing they have grasped some fundamental truth of the world.
#PlayerName#, as the current Grand Master, I consider you one of the few rational individuals in Central China.\nYou must be quite tired of these great heroes.

From today on, you should join the Five Poisons Sect under my guidance.\nI broke my usual practice and imparted the Ten Thousand Venom Manual in its entirety.\nWith your skills, you are guaranteed to dominate the Jianghu and have no opponents.
Cough cough, thank Dragon Palm Sect Leader for your kind offer.\nI am already the Sect Leader of Xianxia Sect. It might not be appropriate for me to join the Five Poisons Sect as an apprentice.
Hmph, I suppose that's why they say the people from Central Plains are unadaptable.
Go ahead, really. This Immortal Venom Codex is meant to be passed down only to the descendants of the Miaojiang region.\nSince you're not being tactful, I don't want to pass it on!
But to avoid others saying I fail to repay kindness,\nAt least accept this secret technique
Thank you for your help, Dragon Palm Daoist.
The head of the Palm Teaching must also send the remaining Mount Shang disciples out of the Miaoguan.\nTo avoid any more trouble, I won't stick around to handle it.
#PlayerName#, when did you change your mind?\nThe current Grand Master will be eagerly awaiting your arrival at the main temple of the Five Poisons Sect.
Cough cough, we have offended the Five Poisons Sect and its members quite a bit before this.\nI also offer my apologies here
Hmph, I forgive and forget
#PlayerName# mediated this time,\nIf we could truly ensure that the string puppets never return to Jianghu,\nThat truly was a great achievement for the Central Plain's Wulin.
#PlayerName#, sometime in the future, if there's anything that can utilize Poor Daoist's assistance,...\nI shall do my utmost to assist as well.
Thanks! It's perfect that we could resolve this matter today.\nThe two of you are welcome to leave!
Dragon Palm Master, I always have a day,\nTo seek justice for those who died in Central China!
Hmph, your actions of late,\nI Long Feng'e shall return it in kind!
While He Zudao's words have merit, Dragon Palm Daoist indeed seems somewhat innocent.\nThe two parties are evenly matched, so this grudge is officially settled.
Never mind it. Why get involved in this?\nStill, the best move is to flee, as the saying goes...
#PlayerName#, the Central Plains Coalition is about to besiege the Jingcheng.\nIt's time to gather all our forces and engage in the final battle with them.
Well, finally it's today

Ladies and gentlemen, #$PlayerName# has been supported by all of you since I succeeded as the Sect Leader of Xianxia Sect.\nSurviving the torment in Yama Palace and the machinations of the Bloodrobe Alliance, they managed to hold on.
Thereafter, our sect endured hardships and worked diligently to revitalize ourselves.\nDefeat the Iron Palm Gang first, then take over the Tang Sect.\nFinally quelled the unrest in Sichuan Province

Subsequently, we allied with the Emei and Wudang sects.\nAnd with the combined strength of the five schools, they conquered Yama Palace in one fell swoop.\nThus greatly expanding the scope of our sect's influence.

After that, we seized the opportunity when the Emperor suspected Flying Dragon Sect and thus justified our entry to rule the Jingcheng.\nSubsequently, he was ordered to subdue the Flying Dragon Sect, which had once been the premier martial sect in all of Central China.

This experience was truly earth-shattering and unparalleled in history.\nOur faction now controls nearly half of the realm.\nThe achievements we have established today are sufficient to be recorded in history.

But it is still not enough, for the agreement I made with all of you was to stabilize the chaotic world.\nNow the Central Plains are still divided among various Wulin sects, with powerful clans rising up, leaving the common people in suffering.
And now, the major sects in Central Plains have formed an alliance out of fear of our power.\nWant to gather half of the Central Plains Wulin's top martial artists and reclaim this key capital city.

If the enemy wins this battle, then the capital must be lost.\nOur plan to establish dominance in Central China will suffer significant setbacks.\nFacing a united front from the various factions of Central Plains in the future will also be difficult.
But if we win this battle, we can crush the coalition army of Central Plains in one fell swoop.\nThe various schools from the Central Plains will also fall apart, becoming scattered like sand.

Justcapitalize on the momentum then, and completing it for Prince Zhou Shizong Chairong will be seamless.\nAnd jointly pursue Zhao Yizong's unfinished grand vision for dominion.\nFrom now on, pacify the chaotic world and unify the Jianghu!
Such a golden opportunity in front of us, how could we let it slip away?\nSo today, I would like to ask all of you to join me in battling once more. May I know if that suits your intentions?
#PlayerName#, rest assured, as the Big Senior Brother of the Xianxia Sect,\nI, Wei Xuhua, will lead by example and charge bravely ahead!
Haha, as the one who led #PlayerName# into this back then,\nAs my senior brother, I can't fall behind either.
Ten years to sharpen this sword, its frosty edge remains untried.\nToday is the perfect day for me, Yu Caiwei, to test the results of my cultivation over these many years.
#PlayerName#, fellow disciples,\nWe've worked together to overcome so many challenges.
Today's final hurdle will definitely be conquered!\nGentlemen...#PlayerName#...I, Jiang Wan, believe in you.
Of course, with #PlayerName#'s world-class martial arts skills,\nWith Xiaoye's intelligence and wit, the Central Plains Coalition Forces will surely be annihilated!
Alright, everyone, the senior brothers and sisters will be responsible for brainstorming.\nAs for the dirty work, heavy labor, and the most dangerous tasks, they are all on me, Yang Sichi!
These past years... I, Lin Yunshang, have been well cared for by all of you, senior brothers and sisters.\nThough my parents are gone, your kindness towards me surpasses that of my own parents!
Today, even my life, Lin Yunshang would risk it.\nLet's also secure this battle's victory together!
Wow, everyone's really good at talking...\nI may not be able to utter such passionate words,\nBut I also feel my blood boiling with excitement!
#PlayerName#, even though I haven't fully recovered my memories in these days,\nBut fuzzy images still occasionally flash through his mind.
We should have gone through many hardships before.\nThere have also been many happy or sorrowful memories from the past.\nBut perhaps these matters are unimportant
The most important thing right now is that I really like the Xianxia Sect.\nLike Big Senior Brother's pretend sternness and Senior Brother's patient guidance.

Likes Senior Sister Yu's direct and decisive actions, and Senior Sister Jiang's gentle and refined manner.\nScrim Senior Brother's carefree attitude, Fyng Senior Brother's diligence making up for his deficiencies.
And there's also the delicious food and drinks made by Senior Lin!
And... and #PlayerName#, who has always been the best to me, #PlayerName#.\nYou are all the most beautiful and virtuous people in this world, and I truly believe that!

#PlayerName#, fellow seniors Senior Brothers and Sisters,\nEven if my strength is lost, Bai Yuntian still wants to rely on this sword today.\nGuard these new and cherished memories left behind for all of you.
I think if we win this battle, we can create even more wonderful memories.\nSo it doesn't seem like such a tragic thing to forget all the previous memories!
White Cloud Junior Cultivator.....
Little White Junior Sister said it really well! Though it's just some plain talk,\nBut every word was heartfelt, and I almost cried...
Uh....What did I just say? I can't really remember either.\nI've ended up saying a lot...
Anyway, I remember the last few lines: Little White Junior Sister likes the yummy food I made!\nHa ha, after this battle, if you want to eat anything, Senior Sister Lin will make it for you.
I want to too!
And me!
Good, good. Once we win this battle, our sect will truly be the Alliance Leader of the Wulin.\nYou can have anything you want... but we still need to win first.
Sure thing. I'll have to give it my all for this too.
In addition, there are our allied Sect Leaders.\nFor us to win this final battle, we will need your full support as well.
Divided, they fall; united, they rule \nIf we win today, it really would fulfill the master's prophecy.
#PlayerName# investigates the cause of your parents' death and seeks revenge.\nI will do my utmost to help #PlayerName# win this battle.
The Xianxia Sect and our Meigu have a long-standing connection; previously, it has often assisted us in resisting powerful enemies.\nToday, I too shall return favor for favor and lend a helping hand.
Hmm, all of our Precious Meridian's elite forces have been deployed for this battle. We must definitely aid #PlayerName# in securing victory.

Haha, if #PlayerName# could really achieve this and bring peace to the chaotic world in one battle...\nThat is indeed a blessing for all the people under heaven. Wudang will also do its utmost to assist.
#PlayerName#, you killed Si Zhonglan and Jin Longsheng, avenging my mother's grief.\nI will do my utmost to lend you a hand.
I believe you. After this battle, if you can unify the Jianghu,\nThen it will surely bring long-term peace and stability to the Central Plains Wulin.
Haha! I never expected it either!\nThe great endeavor that even my cousin Zhao Yinzong was unable to complete in his time,\nYou've made it to the final step today, of all days!
Old Man, I wonder if you truly can win this battle and achieve unprecedented feats!
The various sects maneuver against each other, causing continuous strife.\nThe heavens and earth have suffered for long.
Today, #PlayerName#, if you wish to inherit Brother Zhao Yizong's legacy,\nThen I, Zhao Polu, will also charge into battle for your sake, risking death a thousand times without hesitation!
Good, thank you all Sect Leaders for your strong support!
I, #$PlayerName#, came from humble beginnings,\nSince stepping into the Jianghu, it has been several decades.
Started from nothing, resolved to learn martial arts,\nTraversing the road, we faced numerous hardships and obstacles.
So far, being able to earn the trust of so many fellow disciples and respected Sect Leaders has been invaluable.\nIt is already a fortune in three lifetimes.
#$PlayerName# will not let everyone's trust down \nYou must give it your all to secure this victory.
Time has come. Please beat the war drums and sound the horns.\nPrepare to head to the Jingcheng and engage the enemy in a final showdown!
Outside the Jingcheng, it seems it has never been this lively...
Shaolin, Beggars Sect, Great Concealment, Taoist Mountain, Forge Swords,\nPenglai, Shenshi, Changle, Bili, totaling nine Sect Leaders.\nAssemble all the sect's elite at the city gates.

Almost half of the Central Plains' Wulin were among the allied forces.\nThe other half is handled by the Xianxia, Tiexiang, Tang Sect, Meishu,\nWudang, Yen Luo, and Feilong sect leaders led their formations in defense on the city walls.
Master Kongwen, quite the grand spectacle today!\nI never expected you #$PlayerName# to have such face.\nAllow the Nine Great Sects of Central Plains to join forces against their enemies.
Amituofo! #PlayerName#, though our personal acquaintance is not deep,\nBut I have long heard that you are a man of honor and righteousness.

Today, I have joined forces with the Nine Great Sects to launch an army against your sect. It is not out of bravado or mere combativeness.\nRather, we hope to dissuade you from the notion of taking control of Central China and unifying the Jianghu.

Your esteemed faction now holds Jingxiang, Bashu, Yunnan, and Guangnan, achieving unprecedented accomplishments.\nYou must also be familiar with the principle that the moon waxes and wanes, and water overflows its banks.
We could have lived in peace, each to our own content.\nWhy does #PlayerName# have to get involved in the Central Plains and fight to the death with all the factions?
I hope #PlayerName#, for the sake of our many years in the Wulin,\nListen to an old monk's advice
Only if you are willing to return the Jingcheng and withdraw from Central Plains can we avoid this conflict today.\nMy allied forces from Central China promise not to make things difficult for you.

I have heard that Master is the Abbot of Shaolin Temple, a revered figure whom all in the Jianghu respect.\nHow could I forget that the Jingcheng was granted to me, #$PlayerName#, by the Emperor and entrusted to the Xianxia Sect for defense?
If Master has any objections, he can petition the emperor to revoke his edict.\nThe Xianxia Sect merely carried out our duty. Why push so hard, gentlemen?

Amituofo! #PlayerName#, you control the Jingcheng.\nTo seize control of the Central Plains- who doesn't know about this?\nIndeed, allowing such a vital stronghold to fall into your hands is a miscalculation on the part of our Central Plain Wulin.

But today, with our mighty army at the gates of the city, we must reclaim the Jingcheng.\nThus, it can prevent the court and the emperor from being manipulated by you, even to the point of commanding the lords with the mandate of heaven!

Hate to saddle you with blame, maestro \nI see that you just want to use the pretense of cleansing the court to achieve your own goals.\nIt's all about continuing to maintain the fragmentation of various factions and reigning as kings or domineering warlords.
I #$PlayerName# vow to bring stability to the chaotic world,\nToday's battle in the Jingcheng marks the beginning of my sweep through Central Wulin.
Over the years, the King of Hell, Si Zhonglan, Jin Longsheng, and countless other world-renowned masters have fallen at my hands.\nIf Abbots want to try again, just come and give it a shot!
Amituofo! Since the benefactor remains unwavering in delusion,\nThat leaves me only to use martial arts to uphold the Way, subdue demons, and vanquish evil.

Fellow practitioners, the future landscape of Central Plain's Wulin hangs in this battle.\nToday, as we unite once more, we shall surely achieve what we did during the Tai Yue Ceremony years ago.\nTurn the tide and secure victory
The Joint Army of the Nine Sects, listen up! Prepare for siege!

The enemy is preparing to attack the city, so this battle will be led by our Xianxia Sect.\nThe other factions pressed forward in the agreed formation order, leaving no opportunity for the enemy to strike.
Hmph. Finally can stretch out my muscles and bones.\nToday we must settle the humiliation I suffered at Mount Tai back then!
Besides, Baiyunzi, you shouldn't go on stage just yet...
Ah? How could that be allowed!
Not that we don't want you to act, but your power has recovered by most.\nCan serve as our secret weapon
According to intelligence, the opponent might summon an esteemed master for this battle.\nYou should use your lightness to delay this person and give us a chance.
Oh, got it. Alright, I'll take care of it then!
The enemy troops have arrived. Be careful, everyone! Let the battle begin!
If not me entering the nether realms, who will? This battle shall be led by my Shaolin disciples!
Shaolin disciples, heed my command and follow me to subdue evil!
#PlayerName#, the enemy forces are strong, with ample reinforcements.\nWe should leverage our defensive advantages, make steady progress, and secure the victory.
Good, I have long heard that both of you masters have profound knowledge of Buddhism and your martial arts skills are unparalleled.\nToday, #$PlayerName#, I come to seek your advice from both of you.
Disciples of Yama Palace are all battle-hardened veterans skilled in military formations.\nAs the second main force, he is perfectly suited for this role!
Haha, from heaven to earth, I alone am supreme!\nCentral Plain's scraps, who dares to challenge me in battle!
Only to see the disciples of Yama Palace form a neat military array.\nWith this elite troop trained by Zhao Yizong and the King of Hell,...\nInstantly halted the enemy's offensive
Wow, this situation is even more intense than the Taiyue Grand Ceremony back then.
Recall those days, even the old beggar was thrilled.\nAnd with these crippled palms, I must once again dance the Dragon Descends and fight valiantly!
